metadata.description: Reviewed MDPro3/YGOPro Lua function documentation overrides used by generate_function_docs.py.

schema.summary_en: English summary lines for editor/wiki output.
schema.summary_zh: Chinese summary lines for editor/wiki output.
schema.core_summary_en: Short core-backed summary retained from the old signature override block.
schema.core_summary_zh: Chinese short core-backed summary retained from the old signature override block.
schema.params: Ordered parameter records with name, type, optional, description, and optional description_zh fields.
schema.returns: Ordered return records with type, description, and optional description_zh fields; an empty list means no Lua return values.

summary_en: Returns a composed predicate that calls each function with the same arguments and stops at the first falsy result.
summary_zh: 返回组合条件函数；调用时会用相同参数依次执行传入的函数，并在第一个假值处停止。

summary_en: Registers an EFFECT_LEAVE_FIELD_REDIRECT effect that banishes c when condition is true, defaulting to face-up c.
summary_zh: 登记EFFECT_LEAVE_FIELD_REDIRECT效果，使condition为真时离场的c改为除外；默认条件为c表侧表示。
core_summary_en: Registers leave-field banish redirect.

params.name: condition
params.description: default: face-up condition

summary_en: Registers one or more card codes as codes listed by c, so later checks such as Auxiliary.IsCodeListed can find them. Skipped while c is copying an effect.
summary_zh: 为c登记1个或多个卡名编号，供Auxiliary.IsCodeListed等函数判断这些编号是否被c列名。复制效果时不处理。

summary_en: Registers a Contact Fusion Special Summon procedure on c, using material filter locations and the provided material operation, and returns the created procedure effect.
summary_zh: 为c登记接触融合特殊召唤手续，使用指定素材筛选位置和素材操作，并返回创建的手续效果。
core_summary_en: Registers a Contact Fusion Special Summon procedure on c.

returns.description: The created Contact Fusion procedure effect.

summary_en: Adds the shared Drytron ignition effect that Special Summons c from the hand or Graveyard.
The effect uses the common Drytron release cost, target, operation wrapper, and custom activity counter.
summary_zh: 为c添加「龙辉巧」共通的从手牌或墓地特殊召唤自身的起动效果。
该效果使用共通的解放费用、目标、操作包装函数以及特殊召唤限制计数器。

summary_en: Creates an Equip Spell activation effect for c and registers the matching EFFECT_EQUIP_LIMIT.
The activation effect is returned; when pause is true it is created but not registered on c.
summary_zh: 为c创建装备魔法发动效果，并登记对应的EFFECT_EQUIP_LIMIT。
返回创建的发动效果；pause为true时只创建该效果，不立即登记到c上。
core_summary_en: Creates an Equip Spell activation helper.
core_summary_zh: 创建装备魔法发动辅助效果。

params.name: pause
params.description: default: false

params.name: skip_target
params.description: default: false

returns.description: Created activation effect.

summary_en: Convenience wrapper for Auxiliary.AddFusionEffectProcUltimate.
It builds a params table from the common Fusion Summon arguments: Extra Deck filter, material locations, material filter, material movement operation, and optional advanced params.
summary_zh: Auxiliary.AddFusionEffectProcUltimate的便捷包装。
它会根据常用的融合召唤参数构造params表：额外卡组过滤、素材位置、素材过滤、素材移动操作以及可选的高级params。
core_summary_en: Convenience wrapper for Auxiliary.AddFusionEffectProcUltimate.

params.name: filter
params.description: Fusion Monster filter for the Extra Deck candidate.

params.name: mat_location
params.description: Base material locations, commonly LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_MZONE.

params.name: mat_filter
params.description: Optional candidate material filter.

params.name: mat_operation
params.description: Optional operation that moves the selected material group.

params.name: params
params.description: Optional advanced params forwarded to AddFusionEffectProcUltimate.

returns.description: The created Fusion effect.

summary_en: Creates the configurable Fusion Summon activation effect described by params.

Missing material locations, material filters, material operations, Special Summon nocheck, and category fields are filled with the MDPro3 defaults. Unless params.reg is false, the effect is registered to c as an activation effect.

The generated effect checks Fusion Monsters in the Extra Deck, gathers and filters Fusion Materials, supports Chain Material fallback, selects materials, moves them with the configured operations, Special Summons with SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION, and completes the procedure.
summary_zh: 创建由params描述的可配置融合召唤发动效果。
缺省的素材位置、素材筛选、素材操作、特殊召唤nocheck和Category字段会填入MDPro3默认值。除非params.reg为false，否则该效果会作为发动效果登记给c。
生成的效果会检查额外卡组中的融合怪兽、取得并过滤融合素材、支持Chain Material后备流程、选择素材、按配置操作移动素材、以SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION特殊召唤，并完成正规手续。

summary_en: Registers a Fusion Summon procedure on c requiring materials with card codes code1 and code2.
The helper forwards sub and insf unchanged to Auxiliary.AddFusionProcMix.
summary_zh: 给c登记需要卡号为code1和code2的素材的融合召唤手续。
该辅助函数会把sub和insf原样转交给Auxiliary.AddFusionProcMix。
core_summary_en: Registers a two-code Fusion Material procedure.
core_summary_zh: 登记双卡号融合素材手续。

summary_en: Registers a Fusion Material procedure requiring code1, code2, and between minc and maxc additional materials that satisfy f.
summary_zh: 登记融合素材手续，要求code1、code2，以及minc到maxc张满足f的额外素材。

summary_en: Registers a Fusion Material procedure requiring monsters with code1, code2, and code3 as fixed materials.
summary_zh: 登记需要卡号code1、code2、code3的怪兽作为固定融合素材的融合素材手续。
core_summary_en: Registers a three-code Fusion procedure.

summary_en: Registers a fixed four-name Fusion procedure requiring code1, code2, code3, and code4 as materials.
summary_zh: 登记固定四个卡名的融合手续，要求code1、code2、code3、code4作为素材。
core_summary_en: Registers four-code Fusion materials.

summary_en: Registers a Fusion Summon procedure on c requiring code1 and cc additional Fusion Materials matching f.
The helper builds cc copies of f and forwards them to Auxiliary.AddFusionProcMix together with sub and insf.
summary_zh: 给c登记需要code1以及cc个满足f的额外融合素材的融合召唤手续。
该辅助函数会构造cc份f，并连同sub和insf转交给Auxiliary.AddFusionProcMix。
core_summary_en: Registers a code-plus-filter Fusion Material procedure.
core_summary_zh: 登记卡号加筛选条件的融合素材手续。

summary_en: Registers a Fusion procedure requiring code1 plus between minc and maxc materials that satisfy f.
summary_zh: 登记融合手续，要求code1以及minc到maxc只满足f的素材。
core_summary_en: Registers code plus repeated-filter Fusion materials.
core_summary_zh: 登记卡号加重复筛选融合素材。

summary_en: Registers a fixed-count Fusion Material procedure requiring cc monsters with card code code1.
summary_zh: 登记固定数量融合素材手续，要求cc只卡号为code1的怪兽。
core_summary_en: Registers repeated-code Fusion materials.
core_summary_zh: 登记重复卡号融合素材。

summary_en: Registers a Fusion Material procedure requiring between minc and maxc copies of code1, with optional substitute and Instant Fusion handling.
summary_zh: 登记融合素材手续，要求minc到maxc张code1，并带有可选代用素材和Instant Fusion处理。

summary_en: Registers a Fusion Summon procedure on c that requires one material satisfying f1 and one material satisfying f2.
summary_zh: 给c登记需要1个满足f1和1个满足f2的素材的融合召唤手续。
core_summary_en: Registers a two-filter Fusion Material procedure.
core_summary_zh: 登记双筛选条件的融合素材手续。

summary_en: Registers a Fusion procedure requiring one material satisfying f1 and cc materials satisfying f2.
summary_zh: 登记融合手续，要求1只满足f1的素材以及cc只满足f2的素材。
core_summary_en: Registers one filter plus fixed repeated-filter Fusion materials.
core_summary_zh: 登记一个筛选加固定重复筛选融合素材。

summary_en: Registers a Fusion procedure requiring f1 plus between minc and maxc materials that satisfy f2.
summary_zh: 登记融合手续，要求1只满足f1的素材以及minc到maxc只满足f2的素材。
core_summary_en: Registers one filter plus repeated-filter Fusion materials.
core_summary_zh: 登记一个筛选加重复筛选融合素材。

summary_en: Registers a Fusion Summon procedure on c that requires cc materials satisfying the same material filter f.
summary_zh: 给c登记需要cc个满足同一素材筛选函数f的素材的融合召唤手续。
core_summary_en: Registers a repeated-filter Fusion Material procedure.
core_summary_zh: 登记重复筛选条件的融合素材手续。

summary_en: Registers a Fusion procedure requiring between minc and maxc materials that satisfy f.
summary_zh: 登记融合手续，要求minc到maxc只满足f的素材。
core_summary_en: Registers repeated-filter Fusion materials.
core_summary_zh: 登记重复筛选融合素材。

summary_en: Registers a fixed-count mixed Fusion Material procedure on fcard.
Each extra argument is a required material slot and may be a card code, filter function, or table of alternatives. Numeric material slots update listed-material metadata.
summary_zh: 给fcard登记固定数量的混合融合素材手续。
每个额外参数都是一个必需素材槽，可以是卡号、筛选函数或替代项table。数字素材槽会更新列名素材元数据。
core_summary_en: Registers mixed fixed-count Fusion materials.
core_summary_zh: 登记固定数量混合融合素材。

summary_en: Registers a mixed Fusion Material procedure with one repeated slot and any number of fixed slots.

fun1 is the repeated material requirement used minc to maxc times; additional arguments are fixed requirements. Each requirement may be a card code, filter function, or table of card codes and filters.
summary_zh: 登记混合融合素材手续，包含一个重复素材槽和任意数量的固定素材槽。
fun1是重复使用minc到maxc次的素材要求；后续参数是固定要求。每个要求可以是卡号、筛选函数，或由卡号和筛选函数组成的表。

summary_en: Registers the Shaddoll Fusion Material procedure requiring one Shaddoll material and one material with attr as Fusion Attribute.
summary_zh: 登记影依融合素材手续，要求1只影依素材以及1只把attr作为融合素材属性的素材。
core_summary_en: Registers Shaddoll Fusion materials.

summary_en: Registers the standard Link Summon procedure for c and returns the created Effect.
f filters each Link Material, min/max constrain the number of selected material cards, and gf optionally checks the selected group as a whole.

The helper creates an Extra Deck EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC with SUMMON_TYPE_LINK, uses Auxiliary.GetLinkCount to match the Link Rating, records materials with Card.SetMaterial, and sends them to the GY with REASON_MATERIAL+REASON_LINK.
summary_zh: 为c登记标准连接召唤手续，并返回创建的Effect。
f筛选每张连接素材，min/max限制选择的素材卡数量，gf可额外检查被选择的整组素材。
该辅助函数会建立额外卡组中的EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC并设为SUMMON_TYPE_LINK，使用Auxiliary.GetLinkCount匹配连接值，用Card.SetMaterial记录素材，并以REASON_MATERIAL+REASON_LINK送去墓地。
core_summary_en: Registers a standard Link Summon procedure.
core_summary_zh: 登记标准连接召唤手续。

params.name: c
params.description: Link Monster receiving the procedure.
params.description_zh: 要登记手续的连接怪兽。

params.name: f
params.description: Optional per-material filter. nil means no extra filter beyond normal Link Material legality.
params.description_zh: 可选的逐素材筛选函数。nil表示除通常连接素材合法性外没有额外筛选。

params.name: min
params.description: Minimum number of material cards that must be selected.
params.description_zh: 必须选择的素材卡数量下限。

params.name: max
params.description: Maximum number of material cards. Defaults to c:GetLink() when omitted.
params.description_zh: 素材卡数量上限。省略时默认为c:GetLink()。

params.name: gf
params.description: Optional whole-group validator called as gf(selected_group, link_monster, player).
params.description_zh: 可选的整组素材检查函数，以gf(被选择的Group, 连接怪兽, 玩家)调用。

returns.description: The registered Special Summon procedure effect.
returns.description_zh: 已登记的特殊召唤手续Effect。

summary_en: Registers one or more material card codes for c and also adds each code to c's listed-code table.
Fusion Monsters normally do not need this helper.
summary_zh: 为c登记1个或多个素材卡名编号，并同时把这些编号加入c的列名编号表。
融合怪兽通常不需要使用此辅助函数。

summary_en: Creates a Ritual Summon activation effect whose selected materials' Ritual Levels must exactly equal the Ritual Monster's original Level.
summary_zh: 创建仪式召唤发动效果，所选素材的仪式等级合计必须正好等于仪式怪兽的原本等级。

summary_en: Registers an exact-Level Ritual Summon procedure using Card.GetLevel and returns the created Effect.
summary_zh: 使用Card.GetLevel登记等级正好相等的仪式召唤手续，并返回创建的Effect。
core_summary_en: Registers an exact-Level Ritual procedure.
core_summary_zh: 登记等级正好相等的仪式手续。

summary_en: Adds code1 to c's listed codes, then creates an equal-Level Ritual Summon procedure using the Ritual Monster's current Level.
summary_zh: 把code1加入c的列名卡号，然后使用仪式怪兽当前等级创建等等级仪式召唤手续。

summary_en: Adds code1 and code2 to c's listed codes, then creates an equal-Level Ritual Summon procedure for Ritual Monsters with either code.
summary_zh: 把code1和code2加入c的列名卡号，然后为卡号为其中之一的仪式怪兽创建等等级仪式召唤手续。

summary_en: Creates a Ritual Summon activation effect for Ritual Monster code1.

The selected materials' Ritual Levels must exactly equal the Ritual Monster's original Level, and optional Graveyard material, material filter, and extra callbacks are forwarded to the shared Ritual procedure.
summary_zh: 为卡号code1的仪式怪兽创建仪式召唤发动效果。
所选素材的仪式等级合计必须等于该仪式怪兽的原本等级；可选的墓地素材筛选、素材筛选和额外回调会传给共用仪式手续。
core_summary_en: Creates equal-Level Ritual procedure for a card code.
core_summary_zh: 创建指定卡号的等等级仪式手续。

params.name: summon_location
params.description: default: LOCATION_HAND

returns.description: Created Ritual Summon activation effect.

summary_en: Creates a Ritual Summon activation effect whose selected materials' Ritual Levels must be greater than or equal to the Ritual Monster's original Level.
summary_zh: 创建仪式召唤发动效果，所选素材的仪式等级合计必须大于等于仪式怪兽的原本等级。

summary_en: Adds a Ritual Summon effect for c that uses the Ritual Monster's current Level and requires materials whose total Level is greater than or equal to it.
summary_zh: 为c添加仪式召唤效果，使用仪式怪兽的当前等级，并要求素材等级合计大于等于该等级。
core_summary_en: Adds a greater-or-equal Ritual procedure using the Ritual Monster's current Level.

returns.description: The created Ritual Summon effect.

summary_en: Registers code1 as listed by c, then adds the Greater2 Ritual procedure restricted to Ritual Monsters with that code.
summary_zh: 把code1登记为c列名的编号，然后添加只适用于该编号仪式怪兽的Greater2仪式手续。
core_summary_en: Adds a greater-or-equal Ritual procedure restricted by one listed code.

returns.description: The created Ritual Summon effect.

summary_en: Registers code1 and code2 as listed by c, then adds the Greater2 Ritual procedure restricted to Ritual Monsters with either code.
summary_zh: 把code1和code2登记为c列名的编号，然后添加只适用于任一编号仪式怪兽的Greater2仪式手续。
core_summary_en: Adds a greater-or-equal Ritual procedure restricted by two listed codes.

returns.description: The created Ritual Summon effect.

summary_en: Registers a Ritual Summon procedure for Ritual Monster code1, allowing material Ritual Levels to meet or exceed the Ritual Monster's original Level.
The helper also adds code1 to c's code/material list and returns the created procedure effect.
summary_zh: 为仪式怪兽code1登记仪式召唤手续，允许素材仪式等级合计大于等于仪式怪兽原本等级。
该辅助函数还会把code1加入c的卡号/素材列表，并返回创建的手续效果。
core_summary_en: Adds a Greater Ritual procedure by code.

params.name: summon_location
params.description: default: LOCATION_HAND

summary_en: Creates the configurable Ritual Summon activation effect for c and returns it.

The generated effect checks for a Ritual Monster, gathers Ritual Materials, validates an equal or greater-or-equal material total, releases Ritual Materials, Special Summons with SUMMON_TYPE_RITUAL, and completes the procedure.
Use wrapper helpers for ordinary Ritual Spells, and call this directly when a script needs Graveyard material, a material filter, delayed registration, or extra target/operation callbacks.
summary_zh: 为c创建可配置的仪式召唤发动效果并返回它。
生成的效果会检查仪式怪兽、取得仪式素材、确认素材等级合计正好相等或大于等于需求、解放仪式素材、以SUMMON_TYPE_RITUAL特殊召唤，并完成正规手续。
普通仪式魔法通常使用包装辅助函数；需要墓地素材、素材过滤、不立即登记或额外目标/操作回调时，可直接调用此函数。
core_summary_en: Creates a configurable Ritual Summon activation effect.

params.name: filter
params.description: Ritual Monster filter. It receives the candidate Ritual Monster plus the helper's extra arguments and should return true for monsters this effect can Summon.

params.name: level_function
params.description: Function used to get the required value from the Ritual Monster, commonly Card.GetOriginalLevel or Card.GetLevel.

params.name: greater_or_equal
params.description: Use "Greater" for equal-or-higher material totals or "Equal" for exact totals.

params.name: summon_location
params.description: Location to search for the Ritual Monster. Defaults to LOCATION_HAND.

params.name: grave_filter
params.description: Optional filter for extra Graveyard materials that the helper may merge into the material pool.

params.name: mat_filter
params.description: Optional filter applied to candidate Ritual Materials before the material subgroup is selected.

params.name: pause
params.description: If true, returns the effect without registering it to c.

params.name: extra_operation
params.description: Optional callback run after the Ritual Summon operation. Local wrappers pass the Summoned monster and selected material group to this callback.

params.name: extra_target
params.description: Optional callback run during the target branch for extra operation info or activation checks.

returns.description: The created Ritual Summon activation effect. If pause is false or nil, the helper also registers it to c.

summary_en: Registers set codes of monsters listed by c, so Auxiliary.IsSetNameMonsterListed can check them later. Skipped while c is copying an effect.
summary_zh: 为c登记其文本中列名的怪兽系列编号，供Auxiliary.IsSetNameMonsterListed等函数之后判断。复制效果时不处理。

summary_en: Registers a mixed Synchro Summon procedure requiring up to three fixed material filters plus f4 repeated between minc and maxc times.

The helper creates an Extra Deck EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC with SUMMON_TYPE_SYNCHRO, checks the exact Synchro Level total, and handles mandatory material, hand Synchro, tuner-limit, and optional group-check rules.
The maximum count is capped by c's Level after subtracting any required fixed materials.
summary_zh: 登记混合同调召唤手续：最多3个固定素材筛选条件，加上f4重复minc到maxc次。
该辅助函数会建立位于额外卡组的EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC，并使用SUMMON_TYPE_SYNCHRO；它会检查同调等级合计，并处理必须使用素材、手卡同调、调整限制以及可选的素材组检查。
最大数量会按c的等级扣除必要固定素材后进行上限限制。
core_summary_en: Adds a mixed Synchro procedure.

summary_en: Registers the standard Synchro Summon procedure for c.
f1 filters the Tuner material, f2 filters non-Tuner materials, and minc/maxc set the number of non-Tuner materials required.

The created procedure lives in the Extra Deck, checks materials through the core Synchro helpers, stores the selected group for the operation, and sends materials to the GY with REASON_MATERIAL+REASON_SYNCHRO.
summary_zh: 为c登记标准同调召唤手续。
f1筛选调整素材，f2筛选非调整素材，minc/maxc设置需要的非调整素材数量。
建立的手续在额外卡组生效，通过核心同调辅助函数检查素材，在操作处理中读取已选择的素材组，并以REASON_MATERIAL+REASON_SYNCHRO送去GY。
core_summary_en: Registers the standard Synchro Summon procedure on c.
core_summary_zh: 为c登记标准同调召唤手续。

params.name: c
params.description: Synchro Monster that receives the procedure.

params.name: f1
params.description: Optional Tuner filter. nil accepts any legal Tuner.

params.name: f2
params.description: Optional non-Tuner filter, commonly built with Auxiliary.NonTuner.

params.name: minc
params.description: Minimum number of non-Tuner materials.

params.name: maxc
params.description: Maximum number of non-Tuner materials. If omitted, the helper caps it by c's Level minus 1.

summary_en: Backward-compatible helper for a Synchro Monster that uses exactly 1 Tuner and 1 non-Tuner material.
It calls Auxiliary.AddSynchroProcedure(c, f1, f2, 1, 1).
summary_zh: 为c登记旧式同调召唤手续，要求1只调整和1只非调整怪兽作为素材。
等价于Auxiliary.AddSynchroProcedure(c, f1, f2, 1, 1)。
core_summary_en: Registers the backward-compatible one-Tuner, one-non-Tuner Synchro Summon procedure on c.

summary_en: Registers a continuous effect on c that records the effect that sent c to the Graveyard.
This lets later Graveyard-condition checks distinguish a card that was already in the Graveyard from one sent there by the currently resolving effect.
summary_zh: 为c登记一个持续效果，用于记录把c送去墓地的效果。
这样后续的墓地条件可以区分此卡原本就在墓地，还是被当前正在处理的效果送去墓地。

summary_en: Adds the shared Ursarctic hand Quick Effect that Special Summons c during the Main Phase.
The cost releases a Level 7 or higher monster from the hand, or banishes a valid replacement card from the Graveyard.
summary_zh: 为c添加「北极天熊」共通的手牌快速效果，在主要阶段特殊召唤自身。
费用为解放手牌中1只7星以上怪兽，或从墓地除外可代替费用的对应卡。

summary_en: Registers the standard Xyz Summon procedure for c.
f filters materials, lv is the required material Xyz Level, ct is the minimum material count, and maxct optionally caps the maximum.

The helper creates an Extra Deck EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC with SUMMON_TYPE_XYZ, checks and selects materials with the core Xyz helpers, records them with Card.SetMaterial, and overlays them with Duel.Overlay.
alterf, alterdesc, and alterop define an optional one-card alternate Xyz Summon route.
summary_zh: 给c登记标准超量召唤手续。
f筛选素材，lv是要求的素材超量等级，ct是素材下限，maxct可限制素材上限。
该辅助函数会建立额外卡组中的EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC并设为SUMMON_TYPE_XYZ，使用核心超量素材辅助函数检查和选择素材，用Card.SetMaterial记录素材，并用Duel.Overlay叠放为超量素材。
alterf、alterdesc和alterop用于定义可选的单卡替代超量召唤路线。

params.name: c
params.description: Xyz Monster receiving the procedure.
params.description_zh: 要登记手续的超量怪兽。

params.name: f
params.description: Optional per-material filter. nil means no extra material restriction beyond the normal Xyz checks.
params.description_zh: 可选的单张素材筛选函数。nil表示除通常超量检查外没有额外素材限制。

params.name: lv
params.description: Required material Xyz Level.
params.description_zh: 要求的素材超量等级。

params.name: ct
params.description: Minimum material count.
params.description_zh: 素材数量下限。

params.name: alterf
params.description: Optional filter for a one-card alternate Xyz Summon route.
params.description_zh: 可选的单卡替代超量召唤路线筛选函数。

params.name: alterdesc
params.description: Prompt text id used when the alternate route can be chosen.
params.description_zh: 可以选择替代路线时显示的提示文本id。

params.name: maxct
params.description: Maximum material count. Defaults to ct when omitted.
params.description_zh: 素材数量上限。省略时默认为ct。

params.name: alterop
params.description: Optional check/apply callback for the alternate route. The local helper calls it with chk==0 for legality and chk==1 after selection.
params.description_zh: 可选的替代路线检查/应用回调。本地辅助函数在合法性检查时以chk==0调用，选择后以chk==1调用。

summary_en: Registers a Level-free Xyz Summon procedure on c.
f filters each candidate material, while gf can validate the selected group as a whole, such as requiring all materials to have the same Rank.
The local helper still checks Card.IsCanBeXyzMaterial, zone availability, and EFFECT_XYZ_MIN_COUNT, but procedure.lua notes that EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL is not supported in this path.
summary_zh: 给c登记不检查等级的超量召唤手续。
f筛选每张候选素材，gf可以检查被选择的整组素材，例如要求所有素材具有相同阶级。
本地辅助函数仍会检查Card.IsCanBeXyzMaterial、区域可用性和EFFECT_XYZ_MIN_COUNT，但procedure.lua注明此路线不支持EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL。
core_summary_en: Registers a Level-free Xyz procedure.
core_summary_zh: 登记不检查等级的超量手续。

params.name: c
params.description: Xyz Monster receiving the Level-free procedure.
params.description_zh: 要登记不检查等级手续的超量怪兽。

params.name: f
params.description: Optional per-material filter.
params.description_zh: 可选的单张素材筛选函数。

params.name: gf
params.description: Optional whole-group validator called on the selected material group.
params.description_zh: 可选的整组素材检查函数，会对选择后的素材Group调用。

params.name: minc
params.description: Minimum material count.
params.description_zh: 素材数量下限。

params.name: maxc
params.description: Maximum material count.
params.description_zh: 素材数量上限。

params.name: alterf
params.description: Optional filter for a one-card alternate Xyz Summon route.
params.description_zh: 可选的单卡替代超量召唤路线筛选函数。

params.name: alterdesc
params.description: Prompt text id used when the alternate route can be chosen.
params.description_zh: 可以选择替代路线时显示的提示文本id。

params.name: alterop
params.description: Optional check/apply callback for the alternate route.
params.description_zh: 可选的替代路线检查/应用回调。

summary_en: Returns whether c's global field coordinate is directly adjacent to (i, j), sharing an edge rather than a diagonal.
summary_zh: 检查c的全局场地坐标是否与(i, j)直接相邻；只计算上下左右，不计算斜向。

summary_en: Performs the shared Arcana Force coin-toss operation.
It tosses a coin, or lets the player choose the result while affected by the relevant replacement effect, then stores the result on c with client hints.
summary_zh: 处理「秘仪之力」共通的投掷硬币操作。
通常投掷1次硬币；若受对应替代效果影响，则让玩家选择结果，然后把结果以标记和客户端提示记录在c上。

summary_en: Declares that the shared Arcana Force effect will perform one coin toss for tp.
summary_zh: 声明「秘仪之力」共通效果会为tp进行1次投掷硬币。

summary_en: Arcana Force condition helper that checks whether the handler has a stored Arcana coin-result flag.
summary_zh: 「秘仪之力」条件辅助函数，检查处理对象是否保存有秘仪硬币结果标志。
core_summary_en: Checks Arcana coin flag.

summary_en: Special Summon restriction value for /Assault Mode monsters; allows the Assault Mode summon value or effects activated by Assault Mode Activate.
summary_zh: 「/爆裂体」怪兽的特殊召唤限制Value函数；允许/爆裂体召唤值，或由「爆裂模式」发动的效果。
core_summary_en: Special Summon restriction value for /Assault Mode monsters.

returns.description: true if the Summon matches /Assault Mode conditions.

summary_en: Returns true for a non-Link Monster whose ATK equals DEF, using current values on the field or known printed values elsewhere.
summary_zh: 判断c是否为攻击力和守备力相同的非连接怪兽；在场上使用当前数值，其他位置要求原本数值可确认。

summary_en: Condition for the shared B.E.S. maintenance effect after battle; returns true if the handler is still related to that battle.
summary_zh: B.E.S.共通战斗后维持效果的条件；处理对象仍与该次战斗关联时返回true。

summary_en: Resolves the shared B.E.S. maintenance effect by removing one 0x1f counter from the handler, or destroying it if no counter can be removed.
summary_zh: 处理B.E.S.共通战斗后维持效果：能取除1个0x1f指示物则取除，否则破坏自身。

summary_en: Sets destruction operation info for the shared B.E.S. maintenance effect when the handler cannot remove one 0x1f counter.
summary_zh: B.E.S.共通战斗后维持效果的目标处理；若不能取除1个0x1f指示物，则登记破坏自身的信息。

summary_en: Default condition for banish-redirect effects; returns true while the handler is face-up.
summary_zh: 除外重定向效果的默认条件；处理对象表侧表示时返回true。

summary_en: Registers an EFFECT_CHANGE_CODE effect on c so its code becomes tc's original rule code until reset; reset defaults to standard event reset through the End Phase.
summary_zh: 给c登记EFFECT_CHANGE_CODE效果，使其卡号变为tc按规则使用的原本卡号直到reset；reset默认持续到结束阶段并使用标准事件重置。

summary_en: Sets up puzzle-duel handling by skipping player 0's Draw and Standby Phases and making player 0 lose at the End Phase.
summary_zh: 设置解谜决斗处理：跳过玩家0的抽卡阶段和准备阶段，并在结束阶段让玩家0失败。

summary_en: Returns a value function for EFFECT_CHANGE_BATTLE_DAMAGE. player=0 changes damage taken by the effect owner, player=1 changes damage taken by the opponent; otherwise it returns -1 to keep the damage unchanged.
summary_zh: 返回用于EFFECT_CHANGE_BATTLE_DAMAGE的Value函数。player=0时改写效果持有者受到的战斗伤害，player=1时改写对方受到的战斗伤害；其他情况返回-1表示不改写。

summary_en: Internal recursive helper for Group.CheckSubGroup. It tries adding c to sg, respects Auxiliary.GCheckAdditional, and searches for a subgroup between min and max that satisfies f.
summary_zh: Group.CheckSubGroup使用的内部递归辅助函数；尝试把c加入sg，遵守Auxiliary.GCheckAdditional，并寻找数量在min到max之间且满足f的子组。

summary_en: Internal recursive helper for Group.SelectSubGroup. It searches like Auxiliary.CheckGroupRecursive and stores one valid subgroup in Auxiliary.SubGroupCaptured.
summary_zh: Group.SelectSubGroup使用的内部递归辅助函数；按Auxiliary.CheckGroupRecursive的方式搜索，并把找到的一个有效子组保存到Auxiliary.SubGroupCaptured。

summary_en: Internal recursive helper for Group.CheckSubGroupEach and Group.SelectSubGroupEach. Each selected card must satisfy the filter at the matching position in checks before the final group is tested by f.
summary_zh: Group.CheckSubGroupEach和Group.SelectSubGroupEach使用的内部递归辅助函数；每张被选卡必须满足checks中对应位置的筛选函数，最终组再交给f检查。

summary_en: Checks Union equip count compatibility between Union Monster uc and target tc, optionally ignoring some modern Union count.
summary_zh: 检查同盟怪兽uc与对象tc之间的同盟装备数量兼容性，可选择忽略部分新式同盟数量。
core_summary_en: Checks Union equip-count limits.
core_summary_zh: 检查同盟装备数量限制。

summary_en: Checks whether c can be Xyz Summoned using materials from mg while allowing valid EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL cards to count as two materials.
summary_zh: 检查c是否可以用mg中的素材进行超量召唤，并允许有效的EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL卡按2个素材计数。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c can be Xyz Summoned while counting valid double materials.

returns.description: true if c can be Xyz Summoned with double-material support.

summary_en: Returns the condition function for Contact Fusion procedures. It collects valid materials from the configured locations and checks c's Fusion Material requirement.
summary_zh: 返回接触融合手续的条件函数；从指定位置收集有效素材，并检查c的融合素材要求。
core_summary_en: Returns the condition function for Contact Fusion procedures.

returns.description: Condition function for a Contact Fusion procedure.

summary_en: Material filter for Contact Fusion procedures. The card must be usable as Fusion Material for fc and must satisfy filter when one is provided.
summary_zh: 接触融合手续的素材筛选；该卡必须能作为fc的融合素材，且提供filter时也必须满足filter。
core_summary_en: Material filter for Contact Fusion procedures.

returns.description: true if c is valid Contact Fusion material for fc.

summary_en: Returns the operation function for Contact Fusion procedures. It sets the selected materials on the Fusion Monster, runs mat_operation, and deletes the kept-alive group.
summary_zh: 返回接触融合手续的操作函数；把已选择素材设置给融合怪兽，执行mat_operation，并删除保留的Group。
core_summary_en: Returns the operation function for Contact Fusion procedures.

returns.description: Operation function for a Contact Fusion procedure.

summary_en: Returns a Contact Fusion material operation that reveals face-down materials when needed, hints Graveyard/banished materials, and shuffles all materials into the Deck as cost.
summary_zh: 返回接触融合素材操作函数；必要时公开里侧素材，提示墓地/除外素材，并把全部素材作为费用洗回卡组。
core_summary_en: Returns a Contact Fusion material operation that sends materials to the Deck.

returns.description: Material operation that shuffles materials into the Deck.

summary_en: Returns the target function for Contact Fusion procedures. It selects Fusion Materials, keeps the selected group alive, stores it on the effect, and returns whether selection succeeded.
summary_zh: 返回接触融合手续的目标函数；选择融合素材，保留选择的Group并保存到效果上，返回是否选择成功。
core_summary_en: Returns the target function for Contact Fusion procedures.

returns.description: Target function for a Contact Fusion procedure.

summary_en: Returns a table of one-card check functions where each function calls f(c, list[i]).
summary_zh: 返回一组单卡检查函数；每个函数调用f(c, list[i])。
core_summary_en: Creates check functions from a list.

summary_en: Registers an EVENT_BE_MATERIAL continuous effect on c so that, when c is used as material, the Summoned monster creates an effect relation with te.
summary_zh: 为c登记EVENT_BE_MATERIAL持续效果；当c作为素材使用时，让召唤出的怪兽与te建立效果关联。

summary_en: Special Summon restriction value for Evil HERO/Dark Fusion effects; allows Dark Fusion itself, the Dark Fusion summon value, or Fusion Summons while the player is affected by effect code 72043279.
summary_zh: 「邪心英雄」/「暗黑融合」类效果的特殊召唤限制Value函数；允许「暗黑融合」本身、暗黑融合召唤值，或玩家受编号72043279效果影响时的融合召唤。
core_summary_en: Special Summon restriction value for Evil HERO/Dark Fusion effects.

returns.description: true if the Summon matches Dark Fusion conditions.

summary_en: Target filter for Dimensional Fissure-style replacement effects. It matches cards whose original type includes Monster, excluding Xyz Materials and cards currently treated as Spell/Trap Cards.
summary_zh: 「次元裂缝」类替代效果使用的目标筛选；匹配原本种类包含怪兽的卡，但排除超量素材以及当前作为魔法/陷阱处理的卡。

summary_en: Returns true only for Soul Drain Dragon, used as a Special Summon procedure-type helper.
summary_zh: 仅在c是「魂吸收龙」时返回true，用作特殊召唤手续类型辅助函数。
core_summary_en: Checks Soul Drain Dragon procedure type.
core_summary_zh: 检查魂吸收龙手续类型。

summary_en: Cost filter for the shared Drytron Special Summon effect. It accepts Drytron monsters and Ritual Monsters that can be Tributed from the hand or field while leaving tp an open Monster Zone.
summary_zh: 「龙辉巧」共通特殊召唤效果的费用筛选；匹配可以从手牌或场上解放、且解放后会给tp留下可用怪兽区域的「龙辉巧」怪兽或仪式怪兽。

summary_en: Activity-counter filter for the shared Drytron Special Summon effect. It returns true for cards that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set, so the counter can detect whether tp Special Summoned a monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set this turn.
summary_zh: 「龙辉巧」共通特殊召唤效果的活动计数筛选；对不能通常召唤/盖放的卡返回true，从而让计数器判断tp本回合是否特殊召唤过可以通常召唤/盖放的怪兽。

summary_en: Checks whether c can be banished by tp as a replacement cost through effect code 89771220.
summary_zh: 判断c是否可以由tp通过编号89771220的效果作为代替费用从墓地除外。

summary_en: Checks and pays the shared Drytron self-Summon cost.

The player must not have Special Summoned a monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set this turn. On payment, it applies the matching Special Summon oath, then either Tributes one valid cost card or banishes one valid replacement-cost card.
summary_zh: 检查并支付「龙辉巧」共通的自身特殊召唤费用。
玩家本回合不能已经特殊召唤过可以通常召唤/盖放的怪兽。支付时登记对应的特殊召唤誓约，然后解放1张可用费用卡，或除外1张可用的代替费用卡。

summary_en: Oath target for the shared Drytron cost; it prevents Special Summoning monsters that can be Normal Summoned/Set, excluding cards whose original type is Spell/Trap or Trap Monster.
summary_zh: 「龙辉巧」共通费用登记的誓约目标；阻止特殊召唤可以通常召唤/盖放的怪兽，但排除原本种类为魔法/陷阱或陷阱怪兽的卡。

summary_en: Returns the shared Drytron operation wrapper. It Special Summons the handler in face-up Defense Position, completes its procedure, then calls func(e,tp).
summary_zh: 返回「龙辉巧」共通的操作包装函数；将处理对象守备表示特殊召唤，完成正规手续，然后调用func(e,tp)。

summary_en: Target function for the shared Drytron self-Summon effect. It checks the Monster Zone requirement, confirms the handler can be Special Summoned in face-up Defense Position, and sets Special Summon operation info.
summary_zh: 「龙辉巧」共通自身特殊召唤效果的目标处理；检查怪兽区域需求，确认处理对象能以表侧守备表示特殊召唤，并登记特殊召唤信息。

summary_en: Returns whether c is a Special Summon procedure monster, used by Drytron Special Summon helpers.
summary_zh: 检查c是否是特殊召唤手续怪兽，供「龙辉巧」特殊召唤辅助函数使用。
core_summary_en: Checks Special Summon procedure type.
core_summary_zh: 检查特殊召唤手续类型。

summary_en: Gemini helper condition that returns true when the handler is face-up and not currently in Gemini treated-as-effect state.
summary_zh: 二重辅助条件：处理对象表侧表示且当前不处于二重怪兽视为效果怪兽的状态时返回true。

summary_en: Operation for delayed End Phase destruction effects. It destroys the Card or Group stored as e's label object.
summary_zh: 延迟到结束阶段破坏的操作函数；破坏保存在e的label object中的Card或Group。

summary_en: Returns a predicate that checks whether an Effect has category.
summary_zh: 返回谓词函数，用于判断Effect是否包含category类别。

summary_en: Returns a predicate that checks whether an Effect has property flag.
summary_zh: 返回谓词函数，用于判断Effect是否包含flag属性。

summary_en: Registers Arcana Force-style mandatory coin-toss trigger effects on c for event1 and any extra events.
The shared operation records the coin result as FLAG_ID_ARCANA_COIN; Reversal of Fate replaces the toss with a player choice.
summary_zh: 为c在event1以及额外事件上登记「秘仪之力」式强制投掷硬币触发效果。
共用操作会把硬币结果记录为FLAG_ID_ARCANA_COIN；受「逆转命运」影响时改为由玩家选择结果。
core_summary_en: Enables Arcana Force coin effects.
core_summary_zh: 启用秘仪之力硬币效果。

summary_en: Registers the shared B.E.S. maintenance trigger on c. After c battles, it removes one 0x1f counter if possible; otherwise it destroys c.
summary_zh: 为c登记B.E.S.共通维持触发效果；战斗后能取除1个0x1f指示物则取除，否则破坏c。

summary_en: Registers code as a listed code for c and gives c an EFFECT_CHANGE_CODE effect with that value.
If location is omitted, monsters use the Monster Zone and non-monsters use the Spell & Trap Zone. If condition is omitted, the code change is always active.
summary_zh: 把code登记为c的列名编号，并给c登记取该值的EFFECT_CHANGE_CODE效果。
省略location时，怪兽默认在怪兽区域适用，非怪兽默认在魔法与陷阱区域适用。省略condition时，该卡名变更始终适用。

summary_en: Registers standard Gemini Monster handling on c.
The card can be Normal Summoned again, and while face-up in the Monster Zone or GY and not in Dual State, it is treated as a Normal Monster instead of an Effect Monster.
summary_zh: 为c登记标准二重怪兽处理。
该卡可以再次通常召唤；并且在怪兽区域或墓地表侧表示且不处于二重状态时，当作通常怪兽而不是效果怪兽。
core_summary_en: Registers Gemini Monster handling.

summary_en: Initializes the shared Extra Deck Summon count table with one count for each player and registers a global Draw Phase Start reset. The helper only manages the counter; individual card scripts still check and decrement it.
summary_zh: 初始化共通的额外卡组召唤次数表，双方各为1次，并登记每个抽卡阶段开始时重置的全局效果。此辅助函数只管理计数，具体卡片脚本仍需自行检查并扣除次数。

summary_en: Registers the shared Elemental HERO Neos Fusion End Phase return effects on c. It creates a mandatory return effect and an optional version used while c is affected by effect code 42015635, then returns both effects.
summary_zh: 为c登记「元素英雄 新宇侠」融合怪兽共通的结束阶段返回效果；会创建强制返回效果，以及受编号42015635效果影响时使用的可选版本，并返回这两个效果。

summary_en: Registers the Pendulum Summon procedure for Pendulum Monster c.
Unless reg is false, it also registers the Pendulum Card activation effect from the hand.
summary_zh: 为灵摆怪兽c登记灵摆召唤手续。
除非reg为false，否则也会登记从手牌发动该灵摆卡的效果。
core_summary_en: Registers the standard Pendulum Summon procedure for c.

summary_en: Enables revive-limit handling for c while also allowing it to be Pendulum Summoned from loc.
The helper stores loc on c's metatable and completes c's procedure when it is successfully Pendulum Summoned.
summary_zh: 给c启用苏生限制处理，同时允许其从loc对应位置进行灵摆召唤。
该辅助函数会把loc保存到c的metatable，并在c成功灵摆召唤时完成正规手续。
core_summary_en: Enables revive-limit Pendulum Summon handling.
core_summary_zh: 启用苏生限制灵摆召唤处理。

params.name: loc
params.description: default: 0xff

summary_en: Registers Spirit return setup for c.
When any listed event happens, it creates End Phase return-to-hand effects in the Monster Zone, respecting EFFECT_SPIRIT_DONOT_RETURN and EFFECT_SPIRIT_MAYNOT_RETURN.
summary_zh: 为c登记灵魂怪兽回手设置。
任意列出的事件发生时，会在怪兽区域创建结束阶段回到手牌的效果，并遵守EFFECT_SPIRIT_DONOT_RETURN和EFFECT_SPIRIT_MAYNOT_RETURN。
core_summary_en: Registers Spirit return setup.
core_summary_zh: 登记灵魂怪兽回手设置。

summary_en: Registers the standard modern Union Monster package on c.

The helper adds equipped-card destruction substitution, an EFFECT_UNION_LIMIT using filter, an ignition effect to equip c from the Monster Zone to a valid monster, and an ignition effect to Special Summon c from the Spell & Trap Zone.
summary_zh: 为c登记标准现代同盟怪兽组件。
该辅助函数会添加装备卡破坏代替、使用filter的EFFECT_UNION_LIMIT、从怪兽区域把c装备给合法怪兽的起动效果，以及从魔法与陷阱区域特殊召唤c的起动效果。
core_summary_en: Registers modern Union effects.

summary_en: Returns the shared Equip Spell operation. It equips the handler to the first target if both cards are still related to the effect, the target is face-up, and eqlimit allows it.
summary_zh: 返回共通装备魔法操作函数；若处理对象与第一个目标仍与效果关联、目标表侧表示且eqlimit允许，则把处理对象装备给该目标。

summary_en: Returns the shared Equip Spell target function. is_self and is_opponent choose which Monster Zones can be targeted, filter selects a valid target, and eqlimit is rechecked for chained target changes and resolution.
summary_zh: 返回共通装备魔法目标函数；is_self和is_opponent决定可选择哪一方怪兽区域，filter选择有效目标，eqlimit会在连锁中改选目标和处理时再次检查。

summary_en: Returns e's handler while that card is still related to the current Chain; otherwise returns nil.
summary_zh: 当效果e的处理者仍与当前连锁保持关联时返回该卡；否则返回nil。
core_summary_en: Returns e's handler while it is still related to the current Chain.
core_summary_zh: 在处理者仍与当前连锁关联时返回处理者。

returns.description: e's handler if it is still related to the current Chain; otherwise nil.

summary_en: Resets the shared Extra Deck Summon count table to one count for each player.
summary_zh: 把共通额外卡组召唤次数表重置为双方各1次。

summary_en: Returns true for an opponent's card that has EFFECT_EXTRA_RELEASE_NONSUM available to tp.
summary_zh: 判断c是否为对方控制、且对tp具有EFFECT_EXTRA_RELEASE_NONSUM效果的卡。

summary_en: Returns false.
summary_zh: 返回false。

summary_en: Recursive mixed Fusion Material checker. It tests one required material function at a time, tracks selected materials in sg, and consumes the substitute-material allowance when needed.
summary_zh: 混合融合素材递归检查；按顺序检查每个必需素材函数，把已选素材记录在sg中，并在需要时消耗代替融合素材许可。
core_summary_en: Recursive mixed Fusion Material checker.

returns.description: true if the remaining mixed Fusion Material functions can be satisfied.

summary_en: Final group check for mixed Fusion Materials. It validates mandatory Fusion Materials, Tune Magician restrictions, Extra Monster Zone availability, and additional Fusion goal hooks.
summary_zh: 混合融合素材的最终组检查；验证必须使用的融合素材、EFFECT_TUNE_MAGICIAN_F限制、额外怪兽区域可用性以及额外融合目标检查。
core_summary_en: Final group check for mixed Fusion Materials.

returns.description: true if sg is a valid mixed Fusion Material group.

summary_en: Checks a selected mixed-repeat Fusion Material group. The repeated material function must cover the variable-count materials, while each remaining function is satisfied once.
summary_zh: 检查已选择的重复混合融合素材组；可重复素材函数负责可变数量素材，其余每个素材函数各满足1次。
core_summary_en: Checks a selected mixed-repeat Fusion Material group.

returns.description: true if the mixed-repeat material requirements can be satisfied.

summary_en: Recursive helper for Auxiliary.FCheckMixRep. It temporarily assigns c to one remaining fixed material function and continues checking the rest.
summary_zh: Auxiliary.FCheckMixRep使用的递归辅助函数；临时把c分配给剩余的一个固定素材函数，并继续检查其余要求。
core_summary_en: Recursive helper for Auxiliary.FCheckMixRep.

returns.description: true if c can satisfy this fixed material slot and the rest can be completed.

summary_en: Final goal check for mixed-repeat Fusion Materials. It validates selected count limits, Extra Monster Zone availability, additional Fusion hooks, and fixed/repeated material requirements.
summary_zh: 重复混合融合素材的最终目标检查；验证已选数量限制、额外怪兽区域可用性、额外融合检查以及固定/重复素材要求。
core_summary_en: Final goal check for mixed-repeat Fusion Materials.

returns.description: true if sg is a valid mixed-repeat Fusion Material group.

summary_en: Shared precheck for mixed-repeat Fusion Material goals. It rejects invalid Tune Magician combinations, missing mandatory Fusion Materials, and failed goal hooks.
summary_zh: 重复混合融合素材目标的共通预检查；排除无效的EFFECT_TUNE_MAGICIAN_F组合、缺少必须融合素材以及额外目标检查失败的情况。
core_summary_en: Shared precheck for mixed-repeat Fusion Material goals.

returns.description: true if shared mixed-repeat goal prechecks pass.

summary_en: Selection-recursion helper for mixed-repeat Fusion Materials; it delegates to Auxiliary.FCheckMixRepTemplate using the selected-material condition.
summary_zh: 重复混合融合素材选择递归辅助函数；使用已选择素材条件转交Auxiliary.FCheckMixRepTemplate处理。
core_summary_en: Selection-recursion helper for mixed-repeat Fusion Materials.

returns.description: true if the selected-material recursion can succeed.

summary_en: Checks whether the recursive mixed-repeat selection can continue from the currently selected group, or can finish through Auxiliary.FCheckSelectMixRep.
summary_zh: 判断当前重复混合融合素材选择是否可以继续递归，或是否可以通过Auxiliary.FCheckSelectMixRep完成。
core_summary_en: Checks recursive mixed-repeat selection state.

returns.description: true if the current mixed-repeat selection can continue or finish.

summary_en: Generic recursive template for mixed-repeat Fusion Material checks. It tries assigning c to each fixed material function or to the repeated material slot.
summary_zh: 重复混合融合素材检查的通用递归模板；尝试把c分配给每个固定素材函数，或分配给可重复素材位置。
core_summary_en: Generic recursive template for mixed-repeat Fusion Material checks.

returns.description: true if c can be assigned to a fixed or repeated material slot.

summary_en: Checks whether a mixed-repeat Fusion Material selection can be completed from the current chosen group.
summary_zh: 检查当前重复混合融合素材选择是否可以从已选Group继续完成。
core_summary_en: Checks whether a mixed-repeat Fusion Material selection can be completed.

returns.description: true if the current selection can be completed.

summary_en: Recursive helper for mixed-repeat Fusion selection when field-space constraints are already satisfied or not required.
summary_zh: 重复混合融合选择使用的递归辅助函数；用于场地空间限制已经满足或不需要检查的情况。
core_summary_en: Recursive helper for mixed-repeat Fusion selection without extra Monster Zone filtering.

returns.description: true if the selection can be completed through c.

summary_en: Recursive helper for mixed-repeat Fusion selection that requires the next candidate to be controlled by tp in the Monster Zone.
summary_zh: 重复混合融合选择使用的递归辅助函数；要求下一个候选素材由tp控制且位于怪兽区域。
core_summary_en: Recursive helper for mixed-repeat Fusion selection requiring a Monster Zone candidate.

returns.description: true if c is a valid Monster Zone candidate and the selection can be completed.

summary_en: Material filter used by mixed Fusion procedures. It checks whether c can be used as Fusion Material for fc and satisfies at least one required material function.
summary_zh: 混合融合手续使用的素材筛选；检查c是否可以作为fc的融合素材，并满足至少1个必需素材函数。
core_summary_en: Material filter used by mixed Fusion procedures.

returns.description: true if c is valid material and satisfies any required material function.

summary_en: Returns the condition function for fixed mixed Fusion Material procedures.
summary_zh: 返回固定混合融合素材手续的条件函数。
core_summary_en: Returns the condition function for fixed mixed Fusion Material procedures.

returns.description: Condition function for a fixed mixed Fusion Material procedure.

summary_en: Returns the condition function for mixed Fusion Material procedures with a repeated material slot.
summary_zh: 返回带可重复素材位置的混合融合素材手续的条件函数。
core_summary_en: Returns the condition function for mixed Fusion Material procedures with a repeated material slot.

returns.description: Condition function for a mixed-repeat Fusion Material procedure.

summary_en: Default Fusion Material filter for Fusion effects; returns whether c can be used as Fusion Material.
summary_zh: 融合效果的默认融合素材筛选；判断c是否可以作为融合素材。
core_summary_en: Default Fusion Material filter for Fusion effects.

returns.description: true if c can be used as Fusion Material.

summary_en: Default operation for banishing Fusion Materials with Fusion reason flags.
summary_zh: 把融合素材以融合相关原因标记除外的默认操作。
core_summary_en: Default operation for banishing Fusion Materials.

summary_en: Default Graveyard-material filter for Fusion effects that banish materials; returns whether c can be banished.
summary_zh: 会除外素材的融合效果使用的默认墓地素材筛选；判断c是否可以除外。
core_summary_en: Default Graveyard-material filter for Fusion effects that banish materials.

returns.description: true if c can be banished.

summary_en: Default operation for returning Fusion Materials to the Deck with Fusion reason flags.
summary_zh: 把融合素材以融合相关原因标记回到卡组的默认操作。
core_summary_en: Default operation for returning Fusion Materials to the Deck.

summary_en: Default operation for sending Fusion Materials to the Graveyard with Fusion reason flags.
summary_zh: 把融合素材以融合相关原因标记送去墓地的默认操作。
core_summary_en: Default operation for sending Fusion Materials to the Graveyard.

summary_en: Default Fusion Material filter for effects that send materials to the Graveyard; returns whether c can be sent to the Graveyard.
summary_zh: 会把素材送去墓地的融合效果使用的默认素材筛选；判断c是否可以送去墓地。
core_summary_en: Default Fusion Material filter for effects that send materials to the Graveyard.

returns.description: true if c can be sent to the Graveyard.

summary_en: Returns the operation function for fixed mixed Fusion Material procedures; it selects valid materials and stores them with Duel.SetFusionMaterial.
summary_zh: 返回固定混合融合素材手续的操作函数；选择有效融合素材并通过Duel.SetFusionMaterial保存。
core_summary_en: Returns the operation function for fixed mixed Fusion Material procedures.

returns.description: Operation function for a fixed mixed Fusion Material procedure.

summary_en: Returns the operation function for mixed Fusion Material procedures with a repeated material slot; it lets the player build a valid material group and stores it.
summary_zh: 返回带可重复素材位置的混合融合素材手续的操作函数；让玩家构建有效素材组并保存。
core_summary_en: Returns the operation function for mixed Fusion Material procedures with a repeated material slot.

returns.description: Operation function for a mixed-repeat Fusion Material procedure.

summary_en: Candidate test for mixed-repeat Fusion selection. It temporarily adds c to sg and returns whether the selection is already valid or can still be completed.
summary_zh: 重复混合融合选择的候选检查；临时把c加入sg，并返回当前选择是否已经有效或仍可完成。
core_summary_en: Candidate test for mixed-repeat Fusion selection.

returns.description: true if adding c can complete or continue the selection.

summary_en: Returns the condition function for Shaddoll Fusion procedures. It checks for one Shaddoll material and one material with the required Attribute, with optional field-spell opponent-material support.
summary_zh: 返回「影依」融合手续的条件函数；检查1个「影依」素材和1个指定属性素材，并支持场地效果使用对方怪兽作为素材。
core_summary_en: Returns the condition function for Shaddoll Fusion procedures.

returns.description: Condition function for a Shaddoll Fusion procedure.

summary_en: Opponent-field Shaddoll Fusion Material filter used with effect code 81788994; c must be face-up, affected by the field effect, and pass the standard Shaddoll material filter.
summary_zh: 配合编号81788994效果使用的对方场上「影依」融合素材筛选；c必须表侧表示、受该场地效果影响，并满足标准「影依」素材筛选。
core_summary_en: Opponent-field Shaddoll Fusion Material filter used with effect code 81788994.

returns.description: true if c is a valid opponent-field Shaddoll Fusion Material.

summary_en: Standard Shaddoll Fusion Material filter. The card must be either a Shaddoll monster or match the required Attribute, be usable as Fusion Material, and not be blocked by effect 6205579.
summary_zh: 标准「影依」融合素材筛选；该卡必须是「影依」怪兽或匹配指定属性，可以作为融合素材，且未被编号6205579效果阻止。
core_summary_en: Standard Shaddoll Fusion Material filter.

returns.description: true if c is valid Shaddoll Fusion Material.

summary_en: Returns true if c belongs to the Shaddoll Fusion set 0x9d.
summary_zh: c属于「影依」融合系列0x9d时返回true。
core_summary_en: Checks Shaddoll Fusion set membership.

returns.description: true if c belongs to Shaddoll Fusion set 0x9d.

summary_en: Returns true if c has the required Fusion Attribute or effect code 4904633.
summary_zh: c具有指定融合属性，或具有编号4904633效果时返回true。
core_summary_en: Checks the required Shaddoll Fusion Attribute condition.

returns.description: true if c has attr as Fusion Attribute or effect code 4904633.

summary_en: Returns the operation function for Shaddoll Fusion procedures; it selects the two required materials, optionally using the opponent-field material effect, and stores them with Duel.SetFusionMaterial.
summary_zh: 返回「影依」融合手续的操作函数；选择2张必需融合素材，必要时使用对方场上素材效果，并通过Duel.SetFusionMaterial保存。
core_summary_en: Returns the operation function for Shaddoll Fusion procedures.

returns.description: Operation function for a Shaddoll Fusion procedure.

summary_en: Checks whether c can be paired with another valid Shaddoll Fusion Material from mg or exg.
summary_zh: 检查c是否可以和mg或exg中的另一张有效「影依」融合素材配对。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c can be paired with another valid Shaddoll Fusion Material.

returns.description: true if c can be paired with another valid material.

summary_en: Checks whether c and mc form the required Shaddoll Fusion Material pair while respecting mandatory Fusion Material and additional Fusion checks.
summary_zh: 检查c和mc是否组成所需的「影依」融合素材组合，并同时遵守必须融合素材和额外融合检查。
core_summary_en: Checks a two-card Shaddoll Fusion Material pair.

returns.description: true if c and mc form a valid Shaddoll Fusion Material pair.

summary_en: Returns a filter function that calls f(target, ...) with the extra arguments captured now.
Use this when another API expects a one-argument Card filter but the real filter needs fixed extra values.
Returns a card filter that calls f on the card and extra arguments, then checks whether the result equals value.
summary_zh: 返回卡片筛选函数：对该卡和额外参数调用f，并检查结果是否等于value。
core_summary_en: Builds equality card filter.

summary_en: Special Summon restriction value for Fossil Fusion effects; allows Fossil Fusion's summon value, Fossil Fusion itself, or non-Extra Deck handlers.
summary_zh: 化石融合类效果的特殊召唤限制Value函数；允许化石融合召唤值、「化石融合」本身，或处理对象不在额外卡组。
core_summary_en: Special Summon restriction value for Fossil Fusion effects.

returns.description: true if the Summon matches Fossil Fusion conditions.

summary_en: Checks whether c is a Fusion Monster that can be Fusion Summoned by e using mg and the filters stored in params.
summary_zh: 检查c是否为可由e使用mg和params中筛选条件进行融合召唤的融合怪兽。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c is a valid Fusion Summon target for the configured Fusion effect.

returns.description: true if c can be Fusion Summoned with the provided material pool.

summary_en: Fusion effect material filter; rejects materials immune to e and applies the optional material filter f.
summary_zh: 融合效果素材筛选；排除不受e影响的素材，并在提供f时套用该素材筛选。
core_summary_en: Fusion effect material filter.

returns.description: true if c is affected by e and passes f when provided.

summary_en: Location-specific Fusion material filter; cards outside loc pass, and cards in loc must satisfy f when one is provided.
summary_zh: 按位置使用的融合素材筛选；不在loc的卡直接通过，在loc的卡则需要在提供f时满足f。
core_summary_en: Location-specific Fusion material filter.

returns.description: true if c is outside loc or passes f.

summary_en: Returns the operation function for configurable Fusion Summon effects. It builds the material pool, handles Chain Material, applies per-location material operations, Special Summons the chosen Fusion Monster, and runs extra callbacks.
summary_zh: 返回可配置融合召唤效果的操作函数；构建素材池，处理连锁素材，按位置执行素材操作，特殊召唤选择的融合怪兽，并执行额外回调。
core_summary_en: Returns the operation function for configurable Fusion Summon effects.

returns.description: Operation function for a configurable Fusion Summon effect.

summary_en: Returns the target function for configurable Fusion Summon effects. It checks available Fusion Monsters and material pools, handles Chain Material fallback, and registers operation information.
summary_zh: 返回可配置融合召唤效果的目标函数；检查可召唤融合怪兽和素材池，处理连锁素材的备用检查，并登记操作信息。
core_summary_en: Returns the target function for configurable Fusion Summon effects.

returns.description: Target function for a configurable Fusion Summon effect.

summary_en: Global additional subgroup-check hook used by Group.CheckSubGroup and related selection helpers.
The default implementation returns true. Summon and selection procedures temporarily replace this function to enforce extra group constraints, then restore it.
summary_zh: Group.CheckSubGroup及相关选择辅助函数使用的全局额外子组检查钩子。
默认实现返回true。召唤和选择手续会临时替换该函数以施加额外组限制，之后再恢复。
core_summary_en: Additional subgroup-check hook.

summary_en: Returns cards from location1/location2 that are orthogonally adjacent to the global field coordinate (i, j).
summary_zh: 返回location1/location2中与全局场地坐标(i, j)正交相邻的卡。

summary_en: Returns how many different Attributes are represented among the cards in g; an empty group returns 0.
summary_zh: 返回g中包含的不同属性数量；空Group返回0。

summary_en: Returns c's current ATK, capped at MAX_PARAMETER.
summary_zh: 返回c的当前攻击力，但最高限制为MAX_PARAMETER。

summary_en: Returns c's current Level, capped at MAX_PARAMETER.
summary_zh: 返回c的当前等级，但最高限制为MAX_PARAMETER。

summary_en: Returns c's current Level, capped at MAX_XYZ_LEVEL.
summary_zh: 返回c的当前等级，但最高限制为MAX_XYZ_LEVEL。

summary_en: Returns c's column index from player p's viewpoint, or NULL_VALUE when c has no field column.
The local helper maps ordinary Monster Zones and Spell & Trap Zones to columns 0-4; Extra Monster Zone sequences 5 and 6 map to columns 1 and 3.
summary_zh: 从玩家p视角返回c所在纵列编号；c没有场上纵列时返回NULL_VALUE。
本地辅助函数把通常怪兽区域、魔法与陷阱区域映射为0-4列；额外怪兽区域序号5和6分别映射为1列和3列。
core_summary_en: Returns field column.

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose field column is checked.
params.description_zh: 要检查所在纵列的卡。

params.name: p
params.description: Viewpoint player. Defaults to 0.
params.description_zh: 视角玩家。省略时为0。

returns.description: Column index from p's viewpoint, or NULL_VALUE if c has no field column.
returns.description_zh: 从p视角看的纵列编号；若c没有场上纵列则为NULL_VALUE。

summary_en: Returns c's global row and column indexes from player 0's field viewpoint.
summary_zh: 从玩家0的场地视角返回c的全局行号和列号。

summary_en: Returns the column index for location and sequence from player 0's viewpoint. For player 1, the local column is mirrored. Invalid locations/sequences return NULL_VALUE.
summary_zh: 从玩家0视角返回location和sequence对应的列编号。若p为玩家1，则会把本地列镜像；无效位置或序号返回NULL_VALUE。
core_summary_en: Returns the column index for location and sequence from player 0's viewpoint.

returns.description: The global column index, or NULL_VALUE for invalid input.

summary_en: Returns the row index for location and sequence from player 0's viewpoint. For player 1, the local row is mirrored. Invalid locations/sequences return NULL_VALUE.
summary_zh: 从玩家0视角返回location和sequence对应的行编号。若p为玩家1，则会把本地行镜像；无效位置或序号返回NULL_VALUE。
core_summary_en: Returns the row index for location and sequence from player 0's viewpoint.

returns.description: The global row index, or NULL_VALUE for invalid input.

summary_en: Returns the encoded material value used by Link procedure sum checks.
Ordinary materials and Link-1 monsters count as 1. A Link Monster with Link Rating greater than 1 encodes the choice to count as either 1 or its Link Rating for Group.CheckWithSumEqual.
summary_zh: 返回连接召唤手续求和检查使用的素材数值编码。
通常素材和LINK-1怪兽按1计算。连接值大于1的连接怪兽会编码为可按1或自身连接值计算，供Group.CheckWithSumEqual使用。
core_summary_en: Returns Link Material count encoding.
core_summary_zh: 返回连接素材数量编码。

params.name: c
params.description: Candidate Link Material.
params.description_zh: 候选连接素材。

returns.description: 1, or an encoded 1-or-Link-Rating value for Link Monsters with Link Rating greater than 1.
returns.description_zh: 1；连接值大于1的连接怪兽则返回可表示1或自身连接值的编码。

summary_en: Returns the available Link Materials for tp, including regular Monster Zone materials and cards allowed by extra Link Material effects.
summary_zh: 返回tp可用的连接素材，包括通常怪兽区域素材，以及由额外连接素材效果允许使用的卡。
core_summary_en: Returns the available Link Materials for tp.

returns.description: Available Link Materials.

summary_en: Returns the local column index for a Spell & Trap Zone or Monster Zone sequence. Extra Monster Zone sequences 5 and 6 map to columns 1 and 3; invalid inputs return NULL_VALUE.
summary_zh: 返回魔法与陷阱区域或怪兽区域序号对应的本地列编号。额外怪兽区域序号5和6分别对应列1和列3；无效输入返回NULL_VALUE。
core_summary_en: Returns the local column index for a Spell & Trap Zone or Monster Zone sequence.

returns.description: The local column index, or NULL_VALUE for invalid input.

summary_en: Returns the local row index for a Spell & Trap Zone or Monster Zone sequence. Main Monster Zones are row 1, Extra Monster Zones are row 2, and invalid inputs return NULL_VALUE.
summary_zh: 返回魔法与陷阱区域或怪兽区域序号对应的本地行编号。主要怪兽区域为行1，额外怪兽区域为行2；无效输入返回NULL_VALUE。
core_summary_en: Returns the local row index for a Spell & Trap Zone or Monster Zone sequence.

returns.description: The local row index, or NULL_VALUE for invalid input.

summary_en: Returns c's stored minimum and maximum material counts. If c has no material_count table, returns 0,0.
summary_zh: 返回c登记的素材数量下限和上限。若c没有material_count表，则返回0,0。
core_summary_en: Returns c's stored minimum and maximum material counts.

returns.description: Minimum material count.
Maximum material count.

summary_en: Returns the smallest Synchro Level value c can provide for syncard, including packed alternative Synchro Levels.
summary_zh: 返回c可为syncard提供的最小同调等级，包括打包保存的可选同调等级。
core_summary_en: Returns the smallest Synchro Level value c can provide.

returns.description: Smallest Synchro Level value c can provide.

summary_en: Returns the zone mask of tp's Monster Zones that are linked by at least two face-up Link Monsters on either field.
summary_zh: 返回tp的怪兽区域中，被任意场上至少2只表侧连接怪兽连接到的区域掩码。
core_summary_en: Returns tp's multi-linked Monster Zone mask.

returns.description: Zone mask for zones linked by at least two Link Monsters.

summary_en: Returns the available Synchro Materials for tp and syncard, including valid hand materials when any field material enables hand Synchro use.
summary_zh: 返回tp对syncard可用的同调素材；若场上素材允许使用手牌同调素材，也会合并有效手牌素材。
core_summary_en: Returns the available Synchro Materials for tp and syncard.

returns.description: Available Synchro Materials.

summary_en: Returns the fixed Synchro Level value used by Flower Cardian helpers.
summary_zh: 返回「花札卫」辅助函数使用的固定同调等级。
core_summary_en: Returns the fixed Synchro Level value used by Flower Cardian helpers.

returns.description: Fixed Synchro Level value 2.

summary_en: Returns Lua's type string for ordinary values, or Card, Group, or Effect for those userdata objects.
summary_zh: 普通值返回Lua的type字符串；Card、Group、Effect userdata返回对应名称。
core_summary_en: Returns normalized Lua value type.

summary_en: Returns the stored Xyz Number value for v, where v can be a Card or a numeric card code. Returns nil when no value is registered.
summary_zh: 返回v对应的已登记「No.」数值；v可以是Card或数字卡名编号。未登记时返回nil。
core_summary_en: Returns the stored Xyz Number value for a Card or card code.

returns.description: Registered Xyz Number value, if any.

summary_en: Makes tp give up the normal draw for the current Draw Phase by setting EFFECT_DRAW_COUNT to 0 and registering FLAG_ID_NO_NORMAL_DRAW.
summary_zh: 让tp放弃当前抽卡阶段的通常抽卡：登记EFFECT_DRAW_COUNT为0，并登记FLAG_ID_NO_NORMAL_DRAW。

summary_en: Returns true for cards whose original set code is 0x3, used by Golden Allure Queen quick-effect handling.
summary_zh: 检查c的原本系列代码是否为0x3，供Golden Allure Queen快速效果处理使用。

summary_en: Checks whether player tp is affected by code, code has a registered quick-effect filter, and that filter accepts c.
summary_zh: 检查玩家tp是否受code影响、code是否登记了快速效果筛选，并且该筛选是否接受c。
core_summary_en: Checks quick-effect filter availability.
core_summary_zh: 检查快速效果筛选可用性。

summary_en: Checks whether code is registered in c's card_code_list by Auxiliary.AddCodeList or a related helper.
The Lua helper returns true for a listed code and nil otherwise, so it is normally used as a truthy check.
summary_zh: 检查code是否已通过Auxiliary.AddCodeList或相关辅助函数登记在c的card_code_list中。
该Lua辅助函数在列名时返回true，否则返回nil，通常作为真假判断使用。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c lists code.

returns.description: true if code is listed by c; nil otherwise.

summary_en: Returns true if c's current code matches code or code is registered in c's listed-code table.
summary_zh: 判断c的当前卡名是否为code，或code是否已登记在c的列名编号表中。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c's current code is code or c lists code.

returns.description: true if c has or lists code.

summary_en: Returns true if counter is registered in c.counter_add_list.
summary_zh: 判断counter是否已登记在c.counter_add_list中。
core_summary_en: Checks whether counter is registered in c.counter_add_list.

returns.description: true if counter is registered on c.

summary_en: Condition helper that is true when e's handler is not disabled and is in Dual State.
summary_zh: 条件辅助函数：e的处理对象未被无效且处于二重状态时返回true。
core_summary_en: Checks whether e's handler is in Dual State.
core_summary_zh: 检查e的处理对象是否处于二重状态。

summary_en: Returns true if g contains c.
summary_zh: 判断g是否包含c。
core_summary_en: Checks whether g contains c.

returns.description: true if g contains c.

summary_en: Checks whether code is present in c.material, normally populated by AddMaterialCodeList; returns true or nil.
summary_zh: 检查code是否存在于c.material中；该表通常由AddMaterialCodeList填充。返回true或nil。
core_summary_en: Checks c.material for code.

summary_en: Checks whether c lists setcode in its material_setcode metadata, including packed sub-set matching.
summary_zh: 检查c的material_setcode元数据是否列有setcode，并支持打包子系列匹配。
core_summary_en: Checks listed material set codes.
core_summary_zh: 检查列名素材系列代码。

summary_en: Returns true if c's stored material type mask contains type.
summary_zh: 判断c登记的素材种类掩码是否包含type。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c's stored material type mask contains type.

returns.description: true if c's material type mask contains type.

summary_en: Gemini helper condition that returns true when the effect is disabled or its handler is not in Gemini treated-as-effect state.
summary_zh: 二重辅助条件：效果被无效，或处理对象不处于二重怪兽视为效果怪兽状态时返回true。

summary_en: Checks whether tp can perform a normal draw: draw count is positive, the Deck is not empty, and FLAG_ID_NO_NORMAL_DRAW is not set.
summary_zh: 判断tp是否可以进行通常抽卡：抽卡数量大于0，卡组不为空，且没有FLAG_ID_NO_NORMAL_DRAW。

summary_en: Checks whether c has an equipped card carrying flag effect id, which marks equipment created by that card's own effect.
summary_zh: 检查c是否有带标志效果id的装备卡，用于判断由该卡自身效果装备的卡。
core_summary_en: Checks self-equipped cards.

summary_en: Returns true if setcode matches one of the monster set codes registered for c, using the same set-code comparison rules as set membership helpers.
summary_zh: 判断setcode是否匹配c登记的怪兽系列编号；比较规则与系列判断辅助函数一致。
core_summary_en: Checks whether setcode matches one of c's registered monster set codes.

returns.description: true if c lists a matching monster set code.

summary_en: Returns true if c's text-registered type mask contains type.
summary_zh: 判断c文本登记的种类掩码是否包含type。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c's text-registered type mask contains type.

returns.description: true if c's text type mask contains type.

summary_en: Returns the equipped Union target for effect's handler when it has EFFECT_UNION_STATUS and is equipped.
The Lua expression returns a truthy Card on success, false when the status effect is missing, or nil when no equip target exists.
summary_zh: 当effect的处理对象具有EFFECT_UNION_STATUS且正在装备时，返回其装备对象。
该Lua表达式成功时返回可作为真值使用的Card；没有同盟状态效果时返回false；没有装备对象时返回nil。
core_summary_en: Checks equipped Union state.

returns.description: Equipped target when truthy.

summary_en: Final Link Material group check. It verifies Link Rating total, Extra Monster Zone availability, optional group filter, extra-material compatibility, and required lmat inclusion.
summary_zh: 连接素材组的最终检查；验证连接数值合计、额外怪兽区域可用性、可选组筛选、额外素材兼容性，以及是否包含指定lmat。
core_summary_en: Final Link Material group check.

returns.description: true if sg is a valid Link Material group.

summary_en: Checks whether c is compatible with the other selected Link Materials through EFFECT_EXTRA_LINK_MATERIAL handlers.
summary_zh: 通过EFFECT_EXTRA_LINK_MATERIAL处理函数检查c是否与其他已选连接素材兼容。
core_summary_en: Checks extra Link Material compatibility for c.

returns.description: true if c is compatible with mg.

summary_en: Regular Link Material filter. The card must be visible or selectable by e, usable as Link Material for lc, and satisfy f when provided.
summary_zh: 通常连接素材筛选；该卡必须可见或可被e选择，可以作为lc的连接素材，并在提供f时满足f。
core_summary_en: Regular Link Material filter.

returns.description: true if c is regular Link Material.

summary_en: Extra Link Material filter for hand, Spell & Trap Zone, or opponent-field cards granted by EFFECT_EXTRA_LINK_MATERIAL.
summary_zh: 由EFFECT_EXTRA_LINK_MATERIAL允许的额外连接素材筛选，用于手牌、魔法/陷阱区域或对方场上的卡。
core_summary_en: Extra Link Material filter.

returns.description: true if c can be used through an extra Link Material effect.

summary_en: Consumes count limits for selected Link Materials that were used through valid EFFECT_EXTRA_LINK_MATERIAL effects.
summary_zh: 对通过有效EFFECT_EXTRA_LINK_MATERIAL效果使用的已选连接素材消耗次数限制。
core_summary_en: Consumes count limits for selected extra Link Materials.

summary_en: Returns true when c is not compatible with the other selected Link Materials.
summary_zh: c与其他已选连接素材不兼容时返回true。
core_summary_en: Checks Link Material incompatibility.

returns.description: true if c is incompatible with the rest of sg.

summary_en: Shared extra destroy operation for the Labrynth field effect. After a non-hand-activated Welcome Labrynth Normal Trap resolves, it can destroy one card on the field and consumes the field effect's count limit.
summary_zh: 「白银之迷宫城」共通的追加破坏处理；非从手牌发动的「拉比林斯迷宫欢迎」通常陷阱处理后，可破坏场上1张卡，并使用场地效果的次数限制。

summary_en: Returns the condition function for Link Summon procedures.

The returned function rejects face-up Pendulum Link Monsters in the Extra Deck, builds or filters the material pool, applies runtime min/max limits, includes required lmat material when supplied, checks EFFECT_MUST_BE_LMATERIAL, and asks whether a valid subgroup exists.
summary_zh: 返回连接召唤手续的条件函数。
返回的函数会拒绝额外卡组中表侧表示的灵摆连接怪兽，建立或筛选素材池，应用运行时min/max限制，在提供lmat时加入必需素材，检查EFFECT_MUST_BE_LMATERIAL，并确认是否存在合法素材子组。
core_summary_en: Returns the condition function for Link Summon procedures.

returns.description: Condition function for a Link Summon procedure.

summary_en: Returns the operation function for Link Summon procedures.

The returned function reads the selected group from the effect label object, records it with Card.SetMaterial, consumes valid extra-material count limits, sends the materials to the GY with REASON_MATERIAL+REASON_LINK, and deletes the kept-alive group.
summary_zh: 返回连接召唤手续的操作函数。
返回的函数从效果的LabelObject读取被选择的Group，用Card.SetMaterial记录素材，消耗合法的额外素材次数限制，以REASON_MATERIAL+REASON_LINK把素材送去墓地，并删除KeepAlive的Group。
core_summary_en: Returns the operation function for Link Summon procedures.

returns.description: Operation function for a Link Summon procedure.

summary_en: Returns the target function for Link Summon procedures.
The returned function selects a Link Material subgroup with Group.SelectSubGroup and Auxiliary.LCheckGoal, keeps that group alive, and stores it on the effect for LinkOperation.
summary_zh: 返回连接召唤手续的目标函数。
返回的函数使用Group.SelectSubGroup和Auxiliary.LCheckGoal选择连接素材子组，使该Group保持存在，并保存在效果上供LinkOperation使用。
core_summary_en: Returns the target function for Link Summon procedures.

returns.description: Target function for a Link Summon procedure.

summary_en: Returns the local column index for Monster Zone sequence seq from that controller's viewpoint.
summary_zh: 从控制者视角返回怪兽区域序号seq对应的本地纵列编号。
core_summary_en: Converts Monster Zone sequence to local column.
core_summary_zh: 把怪兽区域序号转换为本地纵列。

summary_en: Special Summon restriction value for Masked HERO/Mask Change effects; allows the Mask Change summon value or effects activated by card code 21143940.
summary_zh: Masked HERO/Mask Change类效果的特殊召唤限制Value函数；允许Mask Change召唤值，或由编号21143940的卡发动的效果。
core_summary_en: Special Summon restriction value for Masked HERO/Mask Change effects.

returns.description: true if the Summon matches Mask Change conditions.

summary_en: EVENT_BE_MATERIAL callback used by Auxiliary.CreateMaterialReasonCardRelation. It creates an effect relation between the Summoned monster and the stored effect object.
summary_zh: Auxiliary.CreateMaterialReasonCardRelation使用的EVENT_BE_MATERIAL回调；让召唤出的怪兽与保存的效果对象建立效果关联。

summary_en: Internal callback for Auxiliary.RegisterMergedDelayedEvent. It collects event cards and, if not inside a Chain, raises EVENT_CUSTOM plus the stored code immediately.
summary_zh: Auxiliary.RegisterMergedDelayedEvent使用的内部回调；收集事件卡，若当前不在连锁中，则立刻触发EVENT_CUSTOM加保存编号的事件。

summary_en: Internal callback for single-card merged delayed events. It collects event cards, clears them if the owner card moved, and raises the stored custom event immediately when possible.
summary_zh: 单卡合并延迟事件使用的内部回调；收集事件卡，若持有者自身移动则清空，并在可立即处理时触发保存的自定义事件。

summary_en: Internal callback for Auxiliary.RegisterMergedDelayedEvent. At Chain End, it raises one merged custom event for all collected cards, then clears the stored group.
summary_zh: Auxiliary.RegisterMergedDelayedEvent使用的内部回调；在连锁结束时，对已收集的卡只触发1次合并后的自定义事件，然后清空保存的Group。

summary_en: Internal Chain End callback for single-card merged delayed events. It clears stale public-move entries, raises the stored custom event for collected cards, then clears the group.
summary_zh: 单卡合并延迟事件使用的连锁结束内部回调；清理因公开移动而失效的记录，对收集到的卡触发保存的自定义事件，然后清空Group。

summary_en: Returns true during either Main Phase.
summary_zh: 当前处于任一主要阶段时返回true。
core_summary_en: Returns true during either Main Phase.

returns.description: true during either Main Phase.

summary_en: Returns a predicate that checks whether an Effect has property flag and is not ranged to the Pendulum Zone.
summary_zh: 返回谓词函数，用于判断Effect是否包含flag属性，且效果范围不在灵摆区域。

summary_en: Checks whether tp's required-material effects of type code are satisfied.

When v is nil, the helper succeeds only if Duel.GetMustMaterial(tp, code) is empty, except for the hard-coded Xyz and Synchro material exceptions present in the utility script. When v is supplied, it returns Duel.CheckMustMaterial(tp, v, code).
summary_zh: 检查tp受到的code类型必须素材效果是否已经满足。
v为nil时，只有Duel.GetMustMaterial(tp, code)为空才成功，但utility脚本中存在硬编码的超量和同调素材例外。v提供时，返回Duel.CheckMustMaterial(tp, v, code)的结果。
core_summary_en: Checks whether required-material effects are satisfied.
core_summary_zh: 检查必须素材效果是否已满足。

summary_en: Returns true when c is not contained in g; used to detect mandatory materials missing from a candidate material group.
summary_zh: c不包含在g中时返回true，用于检查候选素材组是否漏掉必须素材。

summary_en: Returns a predicate that negates f's result.
summary_zh: 返回将f结果取反的谓词函数。
core_summary_en: Returns a predicate that negates f's result.

returns.description: A predicate that returns not f(...).

summary_en: Empty helper function that intentionally does nothing.
summary_zh: 空辅助函数；有意不执行任何处理。

summary_en: Returns a wrapper filter that requires f(target, ...) and also rejects cards currently protected by Necrovalley while the Chain is disablable.
Checks whether v, a Card or Group, contains a card affected by Necrovalley. If the current Chain is disablable and a matching card is found, it negates the current effect and returns true.
summary_zh: 检查v这个Card或Group中是否包含受「王家长眠之谷」影响的卡。若当前连锁可被无效且找到匹配卡，则无效当前效果并返回true。
core_summary_en: Checks whether v contains a card affected by Necrovalley, and negates the current effect if so.

returns.description: true if the current effect was negated by the Necrovalley check.

summary_en: Filter for effects that negate a face-up card. Trap Monsters only need to be face-up, Spell/Trap Cards must be face-up and not already disabled, and monsters use Auxiliary.NegateMonsterFilter.
summary_zh: 用于无效表侧卡效果的筛选。陷阱怪兽只需表侧表示，魔法/陷阱卡需表侧表示且尚未被无效，怪兽则使用Auxiliary.NegateMonsterFilter。
core_summary_en: Filter for effects that negate a face-up card.

returns.description: true if c is a valid card to have its effects negated.

summary_en: Filter for effects that negate an Effect Monster, such as Effect Veiler: c must be face-up, not already disabled, and currently an Effect Monster.
summary_zh: 用于无效效果怪兽效果的筛选，例如「效果遮蒙者」；c必须表侧表示、尚未被无效，且当前为效果怪兽。
core_summary_en: Filter for effects that negate an Effect Monster.

returns.description: true if c is a valid Effect Monster to have its effects negated.

summary_en: Filter for effects that negate a face-up monster, such as Infinite Impermanence: c must be face-up, not already disabled, and be or originally be an Effect Monster.
summary_zh: 用于无效表侧怪兽效果的筛选，例如「无限泡影」；c必须表侧表示、尚未被无效，且当前或原本为效果怪兽。
core_summary_en: Filter for effects that negate a face-up monster.

returns.description: true if c is a valid face-up monster to have its effects negated.

summary_en: Returns true when no Chain is ready, for effects that negate a Summon.
summary_zh: 没有待处理连锁时返回true，用于无效召唤的效果。
core_summary_en: Condition helper for effects that negate a Summon.

returns.description: true when no Chain is ready.

summary_en: Condition for the mandatory Elemental HERO Neos Fusion End Phase return effect; true while the handler is not affected by Neo Space's effect code 42015635.
summary_zh: 「元素英雄 新宇侠」融合怪兽结束阶段强制返回效果的条件；处理对象未受编号42015635（「新宇宙」）效果影响时返回true。
core_summary_en: Condition for the mandatory Elemental HERO Neos Fusion End Phase return effect.

returns.description: true if the forced Neos return effect should apply.

summary_en: Condition for the optional Elemental HERO Neos Fusion End Phase return effect; true while the handler is affected by Neo Space's effect code 42015635.
summary_zh: 「元素英雄 新宇侠」融合怪兽结束阶段可选返回效果的条件；处理对象受编号42015635（「新宇宙」）效果影响时返回true。
core_summary_en: Condition for the optional Elemental HERO Neos Fusion End Phase return effect.

returns.description: true if the optional Neos return effect should apply.

summary_en: Returns the mandatory End Phase return target function for Elemental HERO Neos Fusions. It always allows targeting, sets to-Deck operation info, and calls set_category when provided.
summary_zh: 返回「元素英雄 新宇侠」融合怪兽强制结束阶段返回效果的目标函数；始终允许处理，登记回到卡组信息，并在提供set_category时调用它。
core_summary_en: Returns the mandatory End Phase return target function for Elemental HERO Neos Fusions.

returns.description: Target function for the mandatory return effect.

summary_en: Returns the optional End Phase return target function for Elemental HERO Neos Fusions. It requires the handler to be able to return to the Extra Deck, sets to-Deck operation info, and calls set_category when provided.
summary_zh: 返回「元素英雄 新宇侠」融合怪兽可选结束阶段返回效果的目标函数；要求处理对象可以回到额外卡组，登记回到卡组信息，并在提供set_category时调用它。
core_summary_en: Returns the optional End Phase return target function for Elemental HERO Neos Fusions.

returns.description: Target function for the optional return effect.

summary_en: Returns an iterator over g for generic for loops, using Group.GetFirst and Group.GetNext internally.
summary_zh: 返回用于generic for循环遍历g的迭代器，内部使用Group.GetFirst和Group.GetNext。
core_summary_en: Creates an iterator over g using Group.GetFirst and Group.GetNext.

returns.description: Iterator function for generic for loops.

summary_en: Returns a non-Tuner material filter that also applies f when f is supplied.
Extra arguments are captured now and passed to f after the Card argument.
Returns a composed predicate that calls each function with the same arguments and stops at the first truthy result.
summary_zh: 返回组合条件函数；调用时会用相同参数依次执行传入的函数，并在第一个真值处停止。
core_summary_en: Returns a composed predicate that stops at the first truthy result.

returns.description: A composed predicate.

summary_en: Returns true for original Orcust cards that are Link Monsters on the field or monsters in the GY.
summary_zh: 检查原本为Orcust系列的卡是否是在场上的连接怪兽，或在墓地的怪兽。

summary_en: Checks whether any extra Pendulum Summon effect in eset allows c for the current scales.
summary_zh: 检查eset中的任意额外灵摆召唤效果是否允许c在当前刻度下使用。
core_summary_en: Checks extra Pendulum Summon effects for c.

returns.description: true if any extra Pendulum Summon effect allows c.

summary_en: Checks whether one extra Pendulum Summon effect allows c for the current scales.
summary_zh: 检查1个额外灵摆召唤效果是否允许c在当前刻度下使用。
core_summary_en: Checks one extra Pendulum Summon effect for c.

returns.description: true if te allows c or te is nil.

summary_en: Pendulum Summon candidate filter. It checks location, Level or pendulum_level, scales, Special Summon legality, forbidden state, and extra Pendulum Summon permissions.
summary_zh: 灵摆召唤候选筛选；检查位置、等级或pendulum_level、刻度、特殊召唤合法性、禁止状态，以及额外灵摆召唤许可。
core_summary_en: Pendulum Summon candidate filter.

returns.description: true if c can be Pendulum Summoned.

summary_en: Completes the procedure for monsters that were Special Summoned by Pendulum Summon through the revive-limit helper.
summary_zh: 对通过复活限制辅助函数设置、并以灵摆召唤特殊召唤的怪兽完成正规手续。
core_summary_en: Completes the procedure after a Pendulum Summon when appropriate.

summary_en: Condition function for the shared Pendulum Summon procedure. It checks the two Pendulum Zones, available locations and zones, once-per-turn state, and valid summonable monsters.
summary_zh: 共通灵摆召唤手续的条件函数；检查2个灵摆区域、可用位置和区域、每回合状态，以及可召唤怪兽。
core_summary_en: Condition function for the shared Pendulum Summon procedure.

returns.description: true if a Pendulum Summon is available.

summary_en: Operation function for the shared Pendulum Summon procedure. It chooses the regular or extra Pendulum Summon effect, selects monsters within hand/Extra Deck zone limits, updates the checklist, and merges the selection into sg.
summary_zh: 共通灵摆召唤手续的操作函数；选择通常或额外灵摆召唤效果，在手牌/额外卡组区域限制内选择怪兽，更新检查标记，并把选择合并到sg。
core_summary_en: Operation function for the shared Pendulum Summon procedure.

summary_en: Returns a group check that enforces the hand, Extra Deck, and total zone limits for a Pendulum Summon selection.
summary_zh: 返回组检查函数，用于限制一次灵摆召唤选择中的手牌数量、额外卡组数量和总区域数量。
core_summary_en: Returns a group check for Pendulum Summon zone limits.

returns.description: Group check for Pendulum Summon zone limits.

summary_en: Resets the shared Pendulum Summon checklist at the start of the Draw Phase.
summary_zh: 在抽卡阶段开始时重置共通灵摆召唤检查标记。
core_summary_en: Resets the shared Pendulum Summon checklist.

summary_en: Returns true if c has a psummonable_location flag that includes its current location.
summary_zh: c具有psummonable_location标记且当前位置包含在其中时返回true。
core_summary_en: Checks the psummonable_location flag for c.

returns.description: true if c's current location is Pendulum Summonable by its flag.

summary_en: Returns whether c is a Special Summon procedure monster, used by Phantasm Special Summon helpers.
summary_zh: 检查c是否是特殊召唤手续怪兽，供Phantasm特殊召唤辅助函数使用。
core_summary_en: Checks Special Summon procedure type.
core_summary_zh: 检查特殊召唤手续类型。

summary_en: Sends g to the top of the Deck by reason, lets p order cards that reached either Deck, moves them to the bottom, and returns the number of operated cards.
summary_zh: 以reason把g送到卡组最上方；让p为进入双方卡组的卡排序后，再移动到卡组最下方，并返回实际处理的卡数量。
core_summary_en: Places cards on the bottom of the Deck in player-chosen order.

params.name: reason
params.description: Defaults to REASON_EFFECT.

returns.description: The number of operated cards.

summary_en: Sends g to the top of the Deck by reason, lets p order cards that reached either Deck when needed, and returns the number of operated cards.
summary_zh: 以reason把g送到卡组最上方；需要时让p为进入双方卡组的卡排序，并返回实际处理的卡数量。
