core_summary_en: Places cards on the top of the Deck in player-chosen order.

params.name: reason
params.description: Defaults to REASON_EFFECT.

returns.description: The number of operated cards.

summary_en: Puzzle-mode End Phase operation that sets player 0's LP to 0.
summary_zh: 残局模式的结束阶段操作；把玩家0的LP变为0。

summary_en: Registers global listeners that merge multiple occurrences of event into one EVENT_CUSTOM+code event. The merged event is raised immediately outside a Chain, or at Chain End while in a Chain.
summary_zh: 登记全局监听，把同一连锁内多次发生的event合并成1次EVENT_CUSTOM+code事件。不在连锁中则立即触发，在连锁中则于连锁结束触发。
core_summary_en: Registers global listeners that merge multiple event occurrences into one custom event.

params.name: g
params.description: Optional storage group; a kept-alive group is created when omitted.

summary_en: Registers single-card merged delayed event listeners for one event or a table of events, returning the generated custom event code. The helper clears stored cards when the owner moves to a public state and installs the shared Chain End raiser when needed.
summary_zh: 为单张卡登记1个事件或事件表的合并延迟监听，并返回生成的自定义事件编号。持有者移动到公开状态时会清空保存的卡，并在需要时安装共通的连锁结束触发器。
core_summary_en: Registers single-card merged delayed event listeners.

returns.description: The generated custom event code.

summary_en: Internal helper that registers one event listener and its Chain End companion for Auxiliary.RegisterMergedDelayedEvent_ToSingleCard.
summary_zh: Auxiliary.RegisterMergedDelayedEvent_ToSingleCard使用的内部辅助函数；登记1个事件监听及其连锁结束配套监听。
core_summary_en: Registers one single-card merged delayed event listener and its Chain End companion.

summary_en: Global Chain End helper for single-card merged delayed events. It raises each pending generated custom event once, then clears its stored group.
summary_zh: 单卡合并延迟事件使用的全局连锁结束辅助函数；对每个待处理的生成自定义事件触发1次，然后清空对应Group。

summary_en: Ritual material group predicate that checks zone availability, the requested Greater/Equal level rule, custom mat_group_check, and RCheckAdditional.
summary_zh: 仪式素材组判定：检查区域可用性、指定的Greater/Equal等级规则、自定义mat_group_check以及RCheckAdditional。
core_summary_en: Checks Ritual Material groups.

summary_en: Returns an additional subgroup check used while selecting Ritual Materials for Equal or Greater Ritual procedures.
summary_zh: 返回仪式素材选择时使用的额外子组检查函数，支持Equal或Greater仪式手续。
core_summary_en: Returns an additional subgroup check for Ritual Material selection.

returns.description: Additional Ritual Material subgroup check.

summary_en: Returns the smaller usable Ritual Level value for c when its Ritual Level packs two alternatives.
summary_zh: 当c的仪式等级打包了2个可选数值时，返回较小的可用仪式等级。
core_summary_en: Returns the smaller usable Ritual Level value for c.

returns.description: Smallest usable Ritual Level value.

summary_en: Checks whether g's Ritual Levels exactly equal lv for c.
summary_zh: 检查g中仪式等级合计是否正好等于c所需的lv。
core_summary_en: Checks exact Ritual Material Level total.

returns.description: true if g exactly matches lv.

summary_en: Checks whether g's Ritual Levels are greater than or equal to lv for c.
summary_zh: 检查g中仪式等级合计是否大于或等于c所需的lv。
core_summary_en: Checks greater-or-equal Ritual Material Level total.

returns.description: true if g reaches at least lv.

summary_en: Graveyard Ritual Material filter; c must be a Level monster accepted by f and able to be banished.
summary_zh: 墓地仪式素材筛选；c必须是f接受的有等级怪兽，并且可以被除外。
core_summary_en: Graveyard Ritual Material filter.

returns.description: true if c is valid extra Graveyard Ritual Material.

summary_en: Checks whether c is a valid Ritual Monster that can be Ritual Summoned with the available material groups and the selected Equal or Greater level rule.
summary_zh: 检查c是否为可用现有素材组以及所选Equal或Greater等级规则进行仪式召唤的有效仪式怪兽。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c is a valid Ritual Summon target.

returns.description: true if c can be Ritual Summoned.

summary_en: Returns the operation function for configurable Ritual Summon effects. It selects the Ritual Monster and materials, releases or banishes the materials, Special Summons the monster, and runs extra callbacks.
summary_zh: 返回可配置仪式召唤效果的操作函数；选择仪式怪兽和素材，解放或除外素材，特殊召唤该怪兽，并执行额外回调。
core_summary_en: Returns the operation function for configurable Ritual Summon effects.

returns.description: Operation function for a configurable Ritual Summon effect.

summary_en: Returns the target function for configurable Ritual Summon effects. It checks Ritual Monsters and material pools, then registers Special Summon, banish, and extra target information.
summary_zh: 返回可配置仪式召唤效果的目标函数；检查仪式怪兽和素材池，并登记特殊召唤、除外及额外目标信息。
core_summary_en: Returns the target function for configurable Ritual Summon effects.

returns.description: Target function for a configurable Ritual Summon effect.

summary_en: Returns the local column for a Spell & Trap Zone sequence from the controller's viewpoint.
summary_zh: 从控制者视角返回魔法与陷阱区域序号对应的本地列编号。
core_summary_en: Returns the local column for a Spell & Trap Zone sequence.

returns.description: The local column index, or NULL_VALUE for invalid input.

summary_en: Checks whether every card in g shares at least one bit returned by f; groups of 0 or 1 card return true.
summary_zh: 检查g中的所有卡是否共享f返回值中的至少一个位；0张或1张卡的Group返回true。
core_summary_en: Checks shared bit values across a Group.

summary_en: Selection helper that first offers matching on-field cards with HINTMSG_FIELD_FIRST. If that selection is canceled, it restores the previous hint and falls back to Duel.SelectMatchingCard.
summary_zh: 选择辅助函数；先用HINTMSG_FIELD_FIRST提示玩家选择满足条件的场上卡。若取消该选择，则恢复之前的提示并回退到Duel.SelectMatchingCard。
core_summary_en: Selects matching cards, offering on-field cards first.

returns.description: The selected cards.

summary_en: Filters option tables by their condition, calls Duel.SelectOption with the available option labels, and returns the selected table's custom value or original index.
Each option is {condition, option[, value]}. If no condition is true, the helper returns nil. Its default index return is 1-based, unlike Duel.SelectOption's 0-based return.
summary_zh: 按条件筛选选项表，用可用选项文本调用Duel.SelectOption，并返回所选表的自定义值或原始序号。
每个选项为{condition, option[, value]}。没有条件成立时返回nil。默认返回的序号从1开始，不同于Duel.SelectOption从0开始。
core_summary_en: Selects from conditionally available options.
core_summary_zh: 从满足条件的选项中选择。

returns.description: Selected option value or 1-based option index; nil if no option is available.

summary_en: Lets tp build a selection that contains the same number of cards from g1 and g2.
except is removed from both groups before selection. The result can be nil if min is greater than the computed max.
summary_zh: 让tp构建一个从g1和g2中选取相同数量卡的选择结果。
except会先从两个Group中移除。若min大于计算出的max，结果可以为nil。
core_summary_en: Selects equal counts from two Groups.
core_summary_zh: 从两个Group中选择相同数量。

params.name: min
params.description: default: 1

params.name: max
params.description: default: min(#g1, #g2, 127)

summary_en: Target-selection helper that first offers matching on-field effect targets with HINTMSG_FIELD_FIRST. If accepted, it sets those cards as targets; otherwise it restores the previous hint and falls back to Duel.SelectTarget.
summary_zh: 取对象选择辅助函数；先用HINTMSG_FIELD_FIRST提示玩家选择满足条件的场上效果对象。若接受则登记为对象；否则恢复之前的提示并回退到Duel.SelectTarget。
core_summary_en: Selects matching effect targets, offering on-field cards first.

returns.description: The selected target cards.

summary_en: Returns true if c has a flag with id, used by Auxiliary.IsSelfEquip to identify cards equipped by their own effect.
summary_zh: c持有id标记时返回true；Auxiliary.IsSelfEquip用它判断由自身效果装备的卡。
core_summary_en: Filter used by Auxiliary.IsSelfEquip.

returns.description: true if c has the flag id.

summary_en: Converts a player's local Monster Zone or Spell & Trap Zone sequence into a global zone bit. Invalid players, locations, or sequences return 0.
Monster Zone bits are shifted by 16*p+seq; Spell & Trap Zone bits are shifted by 16*p+seq+8.
summary_zh: 把玩家本地的怪兽区域或魔法与陷阱区域序号转换为全局区域位。玩家、位置或序号无效时返回0。
怪兽区域位按16*p+seq位移；魔法与陷阱区域位按16*p+seq+8位移。
core_summary_en: Converts a local zone sequence to a global zone bit.
core_summary_zh: 把本地区域序号转换为全局区域位。

params.name: p
params.description: Player whose local field sequence is converted.
params.description_zh: 要转换其本地区域序号的玩家。

params.name: loc
params.description: LOCATION_MZONE or LOCATION_SZONE.
params.description_zh: LOCATION_MZONE或LOCATION_SZONE。

params.name: seq
params.description: Sequence inside loc. Monster Zone sequences up to 6 are accepted; Spell & Trap Zone sequences up to 4 are accepted.
params.description_zh: loc中的序号。怪兽区域可接受到6；魔法与陷阱区域可接受到4。

returns.description: The global zone bit, or 0 for invalid input.
returns.description_zh: 全局区域位；输入无效时为0。

summary_en: Applies the equipped Union state to c after it becomes equipped.
If c has an EFFECT_UNION_LIMIT effect, this registers the matching EFFECT_EQUIP_LIMIT and EFFECT_UNION_STATUS reset effects. Old Union cards also receive EFFECT_OLDUNION_STATUS.
summary_zh: 在c成为装备卡后，为其适用已装备的同盟状态。
若c具有EFFECT_UNION_LIMIT效果，则登记对应的EFFECT_EQUIP_LIMIT和EFFECT_UNION_STATUS重置效果。旧式同盟卡还会获得EFFECT_OLDUNION_STATUS。
core_summary_en: Sets equipped Union state.

summary_en: Condition for the mandatory Spirit Monster End Phase return effect. It returns true while the handler is not prevented from returning and does not have the optional-return permission effect.
summary_zh: 灵魂怪兽结束阶段强制回到手牌效果的条件；处理对象没有禁止回手效果，且没有可选择不回手效果时返回true。
core_summary_en: Condition for the mandatory Spirit Monster End Phase return effect.

returns.description: true if the mandatory Spirit return effect should apply.

summary_en: Condition for the optional Spirit Monster End Phase return effect. It returns true while the handler is not prevented from returning and does have the optional-return permission effect.
summary_zh: 灵魂怪兽结束阶段可选回到手牌效果的条件；处理对象没有禁止回手效果，且具有可选择不回手效果时返回true。
core_summary_en: Condition for the optional Spirit Monster End Phase return effect.

returns.description: true if the optional Spirit return effect should apply.

summary_en: Operation for the shared Spirit Monster End Phase return effect. If the handler is still related to the effect, it returns that card to the hand.
summary_zh: 灵魂怪兽共通结束阶段回到手牌效果的操作；处理对象仍与效果关联时，将其回到手牌。
core_summary_en: Operation for the shared Spirit Monster End Phase return effect.

summary_en: Registers the temporary End Phase return effects created by Auxiliary.EnableSpiritReturn: one mandatory trigger and one optional trigger.
summary_zh: 登记Auxiliary.EnableSpiritReturn创建的临时结束阶段回手效果：1个强制触发效果和1个可选触发效果。
core_summary_en: Registers the temporary Spirit Monster End Phase return effects.

summary_en: Target function for the mandatory Spirit Monster End Phase return effect. During the check step it always returns true, then registers return-to-hand operation info.
summary_zh: 灵魂怪兽结束阶段强制回到手牌效果的目标函数；检查阶段始终返回true，之后登记回到手牌的操作信息。
core_summary_en: Target function for the mandatory Spirit Monster End Phase return effect.

returns.description: true during target checks; otherwise no meaningful return value.

summary_en: Target function for the optional Spirit Monster End Phase return effect. During the check step it requires the handler to be able to return to the hand, then registers return-to-hand operation info.
summary_zh: 灵魂怪兽结束阶段可选回到手牌效果的目标函数；检查阶段要求处理对象可以回到手牌，之后登记回到手牌的操作信息。
core_summary_en: Target function for the optional Spirit Monster End Phase return effect.

returns.description: true during valid target checks; otherwise no meaningful return value.

summary_en: Returns the card-string id for card code and string index id. The index starts at 0 and is commonly passed to Effect.SetDescription, Duel.Hint, or selection prompts.
core_summary_en: Returns the card-string id for card code and string index id.
core_summary_zh: 返回卡片code的第id个卡片字符串编号；id从0开始。

summary_en: Returns the condition function for basic Synchro Summon procedures, including optional fixed tuner material handling.
summary_zh: 返回基础同调召唤手续的条件函数，并支持可选的固定调整素材处理。
core_summary_en: Returns the condition function for basic Synchro Summon procedures.

returns.description: Condition function for a basic Synchro Summon procedure.

summary_en: Returns a group check for Synchro material selection that keeps the sum of the selected materials' minimum Synchro Levels at or below syncard's Level.
summary_zh: 返回同调素材选择使用的组检查函数；要求已选素材的最小同调等级合计不超过syncard的等级。
core_summary_en: Returns a group check for Synchro material selection.

returns.description: Group check for Synchro material Level pruning.

summary_en: Returns true when limiter function f exists and rejects c for syncard.
summary_zh: 限制函数f存在且拒绝c作为syncard的素材时返回true。
core_summary_en: Checks a Synchro material limit function.

returns.description: true if f rejects c.

summary_en: Synchro Material filter; c must be face-up or public and usable as Synchro Material for syncard.
summary_zh: 同调素材筛选；c必须表侧表示或公开，并且可以作为syncard的同调素材。
core_summary_en: Synchro Material filter.

returns.description: true if c is usable Synchro Material.

summary_en: Checks whether the remaining mixed Synchro Material pool can complete the selected fixed-material group within the variable material count range.
summary_zh: 检查剩余混合同调素材池是否能在可变素材数量范围内，完成当前已选固定素材组。
core_summary_en: Checks whether a mixed Synchro Material selection can be completed.

returns.description: true if the mixed Synchro Material selection can be completed.

summary_en: Final mixed Synchro Material group check. It validates count, Extra Monster Zone availability, group callback, fixed material, mandatory Synchro Materials, EFFECT_TUNE_MAGICIAN restrictions, Level total, hand-material limits, and tuner limits.
summary_zh: 混合同调素材组的最终检查；验证数量、额外怪兽区域、组回调、指定素材、必须同调素材、EFFECT_TUNE_MAGICIAN限制、等级合计、手牌素材限制以及调整限制。
core_summary_en: Final mixed Synchro Material group check.

returns.description: true if sg plus sg1 is a valid mixed Synchro Material group.

summary_en: Pruning check for mixed Synchro searches; returns true once the selected materials' minimum Synchro Level total reaches syncard's Level.
summary_zh: 混合同调搜索的剪枝检查；当已选素材的最小同调等级合计达到syncard等级时返回true。
core_summary_en: Pruning check for mixed Synchro searches.

returns.description: true if the branch can be pruned by minimum Synchro Level total.

summary_en: Recursive mixed Synchro Material search helper. It temporarily adds c, checks the goal, and continues through mg while the branch remains possible.
summary_zh: 混合同调素材搜索的递归辅助函数；临时加入c，检查目标，并在分支仍可能成立时继续搜索mg。
core_summary_en: Recursive mixed Synchro Material search helper.

returns.description: true if the recursive search can reach a valid group.

summary_en: Returns the condition function for mixed Synchro Summon procedures with up to three fixed material filters and a variable material slot.
summary_zh: 返回混合同调召唤手续的条件函数；支持最多3个固定素材筛选和1个可变素材位置。
core_summary_en: Returns the condition function for mixed Synchro Summon procedures.

returns.description: Condition function for a mixed Synchro Summon procedure.

summary_en: First fixed-material candidate filter for mixed Synchro procedures.
summary_zh: 混合同调手续的第1个固定素材候选筛选。
core_summary_en: First fixed-material candidate filter for mixed Synchro procedures.

returns.description: true if c can fill the first fixed material slot.

summary_en: Second fixed-material candidate filter for mixed Synchro procedures, or the transition into the variable material slot when no second filter is required.
summary_zh: 混合同调手续的第2个固定素材候选筛选；若不需要第2个筛选，则转入可变素材位置。
core_summary_en: Second fixed-material candidate filter for mixed Synchro procedures.

returns.description: true if c can fill the second fixed material slot or advance selection.

summary_en: Third fixed-material candidate filter for mixed Synchro procedures, or the transition into the variable material slot when no third filter is required.
summary_zh: 混合同调手续的第3个固定素材候选筛选；若不需要第3个筛选，则转入可变素材位置。
core_summary_en: Third fixed-material candidate filter for mixed Synchro procedures.

returns.description: true if c can fill the third fixed material slot or advance selection.

summary_en: Variable-slot candidate filter for mixed Synchro procedures; after adding c it checks whether the remaining material pool can complete the summon.
summary_zh: 混合同调手续的可变素材候选筛选；加入c后检查剩余素材池是否还能完成召唤。
core_summary_en: Variable-slot candidate filter for mixed Synchro procedures.

returns.description: true if c can fill the variable material slot.

summary_en: Checks whether selected hand Synchro Materials are allowed by a material that grants hand Synchro use, including filter and count limits.
summary_zh: 检查已选手牌同调素材是否由允许使用手牌同调素材的卡支持，并验证筛选和数量限制。
core_summary_en: Checks selected hand Synchro Materials.

returns.description: true if hand Synchro Materials in g are legal.

summary_en: Returns true for a hand material that is being used because another card enables it, rather than by its own extra Synchro Material effect.
summary_zh: 当手牌素材是因为其他卡允许而被使用、不是依靠自身额外同调素材效果时返回true。
core_summary_en: Hand Synchro Material filter.

returns.description: true if c is a hand material enabled by another card.

summary_en: Returns the operation function for mixed Synchro Summon procedures; it sets materials, sends them to the Graveyard, and releases the kept group.
summary_zh: 返回混合同调召唤手续的操作函数；设置素材，把素材送去墓地，并释放保留的Group。
core_summary_en: Returns the operation function for mixed Synchro Summon procedures.

returns.description: Operation function for a mixed Synchro Summon procedure.

summary_en: Returns the target function for mixed Synchro Summon procedures; it guides material selection and stores the selected group on the effect.
summary_zh: 返回混合同调召唤手续的目标函数；引导素材选择，并把选择的Group保存在效果上。
core_summary_en: Returns the target function for mixed Synchro Summon procedures.

returns.description: Target function for a mixed Synchro Summon procedure.

summary_en: Returns the operation function for basic Synchro Summon procedures; it sets materials, sends them to the Graveyard, and releases the kept group.
summary_zh: 返回基础同调召唤手续的操作函数；设置素材，把素材送去墓地，并释放保留的Group。
core_summary_en: Returns the operation function for basic Synchro Summon procedures.

returns.description: Operation function for a basic Synchro Summon procedure.

summary_en: Returns the target function for basic Synchro Summon procedures; it selects Synchro Materials and stores the selected group on the effect.
summary_zh: 返回基础同调召唤手续的目标函数；选择同调素材并把选择的Group保存在效果上。
core_summary_en: Returns the target function for basic Synchro Summon procedures.

returns.description: Target function for a basic Synchro Summon procedure.

summary_en: Returns true.
summary_zh: 返回true。
core_summary_en: Returns true.

returns.description: Always true.

summary_en: Returns an effect target callback that calls f(target, ...) with the extra arguments captured now.
Use this when SetTarget or similar APIs expect a function with parameters (effect, target).
summary_zh: 返回效果目标回调函数；调用时会执行f(target, ...)并使用当前捕获的额外参数。
适用于SetTarget等需要(effect, target)形式函数的API。
core_summary_en: Wraps a Card predicate for APIs that expect an effect target callback.

returns.description: A target callback with parameters (effect, target).

summary_en: Returns an effect target-value function that calls f on the target card and extra arguments, then checks whether the result equals value.
summary_zh: 返回效果对象Value函数：对对象卡和额外参数调用f，并检查结果是否等于value。
core_summary_en: Builds equality target-value function.

summary_en: Condition callback used by Auxiliary.AddThisCardInGraveAlreadyCheck. When this card is sent to the Graveyard by an effect, material use, or non-activated cost, it stores the responsible effect and installs reset effects; it then returns false so no separate effect operation runs.
summary_zh: Auxiliary.AddThisCardInGraveAlreadyCheck使用的条件回调；当此卡因效果、作为素材或未发动的费用送去墓地时，保存相关效果并登记重置效果，随后返回false让自身不再执行操作。
core_summary_en: Condition callback for Auxiliary.AddThisCardInGraveAlreadyCheck.

returns.description: Always false after any tracking setup is done.

summary_en: Clears the stored responsible effect from the tracking effect and resets this temporary reset effect.
summary_zh: 清除跟踪效果保存的相关效果，并重置这个临时重置效果。
core_summary_en: Clears the stored responsible effect and resets this temporary reset effect.

summary_en: Clears the stored responsible effect through the paired reset effect, then resets both temporary reset effects.
summary_zh: 通过配对的重置效果清除保存的相关效果，并重置两个临时重置效果。
core_summary_en: Clears the stored responsible effect and resets paired temporary reset effects.

summary_en: Reset check used by single-card merged delayed events. If the owner card is now face-up or public, it clears the stored event group.
summary_zh: 单卡合并延迟事件使用的重置检查；若持有者已经表侧表示或处于公开状态，则清空保存的事件Group。
core_summary_en: Clears the stored single-card merged-event group if the owner card is public.

summary_en: Returns whether c is a Special Summon procedure monster, used by Triamid Special Summon helpers.
summary_zh: 检查c是否是特殊召唤手续怪兽，供「三形金字塔」特殊召唤辅助函数使用。
core_summary_en: Checks Special Summon procedure type.
core_summary_zh: 检查特殊召唤手续类型。

summary_en: Deprecated factory that returns a group check rejecting groups with an invalid EFFECT_TUNE_MAGICIAN_* pair for ecode.
summary_zh: 已废弃的工厂函数；返回组检查函数，用于排除含有对ecode无效的EFFECT_TUNE_MAGICIAN_*组合的素材组。
core_summary_en: Deprecated factory for Tune Magician additional checks.

returns.description: Group check that rejects invalid EFFECT_TUNE_MAGICIAN_* pairs.

summary_en: Additional Xyz material group check that rejects invalid EFFECT_TUNE_MAGICIAN_X pairs.
summary_zh: 超量素材组的额外检查；排除无效的EFFECT_TUNE_MAGICIAN_X组合。
core_summary_en: Additional Xyz material group check for EFFECT_TUNE_MAGICIAN_X.

returns.description: true if g has no invalid EFFECT_TUNE_MAGICIAN_X pair.

summary_en: Checks whether c has an ecode effect whose value rejects at least one other card in selected group sg.
summary_zh: 检查c是否具有ecode效果，且该效果的Value会拒绝已选Group sg中的至少另一张卡。
core_summary_en: Checks Tune Magician material restrictions.

summary_en: Calls the effect's value function as f(e, c) and returns that result.
summary_zh: 取得效果e的Value函数并以f(e, c)调用，返回该结果。

summary_en: Returns a material filter that accepts cards that are Tuners for syncard and also satisfy f(target, ...), when f is supplied.
summary_zh: 返回一个素材筛选函数：接受对syncard来说是调整，且在提供f时满足f(target, ...)的卡。
core_summary_en: Creates a Tuner material filter.
core_summary_zh: 创建调整素材筛选函数。

summary_en: Returns an iterator that yields the current turn player first, then the other player.
summary_zh: 返回一个迭代器，先返回当前回合玩家，再返回另一名玩家。
core_summary_en: Returns an iterator over the current turn player and the other player.

returns.description: Iterator that yields the turn player, then the other player.

summary_en: Returns a filter for modern Union equip effects. The target must be face-up, controlled by tp, have no modern Union monster equipped, and satisfy filter.
summary_zh: 返回现代同盟怪兽装备效果使用的筛选函数；对象必须表侧表示、由tp控制、没有装备现代同盟怪兽，并满足filter。
core_summary_en: Returns the target filter for modern Union equip effects.

returns.description: Filter function taking Card c and int tp.

summary_en: Returns an Equip Limit value function for modern Union monsters. It allows cards controlled by the handler's player that satisfy filter, and also keeps the current equip target legal.
summary_zh: 返回现代同盟怪兽使用的装备限制Value函数；允许处理者玩家控制且满足filter的卡，并保持当前装备对象合法。
core_summary_en: Returns the Equip Limit value function for modern Union monsters.

returns.description: Equip Limit value function.

summary_en: Returns the operation function for the shared modern Union equip effect. It equips the handler to the selected target, or sends the handler to the Graveyard by rule if the target is no longer valid.
summary_zh: 返回现代同盟怪兽共通装备效果的操作函数；将处理对象装备给选中的目标，若目标不再有效则因规则把处理对象送去墓地。
core_summary_en: Returns the operation function for modern Union equip effects.

returns.description: Operation function for the shared Union equip effect.

summary_en: Returns the target function for the shared modern Union equip effect. It checks the once-per-turn Union flag, requires an open Spell & Trap Zone, selects a valid target, and registers equip operation info.
summary_zh: 返回现代同盟怪兽共通装备效果的目标函数；检查同盟次数标记、可用魔法与陷阱区域，选择有效目标，并登记装备操作信息。
core_summary_en: Returns the target function for modern Union equip effects.

returns.description: Target function for the shared Union equip effect.

summary_en: Destroy-substitute value function for modern Union monsters; returns true for destruction by battle or card effect.
summary_zh: 现代同盟怪兽的破坏代替Value函数；因战斗或卡片效果将被破坏时返回true。
core_summary_en: Destroy-substitute value function for modern Union monsters.

returns.description: true for destruction by battle or card effect.

summary_en: Operation for the shared modern Union unequip effect; Special Summons the handler in face-up position if it is still related to the effect.
summary_zh: 现代同盟怪兽共通解除装备效果的操作；处理对象仍与效果关联时，将其表侧表示特殊召唤。
core_summary_en: Operation for the shared modern Union unequip effect.

summary_en: Target function for the shared modern Union unequip effect. It checks the Union flag, available Monster Zone, current equip target, and whether the handler can be Special Summoned.
summary_zh: 现代同盟怪兽共通解除装备效果的目标函数；检查同盟次数标记、可用怪兽区域、当前装备对象，以及处理对象能否特殊召唤。
core_summary_en: Target function for the shared modern Union unequip effect.

returns.description: true during valid target checks; otherwise no meaningful return value.

summary_en: Replacement-cost filter for the shared Ursarctic Special Summon effect. It accepts cards in the Graveyard that can be banished as cost through effect code 16471775 or 89264428.
summary_zh: 「北极天熊」共通特殊召唤效果的代替费用筛选；匹配墓地中可作为费用除外，且具有编号16471775或89264428效果的卡。
core_summary_en: Replacement-cost filter for the shared Ursarctic Special Summon effect.

returns.description: true if c can be banished as an Ursarctic replacement cost.

summary_en: Cost filter for the shared Ursarctic Special Summon effect. It accepts Level 7 or higher monsters in the hand.
summary_zh: 「北极天熊」共通特殊召唤效果的费用筛选；匹配手牌中7星以上的怪兽。
core_summary_en: Release-cost filter for the shared Ursarctic Special Summon effect.

returns.description: true if c is a Level 7 or higher monster in the hand.

summary_en: Condition for the shared Ursarctic hand Quick Effect; returns true during either Main Phase.
summary_zh: 「北极天熊」共通手牌快速效果的条件；当前为任一主要阶段时返回true。
core_summary_en: Condition for the shared Ursarctic hand Quick Effect.

returns.description: true during Main Phase 1 or Main Phase 2.

summary_en: Checks and pays the shared Ursarctic Special Summon cost. The player releases a Level 7 or higher monster from the hand, or banishes a valid Graveyard replacement-cost card and consumes that effect's count limit.
summary_zh: 检查并支付「北极天熊」共通特殊召唤费用。玩家解放手牌中1只7星以上怪兽，或除外1张可用的墓地代替费用卡并使用对应效果的次数限制。
core_summary_en: Checks and pays the shared Ursarctic Special Summon cost.

returns.description: true during cost checks; otherwise no meaningful return value.

summary_en: Special Summon restriction target applied after the shared Ursarctic effect resolves; returns true for monsters with Level 0.
summary_zh: 「北极天熊」共通效果处理后登记的特殊召唤限制目标；对等级为0的怪兽返回true。
core_summary_en: Special Summon restriction target applied by the shared Ursarctic effect.

returns.description: true for Level 0 monsters.

summary_en: Operation for the shared Ursarctic Special Summon effect. It Special Summons the handler, then applies the End Phase Special Summon restriction that blocks Level 0 monsters.
summary_zh: 「北极天熊」共通特殊召唤效果的操作；特殊召唤处理对象后，登记直到结束阶段的特殊召唤限制，阻止等级为0的怪兽特殊召唤。
core_summary_en: Operation for the shared Ursarctic Special Summon effect.

summary_en: Target function for the shared Ursarctic Special Summon effect. It requires an open Monster Zone and that the handler can be Special Summoned, then sets Special Summon operation info.
summary_zh: 「北极天熊」共通特殊召唤效果的目标处理；要求有可用怪兽区域且处理对象可以特殊召唤，然后登记特殊召唤信息。
core_summary_en: Target function for the shared Ursarctic Special Summon effect.

returns.description: true during valid target checks; otherwise no meaningful return value.

summary_en: Consumes count limits for opponent's cards in g that were released through EFFECT_EXTRA_RELEASE_NONSUM, such as Lair of Darkness-style release effects not selected by Duel.SelectReleaseGroup.
summary_zh: 对g中通过EFFECT_EXTRA_RELEASE_NONSUM被解放的对方卡使用次数限制，用于未通过Duel.SelectReleaseGroup选择的额外解放效果。
core_summary_en: Consumes count limits for extra release effects used by cards in g.

summary_en: Checks whether c has a valid EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL effect for xyzc, optionally skipping the normal Xyz Material filter when checked is true.
summary_zh: 检查c是否具有对xyzc有效的EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL效果；checked为true时可跳过通常超量素材筛选。
core_summary_en: Checks EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL validity.

returns.description: true if c has a valid EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL effect.

summary_en: Xyz Material filter for double-material handling; c must be face-up or public, usable as Xyz Material for xyzc, match lv, and satisfy f when provided.
summary_zh: 双重素材处理用的超量素材筛选；c必须表侧表示或公开，可以作为xyzc的超量素材，匹配lv，并在提供f时满足f。
core_summary_en: Xyz Material filter for double-material handling.

returns.description: true if c is valid Xyz Material for double-material handling.

summary_en: Final group check for Xyz Summons that may use EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL. It validates Extra Monster Zone availability, EFFECT_XYZ_MIN_COUNT, and whether double-material effects cover minc.
summary_zh: 可能使用EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL的超量召唤最终组检查；验证额外怪兽区域、EFFECT_XYZ_MIN_COUNT，以及双重素材效果是否足以满足minc。
core_summary_en: Final group check for Xyz Summons using EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL.

returns.description: true if g satisfies the double-material Xyz requirements.

summary_en: Consumes the count limits for selected EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL cards needed for the selected group to satisfy the minimum material count.
summary_zh: 为已选素材组中需要用于满足最小素材数量的EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL卡消耗次数限制。
core_summary_en: Consumes count limits for selected EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL cards.

summary_en: Alternate Xyz Summon candidate filter. It checks alterf, Xyz Material legality, Extra Monster Zone availability, mandatory Xyz Materials, EFFECT_XYZ_MIN_COUNT, and optional alterop validation.
summary_zh: 替代超量召唤候选筛选；检查alterf、超量素材合法性、额外怪兽区域、必须超量素材、EFFECT_XYZ_MIN_COUNT以及可选alterop验证。
core_summary_en: Alternate Xyz Summon candidate filter.

returns.description: true if c is a valid alternate Xyz Material.

summary_en: Returns the condition function for standard Xyz Summon procedures, including optional alternate one-card Xyz Summon and EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL handling.
summary_zh: 返回标准超量召唤手续的条件函数，支持可选的1张素材替代超量召唤以及EFFECT_DOUBLE_XMATERIAL处理。
core_summary_en: Returns the condition function for standard Xyz Summon procedures.

returns.description: Condition function for a standard Xyz Summon procedure.

summary_en: Returns the condition function for Level-free Xyz Summon procedures with optional group filter and alternate one-card Xyz Summon support.
summary_zh: 返回不检查等级的超量召唤手续的条件函数，支持可选组筛选和1张素材替代超量召唤。
core_summary_en: Returns the condition function for Level-free Xyz Summon procedures.

returns.description: Condition function for a Level-free Xyz Summon procedure.

summary_en: Level-free Xyz Material filter; c must be face-up if on the field, usable as Xyz Material for xyzc, and satisfy f when provided.
summary_zh: 不检查等级的超量素材筛选；c在场上时必须表侧表示，可以作为xyzc的超量素材，并在提供f时满足f。
core_summary_en: Level-free Xyz Material filter.

returns.description: true if c is valid Level-free Xyz Material.

summary_en: Final group check for Level-free Xyz Summons. It validates Extra Monster Zone availability, optional group filter gf, and EFFECT_XYZ_MIN_COUNT requirements.
summary_zh: 不检查等级的超量召唤最终组检查；验证额外怪兽区域、可选组筛选gf以及EFFECT_XYZ_MIN_COUNT要求。
core_summary_en: Final group check for Level-free Xyz Summons.

returns.description: true if g satisfies the Level-free Xyz requirements.

summary_en: Returns the operation function for Level-free Xyz Summon procedures; it handles alternate summons, sends old overlay cards to the Graveyard by rule, sets materials, and overlays them.
summary_zh: 返回不检查等级的超量召唤手续操作函数；处理替代召唤，把原本叠放素材因规则送去墓地，设置素材并叠放。
core_summary_en: Returns the operation function for Level-free Xyz Summon procedures.

returns.description: Operation function for a Level-free Xyz Summon procedure.

summary_en: Returns the target function for Level-free Xyz Summon procedures; it chooses between alternate material and regular group selection and stores the selected group.
summary_zh: 返回不检查等级的超量召唤手续目标函数；在替代素材和通常组选素材之间选择，并保存所选Group。
core_summary_en: Returns the target function for Level-free Xyz Summon procedures.

returns.description: Target function for a Level-free Xyz Summon procedure.

summary_en: Returns the operation function for standard Xyz Summon procedures; it handles alternate summons, double-material count limits, sends old overlay cards to the Graveyard by rule, sets materials, and overlays them.
summary_zh: 返回标准超量召唤手续的操作函数；处理替代召唤、双重素材次数限制，把原本叠放素材因规则送去墓地，设置素材并叠放。
core_summary_en: Returns the operation function for standard Xyz Summon procedures.

returns.description: Operation function for a standard Xyz Summon procedure.

summary_en: Returns the target function for standard Xyz Summon procedures; it chooses between alternate material, double-material group selection, and regular Xyz Material selection.
summary_zh: 返回标准超量召唤手续的目标函数；在替代素材、双重素材组选取以及通常超量素材选择之间进行处理。
core_summary_en: Returns the target function for standard Xyz Summon procedures.

returns.description: Target function for a standard Xyz Summon procedure.

summary_en: Battle-destroying condition helper that returns true while the handler is still related to battle.
summary_zh: 战斗破坏条件辅助函数：处理对象仍与战斗相关时返回true。
core_summary_en: Checks battle relation.

summary_en: Battle-destroying condition helper for a handler whose battle target is a monster in the Graveyard.
summary_zh: 战斗破坏条件辅助函数：处理对象的战斗对象是墓地中的怪兽时返回true。
core_summary_en: Checks battle destruction to the Graveyard.
core_summary_zh: 检查战斗破坏送去墓地。

summary_en: Condition helper for EVENT_BATTLE_DESTROYING effects; it returns true when the handler is still related to battle and battled an opponent's monster.
summary_zh: EVENT_BATTLE_DESTROYING效果常用的条件辅助函数；处理者仍与战斗关联并且和对方怪兽战斗时返回true。
core_summary_en: Checks the opponent-battle EVENT_BATTLE_DESTROYING condition.
core_summary_zh: 检查对方怪兽战斗破坏条件。

summary_en: Condition helper for a battle-destroying monster: the handler is still related to battle, battled an opponent's monster, and that battle target is a monster in the GY.
summary_zh: 战斗破坏用条件辅助函数：处理对象仍与战斗相关，和对方怪兽进行过战斗，且该战斗对象是墓地中的怪兽。
core_summary_en: Condition helper for battle-destroying effects.
core_summary_zh: 战斗破坏效果用条件辅助函数。

summary_en: Shared cost function that checks whether the handler can be banished as cost, then banishes it face-up as REASON_COST.
Returns true if the player can enter the Battle Phase, or if the current phase is already within the Battle Phase window.
summary_zh: 判断玩家是否可以进入战斗阶段，或当前阶段是否已经处于战斗阶段范围内。

summary_en: Registers FLAG_ID_CHAINING on e's handler if that flag is not already present.
The flag resets by the standard event reset, except turn Set reset, and also at the end of the Chain.
summary_zh: 若效果e的处理者还没有FLAG_ID_CHAINING，则给其登记该标记效果。
该标记按标准事件重置，但不因回合盖放重置，并会在连锁结束时重置。
core_summary_en: Registers the chaining flag on e's handler.
core_summary_zh: 给效果e的处理者登记连锁标记。

summary_en: Returns true if every card in g has a different Attribute.
summary_zh: 判断g中的每张卡是否具有不同属性。

summary_en: Condition helper for effects that would make player tp take effect damage.
It checks the operation info for damage to tp, or recovery to tp that is reversed into damage, and respects EFFECT_REVERSE_DAMAGE, EFFECT_REVERSE_RECOVER, and EFFECT_NO_EFFECT_DAMAGE.
summary_zh: 用于判断玩家tp是否会受到效果伤害的条件辅助函数。
它检查操作信息中对tp造成的伤害，或被反转成伤害的对tp恢复，并会考虑EFFECT_REVERSE_DAMAGE、EFFECT_REVERSE_RECOVER和EFFECT_NO_EFFECT_DAMAGE。
core_summary_en: Condition helper for taking effect damage.
core_summary_zh: 受到效果伤害的条件辅助函数。

summary_en: Returns true if every card in g has a different Link Rating.
summary_zh: 判断g中的每张卡是否具有不同连接数值。

summary_en: Returns true if every card in g has a different Level.
summary_zh: 判断g中的每张卡是否具有不同等级。

summary_en: Returns true if every card in g has a different card code.
summary_zh: 判断g中的每张卡是否具有不同卡名编号。

summary_en: EVENT_TO_GRAVE condition helper that checks whether the handler was previously controlled by tp and destroyed by the opponent.
summary_zh: EVENT_TO_GRAVE条件辅助函数，检查处理对象先前由tp控制且被对方破坏。
core_summary_en: Destroyed-by-opponent EVENT_TO_GRAVE condition.
core_summary_zh: 被对方破坏送去墓地条件。

summary_en: Condition for EVENT_TO_GRAVE triggers: true when the handler was previously on the field under tp's control, was destroyed, and the opponent was the reason player.
summary_zh: EVENT_TO_GRAVE触发条件：处理对象之前在tp场上，被破坏，且原因玩家是对方时返回true。

summary_en: Returns true if every card in g has a different Race.
summary_zh: 判断g中的每张卡是否具有不同种族。

summary_en: Returns true if every card in g has a different Rank.
summary_zh: 判断g中的每张卡是否具有不同阶级。

summary_en: Condition for Quick Effects that change ATK/DEF; true outside the Damage Phase, or during the Damage Phase before damage calculation has been performed.
summary_zh: 改变攻击力/守备力的快速效果条件；不在伤害阶段时为true，或在伤害阶段且尚未进行伤害计算时为true。

summary_en: Condition for EVENT_DAMAGE_STEP_END effects; true if the handler is still related to battle or was battle destroyed.
summary_zh: EVENT_DAMAGE_STEP_END效果的条件；处理对象仍与战斗关联，或已被战斗破坏时返回true。

summary_en: Special Summon condition helper for Evolsaur-style effects and set 0x304e monster Special Summons.
summary_zh: 进化龙式效果以及0x304e系列怪兽特殊召唤用的特殊召唤条件辅助函数。
core_summary_en: Checks Evolsaur-style Special Summon state.
core_summary_zh: 检查进化龙式特殊召唤状态。

summary_en: Condition helper for effects that cannot be activated during the same turn their handler was sent to the GY, unless that handler was returned.
summary_zh: 用于“送去墓地的当回合不能发动”类效果的条件辅助函数；处理者不是本回合送去墓地，或处理者因返回而记录原因时返回true。
core_summary_en: Checks the shared GY timing condition for the handler.
core_summary_zh: 检查处理者的共通墓地时点条件。

summary_en: Special Summon condition helper that returns true when summon type st contains SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION.
summary_zh: 特殊召唤条件辅助函数；当召唤类型st包含SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION时返回true。
core_summary_en: Checks whether st includes SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION.

summary_en: Special Summon condition helper for Gladiator Beast-style returns and set 0x1019 monster Special Summons.
summary_zh: 剑斗兽式返回以及0x1019系列怪兽特殊召唤用的特殊召唤条件辅助函数。
core_summary_en: Checks Gladiator Beast-style Special Summon state.
core_summary_zh: 检查剑斗兽式特殊召唤状态。

summary_en: Checks a 2-card group against one filter in either order: one card must satisfy f(c,a1) and the other f(c,a2).
summary_zh: 检查2张卡的Group是否能按任意顺序满足同一个筛选：一张满足f(c,a1)，另一张满足f(c,a2)。
core_summary_en: Checks a 2-card group against one filter in either order.

returns.description: true if the two cards satisfy the filter in either order.

summary_en: Checks a 2-card group against two filters in either order: one card must satisfy f1(c,a1) and the other f2(c,a2).
summary_zh: 检查2张卡的Group是否能按任意顺序满足两个筛选：一张满足f1(c,a1)，另一张满足f2(c,a2)。
core_summary_en: Checks a 2-card group against two filters in either order.

returns.description: true if the two cards satisfy both filters in either order.

summary_en: Default value helper for EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_BATTLE_TARGET; it returns true when c is not immune to e.
summary_zh: EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_BATTLE_TARGET默认Value辅助函数；c不免疫e时返回true。
core_summary_en: Default battle-target immunity value helper.
core_summary_zh: 战斗对象免疫检查用默认Value辅助函数。

summary_en: Value helper for indestructibility against opponent's effects; it returns true when rp is the opponent of e's handler player.
summary_zh: 对方效果破坏耐性使用的Value辅助函数；当rp是效果e处理者玩家的对方时返回true。
core_summary_en: Returns true for opponent-effect indestructibility checks.
core_summary_zh: 对方效果破坏耐性检查用辅助函数。

summary_en: Value helper for self-protection from effect destruction; it returns true when the reason player is the handler's player.
summary_zh: 自身效果破坏保护用Value辅助函数；原因玩家是处理对象玩家时返回true。
core_summary_en: Self effect-destruction protection value.

summary_en: Special Summon condition helper that returns true only when st contains SUMMON_TYPE_LINK.
summary_zh: 特殊召唤条件辅助函数：仅当st包含SUMMON_TYPE_LINK时返回true。
core_summary_en: Checks Link Summon type.

summary_en: Returns true if tp would have an open Monster Zone after releasing g.
summary_zh: 判断tp在解放g之后是否会有可用怪兽区域。
core_summary_en: Checks whether tp would have an open Monster Zone after releasing g.

returns.description: true if tp has an open Monster Zone after releasing g.

summary_en: Checks whether releasing group g by reason leaves a Monster Zone and g is a valid release group for tp.
summary_zh: 检查因reason解放g后是否留下怪兽区域，并且g是否是tp可用的有效解放组。
core_summary_en: Checks Monster Zone count after releasing g.
core_summary_zh: 检查解放g后的怪兽区域数量。

params.name: reason
params.description: default: REASON_COST

summary_en: Condition helper for effects that negate an activation and banish the activating card. It requires tp to be able to banish, and the activating card must either no longer be related to its effect or be able to be banished.
summary_zh: 「把发动无效并除外」类效果的条件辅助函数；要求tp可以除外，且发动的卡不再与其效果关联，或仍关联但可以被除外。
core_summary_en: Condition helper for effects that negate an activation and banish the activating card.

returns.description: true if the activation can be negated and the card can be banished if needed.

summary_en: Target helper for effects that negate an activation and banish the activating card. It sets negate operation info, adds banish info when the activating card is still related, and marks CATEGORY_GRAVE_ACTION for effects activated in the Graveyard.
summary_zh: 「把发动无效并除外」类效果的目标辅助函数；登记无效信息，发动的卡仍与效果关联时登记除外信息，并在效果从墓地发动时标记CATEGORY_GRAVE_ACTION。

summary_en: Condition helper for effects that negate an activation and return the activating card to the Deck. It accepts Spell/Trap activations, unrelated cards, or related cards that can be returned to the Deck.
summary_zh: 「把发动无效并回到卡组」类效果的条件辅助函数；魔法/陷阱的发动、已不与效果关联的卡，或仍关联且可以回到卡组的卡均满足。
core_summary_en: Condition helper for effects that negate an activation and return the activating card to the Deck.

returns.description: true if the activation can be negated and the card can be returned to the Deck if needed.

summary_en: Filter helper that is true for face-up cards with current ATK greater than 0.
summary_zh: 筛选辅助函数：表侧表示且当前攻击力大于0的卡返回true。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c is face-up with positive ATK.
core_summary_zh: 检查c是否表侧表示且攻击力大于0。

summary_en: Returns true for face-up cards with current DEF greater than 0.
summary_zh: 表侧表示且当前守备力大于0的卡返回true。
core_summary_en: Checks face-up nonzero DEF.

summary_en: Special Summon condition helper that returns true only when st contains SUMMON_TYPE_PENDULUM.
summary_zh: 特殊召唤条件辅助函数：仅当st包含SUMMON_TYPE_PENDULUM时返回true。
core_summary_en: Checks Pendulum Summon type.

summary_en: Qli immunity value helper.
It accepts activated monster effects from monsters whose original Level or Rank is lower than the handler's current Level, and rejects Link Monsters.
summary_zh: 机壳免疫用Value辅助函数。
接受由原本等级或阶级低于处理对象当前等级的怪兽发动的怪兽效果，并拒绝连接怪兽。
core_summary_en: Qli monster immunity filter.

summary_en: Special Summon condition helper that returns true only when the Summon Type contains SUMMON_TYPE_RITUAL.
summary_zh: 特殊召唤条件辅助函数：仅当召唤类型包含SUMMON_TYPE_RITUAL时返回true。
core_summary_en: Checks for Ritual Summon type.
core_summary_zh: 检查是否为仪式召唤类型。

summary_en: For each card in eg whose original code equals e's label, registers a same-code flag effect that lasts through the End Phase/reset.
summary_zh: 对eg中原本卡号等于e的Label的每张卡登记同卡号的标志效果，持续到结束阶段/重置。
core_summary_en: Registers same-code summon flags.

summary_en: Special Summon condition helper that returns true only when st contains SUMMON_TYPE_SYNCHRO.
summary_zh: 特殊召唤条件辅助函数：仅当st包含SUMMON_TYPE_SYNCHRO时返回true。
core_summary_en: Checks Synchro Summon type.

summary_en: Shared value function for EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_EFFECT_TARGET effects that protect against the opponent's effects.
It returns true when the reason player rp is the opponent of e's handler player.
summary_zh: EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_EFFECT_TARGET常用的Value函数，用于防止成为对方效果的对象。
当原因玩家rp是e处理对象玩家的对方时返回true。

summary_en: Value helper for self-targeting protection; it returns true when the reason player is the handler's player.
summary_zh: 自身对象保护用Value辅助函数；原因玩家是处理对象玩家时返回true。
core_summary_en: Self effect-target protection value.

summary_en: Returns true if tp controls a Token on the field. If tp is omitted and e is provided, tp defaults to e's handler player.
summary_zh: 判断tp场上是否存在衍生物。省略tp且提供e时，tp默认使用e的持有者玩家。
core_summary_en: Checks whether tp controls a Token.

returns.description: true if tp controls a Token on the field.

summary_en: Special Summon condition helper that returns true only when st contains SUMMON_TYPE_XYZ.
summary_zh: 特殊召唤条件辅助函数：仅当st包含SUMMON_TYPE_XYZ时返回true。

summary_en: Attempts to add count counters of countertype to c and returns whether the core accepted the addition.

The card must be affected by the resolving reason effect. The current reason player is used as the player adding the counters. When singly is true, counter-limit checks allow a partial addition up to the remaining limit.
summary_zh: 尝试给c放置count个countertype类型的指示物，并返回核心是否接受该次放置。
c必须受当前处理中的原因效果影响。放置指示物的玩家使用当前原因玩家。singly为true时，指示物上限检查允许只放置到剩余上限为止。
core_summary_en: Adds counters to c through the current reason effect.
core_summary_zh: 通过当前原因效果给c放置指示物。

params.name: singly
params.description: default: false

summary_en: Adds temporary monster properties to c through effects.
The binding clears STATUS_NO_LEVEL, applies EFFECT_PRE_MONSTER with type, and applies Attribute, Race, Level, base ATK, and base DEF changes for nonzero supplied values.
summary_zh: 通过效果给c追加临时怪兽属性。
该绑定会清除STATUS_NO_LEVEL，用type适用EFFECT_PRE_MONSTER，并对非零的属性、种族、等级、基础攻击力和基础守备力数值适用对应变更效果。
core_summary_en: Adds temporary monster properties to c.

params.name: attribute
params.description: default: 0

params.name: race
params.description: default: 0

params.name: level
params.description: default: 0

params.name: atk
params.description: default: 0

params.name: def
params.description: default: 0

summary_en: Temporarily assumes one property of c for core checks.
assume_type is one of ASSUME_CODE, ASSUME_TYPE, ASSUME_LEVEL, ASSUME_RANK, ASSUME_ATTRIBUTE, ASSUME_RACE, ASSUME_ATTACK, or ASSUME_DEFENSE.
summary_zh: 临时假定c的一个属性供核心检查使用。
assume_type可为ASSUME_CODE、ASSUME_TYPE、ASSUME_LEVEL、ASSUME_RANK、ASSUME_ATTRIBUTE、ASSUME_RACE、ASSUME_ATTACK或ASSUME_DEFENSE。
core_summary_en: Sets assumed property for core checks.
core_summary_zh: 设置核心检查用假定属性。

summary_en: Removes target from c's persistent card-target relation list.
summary_zh: 把target从c的持续卡片对象关系中移除。
core_summary_en: Cancels persistent card target.

summary_en: Cancels the confirmed-to-Graveyard state for c. If cancel is false, sets that state again.

This state is used for non-continuous Spell/Trap Cards activated on the field before they leave the field; while set, they cannot return to the hand or Deck and are sent to the Graveyard when the Chain ends.
Use this helper to keep such cards on the field, as with Swords of Revealing Light or Scrap-Iron Scarecrow.
Checks whether c has an activation effect that can currently be activated.
If neglect_con is true, condition checks are skipped. If neglect_cost is true, cost checks are skipped.
When copy_info is true and the matching activation is not a free-chain activation, the returned values include the triggering event information: eg, ep, ev, re, r, and rp.
Returns no Lua values when no activation effect is currently usable, so local scripts usually compare the first result with nil.
summary_zh: 检查c是否有当前可以发动的卡片发动效果。
neglect_con为true时跳过Condition检查；neglect_cost为true时跳过Cost检查。
copy_info为true且匹配的发动效果不是自由时点发动时，返回值会包含触发时点信息：eg、ep、ev、re、r、rp。
没有可用发动效果时不返回Lua值，因此本地脚本通常检查第一个返回值是否不为nil。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c has a usable activation effect.
core_summary_zh: 检查c是否有可用的发动效果。

params.name: neglect_con
params.description: true to skip the activation effect's condition check.
params.description_zh: 为true时跳过该发动效果的Condition检查。

params.name: neglect_cost
params.description: true to skip the activation effect's cost check.
params.description_zh: 为true时跳过该发动效果的Cost检查。

params.name: copy_info
params.description: true to copy triggering-event information for non-free-chain activations.
params.description_zh: 为true时，对非自由时点发动复制触发时点信息。

returns.description: The usable activation effect, or nil/no value if none is currently usable.
returns.description_zh: 可用的发动效果；当前没有可用发动效果时为nil/不返回值。

returns.description: eg when copy_info returns event data.
returns.description_zh: copy_info返回事件信息时的eg。

returns.description: ep when copy_info returns event data.
returns.description_zh: copy_info返回事件信息时的ep。

returns.description: ev when copy_info returns event data.
returns.description_zh: copy_info返回事件信息时的ev。

returns.description: re when copy_info returns event data.
returns.description_zh: copy_info返回事件信息时的re。

returns.description: r when copy_info returns event data.
returns.description_zh: copy_info返回事件信息时的r。

returns.description: rp when copy_info returns event data.
returns.description_zh: copy_info返回事件信息时的rp。

summary_en: Checks whether c2 is a valid Equip target for c1.
The core requires c1 to be affected by an EFFECT_EQUIP_LIMIT that accepts c2, and it also enforces old and modern Union count limits.
summary_zh: 检查c2是否是c1的合法装备对象。
核心要求c1受到接受c2的EFFECT_EQUIP_LIMIT影响，并且还会检查旧式和现代同盟怪兽的装备数量限制。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c2 is a valid Equip target for c1.
core_summary_zh: 检查c2是否是c1的合法装备对象。

summary_en: Checks whether c's Fusion Material requirements can be satisfied by g, optionally requiring gc to be included.
chkf is forwarded to the Fusion Material condition check, and not_material is used by procedures that check material availability without treating the cards as actual materials yet.
summary_zh: 检查c的融合素材要求是否可以由g满足，并可要求必须包含gc。
chkf会传给融合素材条件检查；not_material用于只检查素材可用性、但暂不把卡视为实际素材的手续。

summary_en: Checks whether c can substitute for a specifically named Fusion Material listed by Fusion Monster fcard.
summary_zh: 检查c能否代替融合怪兽fcard所列名的指定融合素材。
core_summary_en: Checks Fusion substitute validity.
core_summary_zh: 检查融合素材代用是否合法。

summary_en: Checks whether player can remove at least count Xyz Materials from c for reason.
Replacement effects with EFFECT_OVERLAY_REMOVE_REPLACE can make this return true even when c itself has too few materials.
summary_zh: 检查player能否为了reason从c上取除至少count个超量素材。
即使c本身素材不足，可适用的EFFECT_OVERLAY_REMOVE_REPLACE替代效果也可能使该函数返回true。
core_summary_en: Checks whether player can remove Xyz Materials from c.
core_summary_zh: 检查player能否从c上取除超量素材。

summary_en: Checks whether target is a valid Union equip target for c under EFFECT_UNION_LIMIT.
The core also enforces new/old Union count compatibility between c and target.
summary_zh: 检查target是否是在EFFECT_UNION_LIMIT下c的合法同盟装备对象。
核心还会检查c与target之间的新式/旧式同盟数量兼容性。
core_summary_en: Checks Union equip target legality.
core_summary_zh: 检查同盟装备对象合法性。

summary_en: Checks whether c can coexist on check_player's field under the current unique-on-field rules.
check_location defaults to LOCATION_ONFIELD and is masked to on-field locations. icard can be supplied as an ignored card when testing a pending move.
summary_zh: 检查c在check_player场上是否满足当前唯一性规则，可以与已存在的卡共存。
check_location默认LOCATION_ONFIELD，并会被限制为场上位置；测试即将移动的卡时，可用icard指定一张忽略的卡。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c satisfies unique-on-field restrictions for check_player.
core_summary_zh: 检查c在check_player场上是否满足唯一性规则。

params.name: c
params.description: Card being tested against unique-on-field restrictions.

params.name: check_player
params.description: Player whose field is checked for a uniqueness conflict.

params.name: check_location
params.description: On-field location mask to check; default: LOCATION_ONFIELD. The core masks this value to LOCATION_ONFIELD.

params.name: icard
params.description: Optional card ignored during the check, useful when testing a pending replacement or move.

returns.description: True if c can coexist under the unique-on-field rules for the requested player and location.

summary_en: Clears all effect relations currently stored on c.
summary_zh: 清除c当前保存的全部效果关系。

summary_en: Marks c as having completed its proper Summon procedure.
summary_zh: 把c标记为已经完成正规召唤手续。

summary_en: Copies the initial_effect of card code onto c and returns the generated copy id, or -1 if code belongs to a Normal Monster.

reset defaults to RESETS_STANDARD when 0. count defaults to 1; phase resets without a turn side are normalized to both players' turns. If c is a non-Effect Monster, the core also adds TYPE_EFFECT for the same reset.
summary_zh: 把卡号code的initial_effect复制到c上，并返回生成的复制id；code对应通常怪兽时返回-1。
reset为0时默认RESETS_STANDARD。count默认1；带阶段重置但未指定自己/对方回合时，会规范为双方回合。若c是非效果怪兽，核心还会以同样重置条件追加TYPE_EFFECT。
core_summary_en: Copies another card's initial_effect.

params.name: count
params.description: default: 1

summary_en: Creates a relation between c and effect e.
If e is the triggering effect of a current Chain Link, the relation is tied to that Chain Link; otherwise the core stores a direct effect relation.
summary_zh: 在c与效果e之间建立关联。
若e是当前连锁中某个连锁环的发动效果，该关联会绑定到该连锁环；否则核心会保存直接的效果关联。
core_summary_en: Creates an effect relation for c.

summary_en: Creates a relation from c1 to c2 that is cleared by reset.
summary_zh: 建立从c1到c2的关系，并按reset清除。
core_summary_en: Creates a resettable card relation.
core_summary_zh: 建立可重置的卡片关系。

summary_en: Registers a single-card counter permit effect allowing c to receive counters of countertype in the chosen range.
If location is omitted, monsters default to LOCATION_MZONE and non-monsters default to LOCATION_SZONE + LOCATION_FZONE. An optional condition callback is stored on the permit effect.
summary_zh: 给c登记单卡的指示物许可效果，使其可以在指定范围放置countertype类型的指示物。
省略location时，怪兽默认LOCATION_MZONE，非怪兽默认LOCATION_SZONE + LOCATION_FZONE。提供condition时会作为该许可效果的条件回调保存。
core_summary_en: Registers a counter permit effect on c.
core_summary_zh: 给c登记指示物许可效果。

params.name: c
params.description: Card receiving the counter permit effect.

params.name: countertype
params.description: Counter type that c is allowed to hold.

params.name: location
params.description: Single-effect range for the permit. Omitted defaults to LOCATION_MZONE for monsters, otherwise LOCATION_SZONE + LOCATION_FZONE.

params.name: condition
params.description: Optional condition callback stored on the permit effect; ignored unless this argument is a function.

summary_en: Registers an EFFECT_DUAL_STATUS client-hint effect on c.
summary_zh: 给c登记带客户端提示的EFFECT_DUAL_STATUS效果。
core_summary_en: Enables Gemini/Dual state.

summary_en: Marks c as needing to be properly Summoned before it can be Special Summoned from public locations.
Returns c's activation effect, the effect with type EFFECT_TYPE_ACTIVATE. This is mainly used for Spell/Trap Cards.
Returns nil when the card has no registered activation effect, so guard the result before calling Effect methods.
Use the returned Effect to check whether a Field Spell or other Spell/Trap can be activated before moving or resolving it through another effect.
summary_zh: 返回c的发动效果，即类型包含EFFECT_TYPE_ACTIVATE的效果；主要用于魔法/陷阱卡。
如果该卡没有登记发动效果则返回nil，因此调用Effect方法前应先检查返回值。
当其他效果要移动或处理场地魔法等魔法/陷阱的发动时，可用返回的Effect先检查其是否可以发动。
core_summary_en: Returns c's activation effect.

returns.description: The activation effect registered on c, or nil if none is registered.
returns.description_zh: c上登记的发动效果；没有登记时返回nil。

summary_en: Returns c's current ATK, with unknown or negative ATK reported as 0.
summary_zh: 返回c当前的攻击力；未知或负数攻击力按0返回。

summary_en: Returns c's attack declaration count.
summary_zh: 返回c的攻击宣言次数。
core_summary_en: Returns attack declaration count.

summary_en: Returns the Group of cards c can attack and a boolean indicating whether c can attack directly.
summary_zh: 返回c可攻击的卡的Group，以及c能否直接攻击的布尔值。
core_summary_en: Returns attackable targets and direct-attack flag.
core_summary_zh: 返回可攻击对象和直接攻击标志。

returns.description: Attackable monsters.
Whether c can attack directly.

summary_en: Returns c's attack count for the current turn.
summary_zh: 返回c在当前回合的攻击次数。
core_summary_en: Returns attack count.

summary_en: Returns the Group of cards that c has attacked.
summary_zh: 返回c攻击过的卡组成的Group。

summary_en: Returns the number of attack records stored for c.
summary_zh: 返回c保存的攻击记录数量。

summary_en: Returns c's current Attribute bitmask.
Cards treated as having multiple Attributes can return a bitwise combination of ATTRIBUTE_* values.
summary_zh: 返回c当前的属性位掩码。
被视为具有多个属性的卡可能返回多个ATTRIBUTE_*值的按位组合。
core_summary_en: Returns c's current Attribute bitmask.
core_summary_zh: 返回c当前的属性位掩码。

summary_en: Returns the Attribute c is treated as having in the GY for player, defaulting to the current reason player.
summary_zh: 返回c在墓地中对player视为具有的属性；player省略时使用当前原因玩家。
core_summary_en: Returns Graveyard Attribute.

params.name: player
params.description: default: current reason player

summary_en: Returns c's current base ATK, with unknown or negative ATK reported as 0.
summary_zh: 返回c当前的基础攻击力；未知或负数攻击力按0返回。

summary_en: Returns c's current base DEF. Unknown or negative base DEF values are clamped to 0 by this binding.
summary_zh: 返回c当前的基础守备力。未知或负数基础守备力会被该绑定限制为0。
core_summary_en: Returns c's current base DEF.
core_summary_zh: 返回c当前的基础守备力。

summary_en: Returns c's temporary battle-position snapshot.
summary_zh: 返回c的临时战斗表示形式快照。
core_summary_en: Returns c's battle position snapshot.
core_summary_zh: 返回c的战斗表示形式快照。

summary_en: Returns the monster currently battling c, or nil if c is not the current attacker or attack target.
summary_zh: 返回当前正在与c战斗的怪兽；若c不是当前攻击怪兽或攻击对象则返回nil。
core_summary_en: Returns c's current battle counterpart.

returns.description: The monster battling c, or nil.

summary_en: Returns the Group of cards that c has battled.
summary_zh: 返回c已经战斗过的卡组成的Group。

summary_en: Returns the number of cards currently recorded in c's battled-cards set.
summary_zh: 返回c当前记录的已战斗卡集合数量。
core_summary_en: Counts cards battled by c.

summary_en: Returns a Group containing all persistent card targets currently recorded on c.
summary_zh: 返回包含c当前记录的全部持续取对象卡的Group。
core_summary_en: Returns persistent card targets.

summary_en: Returns the number of persistent card targets currently recorded on c.
summary_zh: 返回c当前记录的持续取对象卡数量。
core_summary_en: Counts persistent card targets.
core_summary_zh: 统计持续取对象卡数量。

summary_en: Returns c's current card code and, when present, its secondary code.
Returns a Group containing cards in the same column as c.

This MDPro3/YGOPro binding only takes c. It uses c's current on-field column, including related Monster Zones, Spell & Trap Zones, and Extra Monster Zone column relationships; if c is not on the field, the returned Group is empty.
summary_zh: 返回与c位于同一纵列的卡组成的Group。
此MDPro3/YGOPro绑定只接收c。它使用c当前场上的纵列，包含相关怪兽区域、魔法与陷阱区域以及额外怪兽区域的纵列关系；若c不在场上，返回的Group为空。
core_summary_en: Returns cards in c's column.

summary_en: Returns the number of cards in columns overlapping c.
summary_zh: 返回与c所在纵列重叠的卡数量。
core_summary_en: Counts cards in c's columns.

summary_en: Returns the zone bitmask for columns overlapping c within loc.
When player is supplied as the opposing perspective, the core swaps the player/opponent halves of the mask.
summary_zh: 返回loc范围内与c所在纵列重叠的区域位掩码。
提供player且视角为对方时，核心会交换掩码中的双方区域部分。
core_summary_en: Returns overlapping column zones.

summary_en: Returns c's current controller.
Returns counters on c for countertype.
When countertype is 0, this core returns the number of different counter types currently present on c, not the total number of all counters.
summary_zh: 返回c上的countertype类型指示物信息。
countertype为0时，此核心返回c当前拥有的不同指示物类型数量，而不是全部指示物的总数。
core_summary_en: Returns counter information on c.

summary_en: Returns the Pendulum Scale c currently uses.
In a Pendulum Zone, this returns the left or right current scale according to c's zone sequence. Outside a Pendulum Zone, it returns c's printed left scale value.
summary_zh: 返回c当前使用的灵摆刻度。
在灵摆区域时，会按c所在区域序号返回当前左/右刻度；不在灵摆区域时，返回c记载的左刻度数值。
core_summary_en: Returns c's current Pendulum Scale.

summary_en: Returns c's current DEF. Unknown or negative DEF values are clamped to 0 by this binding.
summary_zh: 返回c当前的守备力。未知或负数守备力会被该绑定限制为0。
core_summary_en: Returns c's current DEF.

summary_en: Returns the destination location currently stored in c's send-to parameters.
summary_zh: 返回c当前送去参数中保存的目标位置。
core_summary_en: Returns stored destination location.

summary_en: Returns the number of effects with code currently found by c's effect filter.
summary_zh: 返回c的效果筛选中当前找到的code效果数量。
core_summary_en: Counts matching effects on c.
core_summary_zh: 统计c上的匹配效果数量。

summary_en: Returns the number of Equip Cards currently equipped to c.
summary_zh: 返回当前装备给c的装备卡数量。
core_summary_en: Returns equipped-card count.

summary_en: Returns the Equip Cards currently equipped to c as a Group.
summary_zh: 以Group返回当前装备给c的装备卡。
core_summary_en: Returns Equip Cards currently equipped to c.
core_summary_zh: 返回当前装备给c的装备卡。

summary_en: Returns the card that c is currently equipped to, or nil if c has no equip target.
summary_zh: 返回c当前装备到的卡；如果c没有装备对象则返回nil。
core_summary_en: Returns the card that c is equipped to.

summary_en: Returns c's current field ID, the core timestamp assigned when c moved to its current place.

Smaller values are older. The core refreshes this value when the card gains a new field identity, such as entering the field or changing controller. This differs from Card.GetRealFieldID, which tracks the real field ID used by battle-state checks.
summary_zh: 返回c当前的field ID，即核心在c移动到当前位置时分配的时间标识。
数值越小表示越早进入当前位置。核心会在卡获得新的场上身份时更新该值，例如进入场上或变更控制者。此值不同于Card.GetRealFieldID，后者用于战斗状态等真实位置检查。
core_summary_en: Returns c's current field ID.

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose current field ID is returned.

returns.description: Current field ID assigned by the core for c's current field identity.

summary_en: Returns c's first persistent card target, or nil.
summary_zh: 返回c的第1个持续取对象卡；没有时返回nil。
core_summary_en: Returns the first persistent card target.
core_summary_zh: 返回第1个持续取对象卡。

summary_en: Returns how many flag effects with code are registered on c.
summary_zh: 返回c上编号为code的标记效果数量。
core_summary_en: Counts card flag effects by code.

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose single-card flag effects are counted.

params.name: code
params.description: Flag-effect code; the core masks it with MAX_CARD_ID and adds EFFECT_FLAG_EFFECT.

returns.description: Number of matching flag effects on c.

summary_en: Returns the first label value from each flag effect with the given code on c.
If c has no matching flag effect, the core returns nil. Matching flag effects with no label return 0 for that slot.
summary_zh: 返回c上编号为code的每个标记效果的第1个Label值。
没有匹配的标记效果时返回nil；匹配的标记效果没有Label时，该位置返回0。
core_summary_en: Returns label values from flag effects with the given code on c.
core_summary_zh: 返回c上编号为code的标记效果Label。

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose single-card flag effects are inspected.

params.name: code
params.description: Flag-effect code; the core masks it with MAX_CARD_ID and adds EFFECT_FLAG_EFFECT.

returns.description: First label value, or nil if no matching flag effect exists.
Additional integer label values from additional matching flag effects.

summary_en: Returns the Attribute c uses as Fusion Material for player, defaulting to the current reason player.
summary_zh: 返回c作为融合素材使用时对player使用的属性；player省略时使用当前原因玩家。
core_summary_en: Returns Fusion Material Attribute.

params.name: player
params.description: default: current reason player

summary_en: Returns c's Fusion Material codes: current code, second code when present, then EFFECT_ADD_FUSION_CODE values.
When the core is checking with not_material set, only the current and second codes are returned.
summary_zh: 返回c作为融合素材使用时的卡号：当前卡号、存在时的第二卡号，以及EFFECT_ADD_FUSION_CODE的追加值。
核心以not_material状态检查时，只返回当前卡号和第二卡号。
core_summary_en: Returns Fusion Material codes.

returns.description: Current code.
Additional Fusion Material code values, if any.

summary_en: Returns c's Fusion Material Type mask used by Fusion Material checks.
summary_zh: 返回c用于融合素材检查的融合素材种类位掩码。

summary_en: Returns the hand-Synchro enabling effect on c, its target function, and the min/max hand-material counts.
Only Monster Zone cards are checked. EFFECT_HAND_SYNCHRO has priority, then EFFECT_TUNER_MATERIAL_LIMIT with LOCATION_HAND.
summary_zh: 返回c上的手牌同调启用效果、其Target函数，以及手牌素材数量min/max。
只检查怪兽区域中的卡。优先检查EFFECT_HAND_SYNCHRO，其次检查带LOCATION_HAND的EFFECT_TUNER_MATERIAL_LIMIT。
core_summary_en: Returns hand Synchro parameters.

returns.description: Hand Synchro enabling effect.
Effect target function.
Minimum hand-material count.
Maximum hand-material count.

summary_en: Returns the location c would be redirected to by leave-field effects for REASON_EFFECT.
summary_zh: 返回c因REASON_EFFECT适用离场改去效果时会前往的位置。
core_summary_en: Returns leave-field redirect destination.

summary_en: Returns c's current left Pendulum Scale value.
summary_zh: 返回c当前的左灵摆刻度数值。
core_summary_en: Returns c's left Pendulum Scale.

summary_en: Returns c's current Level.
Returns c's Link Rating, or 0 if c is not a Link Monster.
summary_zh: 返回c的连接值；c不是连接怪兽时返回0。
core_summary_en: Returns c's Link Rating.

summary_en: Returns the Attribute c uses as Link Material for player, defaulting to the current reason player.
summary_zh: 返回c作为连接素材使用时对player使用的属性；player省略时使用当前原因玩家。
core_summary_en: Returns Link Material Attribute.

params.name: player
params.description: default: current reason player

summary_en: Returns c's Link Material codes: current code, second code when present, then EFFECT_ADD_LINK_CODE values.
summary_zh: 返回c作为连接素材使用时的卡号：当前卡号、存在时的第二卡号，以及EFFECT_ADD_LINK_CODE的追加值。
core_summary_en: Returns Link Material codes.

returns.description: Current code.
Additional Link Material code values, if any.

summary_en: Returns the Race c uses as Link Material for player, defaulting to the current reason player.
summary_zh: 返回c作为连接素材使用时对player使用的种族；player省略时使用当前原因玩家。
core_summary_en: Returns Link Material Race.

params.name: player
params.description: default: current reason player

summary_en: Returns c's Link Material Type mask used by Link Material checks.
summary_zh: 返回c用于连接素材检查的连接素材种类位掩码。

summary_en: Returns the cards currently occupying zones linked by c.
Use this when an effect cares about the actual cards in zones pointed to by c's Link Markers.
summary_zh: 返回当前位于c连接区域中的卡。
当效果关心c的连接标记所指向区域中的实际卡时使用。
core_summary_en: Returns cards currently in zones linked by c.
core_summary_zh: 返回当前位于c连接区域中的卡。

returns.description: Cards currently in c's linked zones.
returns.description_zh: 当前位于c连接区域中的卡。

summary_en: Returns the number of cards in zones linked by c.
summary_zh: 返回位于c所连接区域中的卡数量。
core_summary_en: Counts linked-zone cards.

summary_en: Returns the linked-zone bitmask generated by c.
By default the bitmask is from c's controller perspective. Passing player converts the mask to that player's perspective.
Use bit helpers such as bit.extract or bit.band when checking whether a specific sequence is pointed to.
summary_zh: 返回c产生的连接区域位掩码。
默认从c的控制者视角返回。传入player时，会把掩码转换为该玩家视角。
检查特定序号是否被连接标记指向时，通常配合bit.extract或bit.band等位运算辅助函数。
core_summary_en: Returns c's linked-zone bitmask.
core_summary_zh: 返回c的连接区域位掩码。

params.name: player
params.description: Perspective player for the returned zone mask. Default: c's controller.
params.description_zh: 返回区域掩码时使用的视角玩家。默认值：c的控制者。

returns.description: Linked-zone bitmask from the requested perspective.
returns.description_zh: 指定视角下的连接区域位掩码。

summary_en: Returns c's current location, or 0 if c is currently treated as not being on the field.
summary_zh: 返回c当前所在位置；c当前被当作不在场上时返回0。
core_summary_en: Returns c's current location.

summary_en: Returns a Group containing the cards currently stored as c's material cards.
summary_zh: 返回c当前记录的素材卡Group。
core_summary_en: Returns c's stored material cards.

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose stored material list is being read.

returns.description: New Group containing c's stored material cards; the Group is empty if no material cards are stored.

summary_en: Returns the number of cards currently recorded as c's materials.
summary_zh: 返回当前记录为c素材的卡数量。
core_summary_en: Returns material count.

summary_en: Returns the Group of cards mutually linked with c.
summary_zh: 返回与c互相连接的卡的Group。
core_summary_en: Returns mutually linked cards.

summary_en: Returns the number of cards mutually linked with c.
summary_zh: 返回与c互相连接的卡数量。
core_summary_en: Counts mutually linked cards.

summary_en: Returns the zone mask of c's mutually linked zones, swapped to player viewpoint when a player argument opposite c's controller is supplied.
summary_zh: 返回c互相连接的区域位掩码；提供与c控制者相对的player参数时，会交换为该玩家视角。

summary_en: Returns c's original Attribute from card data, or 0 while c is marked with STATUS_NO_LEVEL.
summary_zh: 返回c卡片数据中的原本属性；c带STATUS_NO_LEVEL时返回0。
core_summary_en: Returns c's original Attribute.

summary_en: Returns c's original card code from card data.
summary_zh: 返回c卡片数据中的原本卡号。
core_summary_en: Returns c's original card code.

summary_en: Returns c's rule-original card code.
Double-code cards return two codes: the printed original code and the second rule code. Other cards return only the duel code used by the core.
summary_zh: 返回c按规则使用的原本卡号。
双卡号卡返回两个卡号：记载的原本卡号和第二规则卡号。其他卡只返回核心使用的决斗卡号。
core_summary_en: Returns c's rule-original card code.
core_summary_zh: 返回c按规则使用的原本卡号。

returns.description: Primary rule-original code.
Second rule code, when present.

summary_en: Returns c's printed left Pendulum Scale.
summary_zh: 返回c记载的左灵摆刻度。

summary_en: Returns c's original Level from card data, or 0 for Xyz Monsters, Link Monsters, and cards marked with STATUS_NO_LEVEL.
summary_zh: 返回c卡片数据中的原本等级；超量怪兽、连接怪兽以及带STATUS_NO_LEVEL的卡返回0。
core_summary_en: Returns c's original Level.

summary_en: Returns c's original Race from card data, or 0 while c is marked with STATUS_NO_LEVEL.
summary_zh: 返回c卡片数据中的原本种族；c带STATUS_NO_LEVEL时返回0。
core_summary_en: Returns c's original Race.

summary_en: Returns c's printed Rank from card data, or 0 if c is not an Xyz Monster.
summary_zh: 返回c卡片数据中的原本阶级；c不是超量怪兽时返回0。
core_summary_en: Returns printed Rank.

summary_en: Returns c's printed right Pendulum Scale.
summary_zh: 返回c记载的右灵摆刻度。

summary_en: Returns c's original card-data type bitmask, not its current modified type.
summary_zh: 返回c原本卡片数据中的种类位掩码，而不是当前被修改后的种类。
core_summary_en: Returns c's original card-data type.
core_summary_zh: 返回c原本卡片数据中的种类。

summary_en: Returns the number of current Xyz Materials attached to c.
summary_zh: 返回c当前叠放的超量素材数量。
core_summary_en: Returns the number of Xyz Materials attached to c.
core_summary_zh: 返回c叠放的超量素材数量。

summary_en: Returns a Group containing the cards currently attached to c as Xyz Materials.
summary_zh: 返回当前叠放在c下面作为超量素材的卡组成的Group。
core_summary_en: Returns c's current Xyz Materials.

summary_en: Returns the card that c is attached to as an Xyz Material, or nil when c is not attached.
summary_zh: 返回c作为超量素材叠放到的卡；c未作为素材叠放时返回nil。

summary_en: Returns c's original owner player.
summary_zh: 返回c的原本持有者玩家。

summary_en: Returns the Group of cards that are targeting c as their persistent card-target owner.
summary_zh: 返回把c作为持续卡片对象拥有者的卡组成的Group。

summary_en: Returns the number of cards targeting c as their persistent card-target owner.
summary_zh: 返回把c作为持续卡片对象拥有者的卡数量。

summary_en: Returns c's current position value.
summary_zh: 返回c当前的表示形式数值。
core_summary_en: Returns current position.

summary_en: Returns the ATK value recorded for c's previous on-field state.
summary_zh: 返回c之前场上状态记录的攻击力数值。
core_summary_en: Returns previous on-field ATK.

summary_en: Returns the Attribute value recorded for c's previous on-field state.
summary_zh: 返回c之前场上状态记录的属性数值。
core_summary_en: Returns c's previous on-field Attribute.

summary_en: Returns the card code recorded for c's previous on-field state.
If the previous state had a second code, that code is returned as a second value.
summary_zh: 返回c之前场上状态记录的卡号。
若之前状态有第二卡号，则第二卡号作为第2个返回值返回。
core_summary_en: Returns c's previous on-field code.

returns.description: Second previous code, when present.

summary_en: Returns c's previous controller value.
summary_zh: 返回c之前记录的控制者。
core_summary_en: Returns c's previous controller.

summary_en: Returns the DEF value c had while it was previously on the field.
summary_zh: 返回c先前在场上时的DEF值。
core_summary_en: Returns previous on-field DEF.

summary_en: Returns c's previous Equip target, or nil.
summary_zh: 返回c之前的装备对象；没有时返回nil。
core_summary_en: Returns the previous Equip target.

summary_en: Returns the Level value c had while it was previously on the field.
summary_zh: 返回c先前在场上时的等级值。
core_summary_en: Returns previous on-field Level.

summary_en: Returns c's previous location bitmask from before its last location change.
summary_zh: 返回c在上一次位置变化前的原位置位掩码。
core_summary_en: Returns previous location.

summary_en: Returns the number of cards that were overlaid on c while it was previously on the field.
Returns c's previously recorded position value.
summary_zh: 返回c之前记录的表示形式数值。
core_summary_en: Returns previous position.

summary_en: Returns the Race value recorded for c's previous on-field state.
summary_zh: 返回c之前场上状态记录的种族数值。
core_summary_en: Returns c's previously recorded on-field Race.
core_summary_zh: 返回c之前记录的场上种族。

summary_en: Returns the Rank value c had while it was previously on the field.
summary_zh: 返回c先前在场上时的阶级值。

summary_en: Returns c's previous sequence value.
summary_zh: 返回c之前记录的位置序号。
core_summary_en: Returns c's previous sequence.

summary_en: Returns the Type value recorded for c's previous on-field state.
summary_zh: 返回c之前场上状态记录的种类数值。
core_summary_en: Returns c's previously recorded on-field Type.
core_summary_zh: 返回c之前记录的场上种类。

summary_en: Returns c's current Race value. Cards with multiple Races can return a bitmask containing more than one Race.
Returns the Race c is treated as having in the GY for player, defaulting to the current reason player.
summary_zh: 返回c在墓地中对player视为具有的种族；player省略时使用当前原因玩家。

summary_en: Returns c's current Rank.
Non-Xyz cards return 0. Xyz Monsters outside the Monster Zone return their original Rank; in the Monster Zone, Rank-changing effects are applied and the result is at least 1.
summary_zh: 返回c当前的阶级。
非超量卡返回0。超量怪兽不在怪兽区域时返回原本阶级；在怪兽区域时会应用阶级变更效果，结果最低为1。
core_summary_en: Returns c's current Rank.

summary_en: Returns c's real field ID, the core field identifier used for relation tracking.
summary_zh: 返回c的真实field ID，即核心用于关系追踪的场上识别值。
core_summary_en: Returns real field ID.

summary_en: Returns c's current reason bitmask/value.
This is the reason recorded in c's current state, such as REASON_EFFECT, REASON_COST, or REASON_BATTLE; it is not limited to position changes.
summary_zh: 返回c当前记录的原因位掩码/数值。
这是c当前状态中记录的原因，例如REASON_EFFECT、REASON_COST或REASON_BATTLE；并不只用于表示形式变更。
core_summary_en: Returns c's current reason value.
core_summary_zh: 返回c当前记录的原因数值。

summary_en: Returns c's current reason card, or nil when no reason card is recorded.
summary_zh: 返回c当前记录的原因卡；没有记录原因卡时返回nil。
core_summary_en: Returns c's current reason card.
core_summary_zh: 返回c当前记录的原因卡。

summary_en: Returns c's current reason effect, or nil when no reason effect is recorded.
summary_zh: 返回c当前记录的原因效果；没有记录原因效果时返回nil。
core_summary_en: Returns c's current reason effect.

summary_en: Returns c's current reason player, the player recorded in c's current reason state.
summary_zh: 返回c当前记录的原因玩家，即c当前原因状态中的玩家。
core_summary_en: Returns c's current reason player.
core_summary_zh: 返回c当前记录的原因玩家。

summary_en: Returns c's current right Pendulum Scale value.
summary_zh: 返回c当前的右灵摆刻度数值。
core_summary_en: Returns right Pendulum Scale.

summary_en: Returns the Ritual Level value c contributes for Ritual Monster rc.
summary_zh: 返回c为仪式怪兽rc提供的仪式等级数值。
core_summary_en: Returns Ritual Material Level value.

summary_en: Returns c's sequence within its current location.
For field zones, Main Monster Zones and Spell & Trap Zones use 0-4 from left to right, the Field Zone uses 5, and Pendulum Zones use 6-7.
For other locations, sequence is the card's position in that location, starting from 0.
summary_zh: 返回c在当前位置中的序号。
在场上时，主要怪兽区域和魔法与陷阱区域从左到右使用0-4；场地区域使用5；灵摆区域使用6-7。
在其他位置时，序号表示该卡在该位置中的顺序，从0开始。
core_summary_en: Returns c's current sequence.

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose current sequence is returned.
params.description_zh: 要读取当前序号的卡。

returns.description: Sequence in c's current location.
returns.description_zh: c在当前位置中的序号。

summary_en: Returns Special Summon information for c.

Supported fields include SUMMON_INFO_CODE, SUMMON_INFO_CODE2, SUMMON_INFO_TYPE, SUMMON_INFO_LEVEL, SUMMON_INFO_RANK, SUMMON_INFO_ATTRIBUTE, SUMMON_INFO_RACE, SUMMON_INFO_ATTACK, SUMMON_INFO_DEFENSE, SUMMON_INFO_REASON_EFFECT, and SUMMON_INFO_REASON_PLAYER.
Returns the location c was Summoned from, decoded from its summon information.
summary_zh: 返回c是从哪个位置被召唤的，该值从召唤信息中解析。
core_summary_en: Returns summon source location.

summary_en: Returns the player recorded as having Summoned c.
summary_zh: 返回记录为召唤c的玩家。
core_summary_en: Returns Summon player.

summary_en: Returns c's recorded Summon Type bits masked to the default Summon Type field.
summary_zh: 返回c记录的召唤类型位，并按默认召唤类型字段进行掩码。
core_summary_en: Returns c's Summon Type bits.

summary_en: Returns the Synchro Level value c contributes for Synchro Monster scard.
summary_zh: 返回c为同调怪兽scard提供的同调等级数值。
core_summary_en: Returns Synchro Material Level value.

summary_en: Returns c's Synchro Material Type mask used by Synchro Material checks.
summary_zh: 返回c用于同调素材检查的同调素材种类位掩码。

summary_en: Returns the ATK value recorded in c's card data.
This is the printed/database value, not the current ATK. Unlike Card.GetAttack, the binding does not clamp unknown ATK to 0, except cards marked STATUS_NO_LEVEL return 0.
summary_zh: 返回c卡片数据中记录的攻击力。
这是记载/数据库数值，不是当前攻击力。不同于Card.GetAttack，该绑定不会把未知攻击力限制为0；但带STATUS_NO_LEVEL的卡返回0。
core_summary_en: Returns c's card-data ATK.
core_summary_zh: 返回c卡片数据中的攻击力。

summary_en: Returns c's printed/stored DEF value, or 0 while c has no-Level status.
summary_zh: 返回c卡片数据中记载/保存的守备力数值；c处于无等级状态时返回0。
core_summary_en: Returns printed/stored DEF.

summary_en: Returns the minimum and maximum Tribute counts for Normal Summoning c.
summary_zh: 返回通常召唤c所需的最小和最大解放数量。
core_summary_en: Returns Normal Summon Tribute requirements.
core_summary_zh: 返回通常召唤解放需求。

returns.description: Minimum Tribute count.
Maximum Tribute count.

summary_en: Returns the tuner-material-limit effect affecting c, that effect's target function or nil, its value or nil, and the allowed minimum and maximum counts; if no such effect applies, no values are returned.
summary_zh: 返回影响c的调整素材限制效果、该效果的Target函数或nil、Value或nil，以及允许的最小和最大数量；没有该效果时不返回值。
core_summary_en: Returns tuner material limit information, or no values if no limit applies.
core_summary_zh: 返回调整素材限制信息；没有限制时不返回值。

returns.description: The tuner-material-limit effect.
The effect target function, if any.
The effect value, if any.
Minimum allowed material count.
Maximum allowed material count.

summary_en: Returns c's turn counter.
summary_zh: 返回c的回合计数器。
core_summary_en: Returns c's turn counter.

summary_en: Returns c's stored turn ID.
The core updates this value when the card is added to a location, so scripts commonly compare it with Duel.GetTurnCount() for same-turn timing checks.
summary_zh: 返回c保存的回合ID。
核心在卡加入某个位置时更新该值，因此脚本常用它与Duel.GetTurnCount()比较来判断同回合时点。
core_summary_en: Returns c's stored turn ID.

summary_en: Returns c's current type mask, including temporary type changes applied to the card.
summary_zh: 返回c当前的类型掩码，包含卡片当前受到的临时类型变更。

summary_en: Returns c's modern Union count and old Union count.
summary_zh: 返回c当前的新式同盟数量和旧式同盟数量。
core_summary_en: Returns Union equip counts.

returns.description: Modern Union count.
Old Union count.

summary_en: Returns c's Xyz Material Type mask used by Xyz Material checks.
summary_zh: 返回c用于超量素材检查的超量素材种类位掩码。

summary_en: Checks only whether c is free of EFFECT_CANNOT_CHANGE_CONTROL.
summary_zh: 只检查c是否不受EFFECT_CANNOT_CHANGE_CONTROL影响。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c is free of cannot-change-control effects.
core_summary_zh: 检查c是否不受不能变更控制权效果影响。

summary_en: Checks whether c can be returned to the Deck.
Checks whether c can be returned to the Deck as a cost.
Checks whether c can be returned to the Deck or Extra Deck as a cost.
