Checks whether c can be returned to the Extra Deck by the current reason player.
summary_zh: 判断c能否由当前原因玩家返回额外卡组。

summary_en: Checks whether c can be returned to the Extra Deck as a cost.
Checks whether c can be sent to the Graveyard.
Checks whether c can be sent to the Graveyard as a cost.
Checks whether c can be returned or added to the hand by the current reason player.
An optional player argument can be passed when a specific player is performing the action.
summary_zh: 判断c能否由player送去或返回手牌。
player省略时使用当前原因玩家。

summary_en: Checks whether c can be returned to the hand as a cost.
This uses c's actual return destination and returns false when the card would go somewhere other than the player's hand, such as the Extra Deck.
Checks whether c can be banished by player in position pos for reason.
player defaults to the current reason player, pos defaults to POS_FACEUP, and reason defaults to REASON_EFFECT.
Checks whether c can be banished as a cost by the current reason player.
pos controls the banished position and defaults to POS_FACEUP.
summary_zh: 判断c能否由当前原因玩家作为cost除外。
pos指定除外时的表示形式，省略时为POS_FACEUP。

summary_en: Checks whether c is treated as occupying or applying to all columns.
summary_zh: 检查c是否被视为占用或适用于全部纵列。

summary_en: Checks whether c includes all reasons in reason.
Checks whether c includes all types in type.
Checks whether c is a monster or currently treated as one, and whether its current ATK equals any supplied atk value.
Nil atk arguments are skipped. Non-monsters that are not treated as monsters return false.
summary_zh: 检查c是否为怪兽或当前被当作怪兽，并且当前攻击力是否等于任意给定的atk值。
nil的atk参数会被跳过。不是怪兽且未被当作怪兽的卡返回false。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c's current ATK matches any supplied value.
core_summary_zh: 检查c当前攻击力是否匹配任意给定值。

summary_en: Checks whether c is a monster or currently treated as one, and whether its current ATK is at least atk.
Unlike Card.IsAttackBelow, this core does not add a separate guard for unknown ATK before comparing.
summary_zh: 检查c是否为怪兽或当前被当作怪兽，并且当前攻击力是否大于等于atk。
不同于Card.IsAttackBelow，此核心在比较前不会额外检查攻击力未知的情况。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c's current ATK is at least atk.
core_summary_zh: 检查c当前攻击力是否大于等于atk。

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose current ATK is checked.

params.name: atk
params.description: Minimum ATK value accepted by the check.

returns.description: True if c is a monster or treated as one and its current ATK is at least atk.

summary_en: Checks whether c is a monster, or treated as one, whose current ATK is known and less than or equal to atk.
Cards with unknown ATK return false because the core requires the current ATK to be at least 0.
summary_zh: 检查c是否为怪兽或被当作怪兽，并且当前攻击力已确定且小于等于atk。
攻击力未知的卡返回false，因为核心要求当前攻击力至少为0。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c's current ATK is known and at most atk.
core_summary_zh: 检查c当前攻击力是否已确定且小于等于atk。

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose current ATK is checked.

params.name: atk
params.description: Maximum ATK value accepted by the check.

returns.description: True if c is a monster or treated as one, has known ATK, and that ATK is at most atk.

summary_en: Checks whether c's current position contains POS_ATTACK.
summary_zh: 检查c当前表示形式是否包含POS_ATTACK。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c is in Attack Position.

summary_en: Checks whether c currently satisfies the core's basic attack-capable conditions.

The card must be face-up Attack Position, or face-up Defense Position with EFFECT_DEFENSE_ATTACK, and it must not be forbidden, unable to attack, attack-disabled, or under a skipped Battle Phase. This does not check attack-announcement costs.
summary_zh: 检查c当前是否满足核心的基础可攻击条件。
该卡必须是表侧攻击表示，或带EFFECT_DEFENSE_ATTACK的表侧守备表示，并且不能处于禁止状态、不能攻击、攻击被无效，或回合玩家被跳过战斗阶段。该函数不检查攻击宣言费用。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c is currently attack-capable.

summary_en: Checks whether c currently has at least one Attribute flag from attribute.
Checks whether the current reason player can place count counters of countertype on c.

When loc is 0, c must currently be face-up on the field. When loc is nonzero, the counter permit range is checked against loc instead. If singly is true, counter limits are tested as current count + 1 rather than current count + count.
summary_zh: 检查当前原因玩家能否在c上放置count个countertype类型的指示物。
loc为0时，c必须当前表侧表示存在于场上。loc不为0时，改为用loc检查指示物许可效果的范围。singly为true时，指示物上限按当前数量+1检查，而不是按当前数量+count检查。
core_summary_en: Checks whether counters can be placed on c.
core_summary_zh: 检查能否在c上放置指示物。

params.name: singly
params.description: default: false

params.name: loc
params.description: default: 0

summary_en: Checks whether c1 can be chosen as a battle target by c2.
summary_zh: 检查c1能否被c2选择为攻击对象。

summary_en: Checks whether c's effects can be negated by e.
Cards that are already negated, have no original effects, or are unaffected by e cannot be negated.
The optional third parameter indicates whether this is a monster effect.
Checks whether c can be targeted by e, or by the current reason effect when e is omitted.
summary_zh: 判断c能否成为e的效果对象；省略e时使用当前原因效果。

summary_en: Checks whether c can be used as Fusion Material for fc and summon_type.
fc is optional and summon_type defaults to SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION. The binding has no ignore_mon argument; it delegates to the core Fusion Material legality checks.
summary_zh: 检查c能否作为fc和summon_type的融合素材使用。
fc可省略，summon_type默认SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION。该绑定没有ignore_mon参数，而是交给核心的融合素材合法性检查处理。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c can be used as Fusion Material.
core_summary_zh: 检查c能否作为融合素材。

params.name: summon_type
params.description: default: SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION

summary_en: Checks whether c can be used as Link Material, optionally for Link Monster scard.
Standard Link procedures call this before applying their own material filters.
summary_zh: 检查c能否作为连接素材；可选地指定连接怪兽scard。
标准连接召唤手续会在应用自身素材筛选前调用此检查。
core_summary_en: Checks Link Material usability.
core_summary_zh: 检查能否作为连接素材。

params.name: scard
params.description: Link Monster that would use c as material.
params.description_zh: 要把c作为素材使用的连接怪兽。

returns.description: true if c may currently be used as Link Material for scard or for a generic Link Material check.
returns.description_zh: 若c当前可以作为scard的连接素材，或通过通用连接素材检查，则返回true。

summary_en: Checks whether c can be placed onto the target player's field.
Returns false if the target player is invalid, c is forbidden, or placing c there would violate uniqueness checks.
core_summary_en: Checks whether c can be placed onto the target player's field.
Returns false if the target player is invalid, c is forbidden, or placing c there would violate uniqueness checks.

params.name: toplayer
params.description: Target player. Defaults to the current reason player.

params.name: tolocation
params.description: Target location. Defaults to LOCATION_SZONE.

returns.description: true if c can be placed on that player's field.

summary_en: Checks whether c can be used as Ritual Material for sc.
Ritual scripts usually call this after choosing the Ritual Monster, filtering Duel.GetRitualMaterial's result with Card.IsCanBeRitualMaterial so monster-specific material restrictions are respected.
Pass nil for sc only when checking the generic material pool before a specific Ritual Monster is known.
summary_zh: 检查c能否作为sc的仪式素材。
仪式脚本通常在选定仪式怪兽后，用Card.IsCanBeRitualMaterial过滤Duel.GetRitualMaterial取得的组，以遵守该怪兽自身的素材限制。
只有在尚未确定具体仪式怪兽、只检查通用素材池时，才对sc传入nil。

summary_en: Checks whether c can be Special Summoned by effect e using sumtype, sumplayer, sumpos, target player, and optional zone.
If nocheck is true, c's Summoning condition is skipped. If nolimit is true, c's revive limit or proper-Summon limit is skipped.
summary_zh: 检查c能否通过效果e，以给定的召唤类型、召唤玩家、表示形式、目标玩家和可选区域进行特殊召唤。
nocheck为true时跳过召唤条件检查；nolimit为true时跳过苏生限制或正规召唤限制检查。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c can be Special Summoned by effect e with the supplied summon parameters.
core_summary_zh: 检查c是否可以用效果e和给定的召唤参数进行特殊召唤。

params.name: c
params.description: Card being checked.

params.name: e
params.description: Effect that would perform the Special Summon.

params.name: sumtype
params.description: Summon type value recorded for the Special Summon.

params.name: sumplayer
params.description: Player treated as performing the Special Summon.

params.name: nocheck
params.description: If true, skips c's Summoning-condition check.

params.name: nolimit
params.description: If true, skips c's revive-limit or proper-Summon limit check.

params.name: sumpos
params.description: Summon position mask checked by the core; default: POS_FACEUP.

params.name: toplayer
params.description: Player whose field c would be Summoned to; default: sumplayer.

params.name: zone
params.description: Allowed Monster Zone bitmask; default: 0xff.

returns.description: True if c can be Special Summoned with the supplied parameters.

summary_en: Checks whether c can be used as Synchro Material for scard, with tuner supplied when the core needs the paired Tuner.
summary_zh: 检查c能否作为scard的同调素材；核心需要配对调整时可提供tuner。
core_summary_en: Checks Synchro Material usability.
core_summary_zh: 检查能否作为同调素材。

summary_en: Checks whether c can be used as Xyz Material, optionally for sc.
The core rejects Tokens, cards whose Xyz-material type is not a monster, cards with STATUS_FORBIDDEN, and applicable EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_XYZ_MATERIAL effects.
summary_zh: 检查c能否作为超量素材使用，可选指定要召唤的sc。
核心会拒绝衍生物、超量素材用种类不是怪兽的卡、带STATUS_FORBIDDEN的卡，以及适用的EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_XYZ_MATERIAL效果。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c can be used as Xyz Material.
core_summary_zh: 检查c能否作为超量素材。

summary_en: Checks the core's effect-specific position-change capability for c.
In this MDPro3/YGOPro core, that helper returns false for Link Monsters and true for other cards; it does not perform the broader manual battle-position-change checks.
summary_zh: 检查核心中供效果改变表示形式使用的能力判断。
在此MDPro3/YGOPro核心中，该底层辅助函数对连接怪兽返回false，对其他卡返回true；它不会执行更完整的手动改变战斗表示形式检查。
core_summary_en: Checks the effect-specific position-change helper for c.
core_summary_zh: 检查c的效果改变表示形式能力。

summary_en: Checks whether c can hold counters of countertype.
summary_zh: 检查c能否持有countertype类型的指示物。
core_summary_en: Checks counter compatibility.

summary_en: Checks whether c can be used as Xyz Material by player.
player defaults to the current reason player. The core rejects Tokens, forbidden cards in invalid states, and cards controlled by the other player that cannot change control.
summary_zh: 检查c能否由player作为超量素材使用。
player省略时使用当前原因玩家。核心会排除衍生物、处于非法状态的禁止使用卡，以及由对方控制且不能变更控制权的卡。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c can be used as Xyz Material by player.
core_summary_zh: 检查c能否由player作为超量素材使用。

params.name: player
params.description: default: current reason player

summary_en: Checks whether player can remove count counters of countertype from c for reason.
summary_zh: 检查player能否因reason从c上取除count个countertype类型的指示物。
core_summary_en: Checks counter removal permission.

returns.description: nil if player is invalid.

summary_en: Checks whether c can be turned face-down by the current reason player.
The core returns false for Link Monsters, Tokens, already face-down cards, and cards or players affected by EFFECT_CANNOT_TURN_SET.
summary_zh: 检查c能否被当前原因玩家变成里侧表示。
连接怪兽、衍生物、已经里侧表示的卡，以及受到EFFECT_CANNOT_TURN_SET影响的卡或玩家会返回false。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c can be turned face-down.
core_summary_zh: 检查c能否变成里侧表示。

params.name: c
params.description: Card checked for whether it can be turned face-down.

returns.description: True if c can be turned face-down by the current reason player.

summary_en: Checks whether the current attacker can make another attack under chain-attack rules.
This core binding validates c but tests the duel's current attacker. ac defaults to 2, and monsteronly requires an attack target instead of allowing a direct attack.
summary_zh: 检查当前攻击怪兽能否按连续攻击规则再次攻击。
这个核心绑定会校验c，但实际检查决斗中的当前攻击怪兽。ac默认2，monsteronly要求必须有攻击对象，不能直接攻击。
core_summary_en: Checks whether the current attacker can attack again.
core_summary_zh: 检查当前攻击怪兽是否能再次攻击。

params.name: ac
params.description: default: 2

params.name: monsteronly
params.description: default: false

summary_en: Checks whether c's current card code, or alternate code if it has one, matches any supplied code.
core_summary_en: Checks whether c matches any supplied card code.
core_summary_zh: 检查c的卡号是否匹配任意给定的卡号。

summary_en: Checks whether c's current controller is controler.
Checks whether control of c can currently move to the other player.
The card must be in the Monster Zone and must not be affected by EFFECT_CANNOT_CHANGE_CONTROL. Unless ignore_mzone is true, the opponent must also have an available Monster Zone in zone.
summary_zh: 检查c的控制权当前能否转移给另一名玩家。
c必须在怪兽区域，且不受EFFECT_CANNOT_CHANGE_CONTROL影响。ignore_mzone不为true时，对方还必须在zone指定范围内有可用的怪兽区域。
core_summary_en: Checks whether control of c can move to the other player.
core_summary_zh: 检查c的控制权能否转移给另一名玩家。

params.name: ignore_mzone
params.description: default: false

params.name: zone
params.description: default: 0xff

summary_en: Checks whether c is not a Link Monster, is a monster or currently treated as one, and has current DEF equal to any supplied def value.
Nil def arguments are skipped. Unlike the old imported text, the binding does not explicitly require c to be in the Monster Zone.
summary_zh: 检查c不是连接怪兽、是怪兽或当前被当作怪兽，并且当前守备力是否等于任意给定def值。
nil的def参数会被跳过。不同于旧导入文本，该绑定不会明确要求c位于怪兽区域。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c's current DEF matches any supplied value.
core_summary_zh: 检查c当前守备力是否匹配任意给定值。

summary_en: Checks whether c has current DEF greater than or equal to def.
Link Monsters and cards that are not monsters or currently treated as monsters return false.
summary_zh: 检查c当前守备力是否大于等于def。
连接怪兽，以及不是怪兽且当前未被当作怪兽的卡，返回false。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c's current DEF is at least def.
core_summary_zh: 检查c当前守备力是否大于等于def。

summary_en: Checks whether c has known current DEF less than or equal to def.
Link Monsters and non-monsters return false, and unknown or negative DEF also returns false.
summary_zh: 检查c已知的当前守备力是否小于等于def。
连接怪兽和非怪兽返回false；未知或负数守备力也返回false。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c's DEF is at most def.
core_summary_zh: 检查c的守备力是否最多为def。

summary_en: Checks whether c's current position contains POS_DEFENSE.
summary_zh: 检查c当前表示形式是否包含POS_DEFENSE。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c is in Defense Position.

summary_en: Checks whether c can be destroyed.

Without e, the core only rejects Xyz Materials and cards already in the GY or banished. With e, it checks whether c is affected by e and whether effect-destruction protection applies for the current reason player.
summary_zh: 检查c能否被破坏。
不传e时，核心只排除超量素材以及已经在墓地或除外的卡。传入e时，会检查c是否受e影响，以及按当前原因玩家判断的效果破坏耐性。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c can be destroyed.

summary_en: Checks whether c has a direct-attack record.
summary_zh: 检查c是否保存有直接攻击记录。

summary_en: Checks whether c currently has STATUS_DISABLED.
summary_zh: 检查c当前是否带STATUS_DISABLED。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c has STATUS_DISABLED.

summary_en: Checks whether c can be discarded for reason.
This is only a check: sending a card from the hand to the Graveyard with REASON_DISCARD does not by itself make that card unable to be discarded.
Checks whether c is currently affected by EFFECT_DUAL_STATUS.
summary_zh: 检查c当前是否受EFFECT_DUAL_STATUS影响。
core_summary_en: Checks Gemini/Dual state.

summary_en: Checks whether c has an effect matching filter.
Checks whether c is a card kind treated by the core as an Extra Deck monster.
summary_zh: 检查c是否属于核心视为额外卡组怪兽的卡种。
core_summary_en: Checks Extra Deck monster kind.
core_summary_zh: 检查额外卡组怪兽卡种。

summary_en: Checks whether c is part of an Extra Link state.
summary_zh: 检查c是否处于额外连接状态。

summary_en: Checks whether c is in face-down position.
Checks whether c is in face-up position.
core_summary_en: Checks whether c is in face-up position.

summary_en: Checks whether c is face-up; returns true for cards in the hand, Graveyard, Main Deck, and similar hidden/non-field locations.
Checks whether c currently has STATUS_FORBIDDEN.
summary_zh: 判断c当前是否具有STATUS_FORBIDDEN状态。

summary_en: Checks whether c's Attribute while used as Fusion Material contains attribute.
player defaults to the current reason player. The core uses c:GetFusionAttribute(player), so Fusion Material Attribute-changing effects are included.
summary_zh: 检查c作为融合素材使用时的属性是否包含attribute。
player默认当前原因玩家。核心使用c:GetFusionAttribute(player)，因此会计入融合素材用属性变更效果。
core_summary_en: Checks c's Attribute while used as Fusion Material.
core_summary_zh: 检查c作为融合素材使用时的属性。

params.name: player
params.description: default: current reason player

summary_en: Checks whether c can be treated as any supplied code while used as Fusion Material.
The core includes c's current code, second code, and EFFECT_ADD_FUSION_CODE values. If no Fusion-only code additions apply, or material-code checks are disabled, it falls back to Card.IsCode.
summary_zh: 检查c作为融合素材使用时，是否能当作任意给定code。
核心会计入c当前卡号、第二卡号以及EFFECT_ADD_FUSION_CODE数值。没有适用的融合专用追加卡号，或素材卡号检查被禁用时，退回Card.IsCode检查。
core_summary_en: Checks Fusion Material codes.

summary_en: Checks whether c can be treated as belonging to any supplied set code while used as Fusion Material.
nil set-code arguments are ignored.
summary_zh: 判断c作为融合素材时是否可以视为属于任一传入的系列编号。
nil系列编号参数会被忽略。

summary_en: Checks whether c can be Fusion Summoned as a Fusion Monster for summon type sum_type, defaulting to 0.
summary_zh: 检查c能否作为融合怪兽用召唤类型sum_type进行融合召唤；sum_type默认0。

summary_en: Checks whether c's type while used as Fusion Material contains type.
For an original Monster Card in the Spell & Trap Zone, the core uses the card-data type while material checks are active; otherwise it uses c's current type.
summary_zh: 检查c作为融合素材使用时的种类是否包含type。
原本为怪兽的卡位于魔法与陷阱区域，且正在素材检查时，核心使用卡片数据中的种类；其他情况使用c当前种类。
core_summary_en: Checks c's type while used as Fusion Material.
core_summary_zh: 检查c作为融合素材使用时的种类。

summary_en: Checks whether c1 currently has c2 as a persistent card target.
summary_zh: 检查c1当前是否把c2作为持续取对象卡。
core_summary_en: Checks persistent card targeting.

summary_en: Checks whether c has DEF.
Returns the effects currently affecting c with effect code code, or nil if none match.
When player is supplied, only effects whose count limit can still be used by that player are returned. Multiple matching effects are returned as multiple Lua return values.
summary_zh: 返回当前影响c且效果编号为code的效果；没有匹配效果时返回nil。
提供player时，只返回该玩家仍可使用次数限制的效果。多个匹配效果会作为多个Lua返回值返回。
core_summary_en: Returns effects affecting c with code, or nil if none match.
core_summary_zh: 返回影响c且编号为code的效果；没有匹配效果时返回nil。

returns.description: Additional matching effects, if any.

summary_en: Checks whether c has a Level.
Checks whether c is unaffected by effect e.
Checks whether c's current Level equals any supplied level value.
nil level arguments are ignored.
summary_zh: 判断c当前等级是否等于任一传入的等级值。
nil等级参数会被忽略。

summary_en: Checks whether c has a Level greater than 0 and greater than or equal to level.
Checks whether c has a Level greater than 0 and less than or equal to level.
Checks whether c:GetLink() equals any supplied link value. Nil link arguments are skipped; non-Link cards compare as 0.
summary_zh: 检查c:GetLink()是否等于任意给定link值。nil的link参数会被跳过；非连接怪兽按0比较。
core_summary_en: Checks c's Link Rating.

summary_en: Checks whether c has a nonzero Link Rating greater than or equal to link.
summary_zh: 检查c是否具有非0连接值，且连接值大于等于link。
core_summary_en: Checks c's Link Rating lower bound.

summary_en: Checks whether c's Attribute while used as Link Material contains attribute.
player defaults to the current reason player. The core uses c:GetLinkAttribute(player), so Link Material Attribute-changing effects are included.
summary_zh: 检查c作为连接素材使用时的属性是否包含attribute。
player默认当前原因玩家。核心使用c:GetLinkAttribute(player)，因此会计入连接素材用属性变更效果。
core_summary_en: Checks c's Attribute while used as Link Material.
core_summary_zh: 检查c作为连接素材使用时的属性。

params.name: player
params.description: default: current reason player

summary_en: Checks whether c has a nonzero Link Rating that is less than or equal to link.
summary_zh: 检查c是否具有非0连接值，且连接值小于等于link。
core_summary_en: Checks c's Link Rating upper bound.

summary_en: Checks whether c matches any supplied code while used as Link Material.
This includes c's current code, second code, and EFFECT_ADD_LINK_CODE values. If no link-code additions apply, the binding falls back to Card.IsCode.
summary_zh: 检查c作为连接素材使用时是否匹配任意给定卡号。
会检查c当前卡号、第二卡号以及EFFECT_ADD_LINK_CODE追加的卡号。没有连接卡号追加效果时，该绑定退回使用Card.IsCode。
core_summary_en: Checks Link Material card codes.

summary_en: Checks whether c has Link Marker direction dir.
summary_zh: 检查c是否具有方向dir的连接标记。
core_summary_en: Checks Link Marker direction.

summary_en: Checks whether c's Race while used as Link Material for player contains race. player defaults to the current reason player.
summary_zh: 检查c作为player的连接素材使用时的种族是否包含race。player省略时使用当前原因玩家。
core_summary_en: Checks c's Race while used as Link Material.
core_summary_zh: 检查c作为连接素材使用时的种族。

params.name: player
params.description: default: current reason player

summary_en: Checks whether c can be treated as any supplied setcode while used as Link Material. Nil setcode arguments are skipped.
summary_zh: 检查c作为连接素材使用时能否视为任意给定setcode的系列卡。nil的setcode参数会被跳过。
core_summary_en: Checks c's set codes while used as Link Material.
core_summary_zh: 检查c作为连接素材使用时的系列。

summary_en: Checks whether c is currently in linked state.
summary_zh: 检查c当前是否处于连接状态。
core_summary_en: Checks linked state.

summary_en: Checks whether Link Monster c can be Link Summoned by the current reason player.
Optional materials, lcard, minc, and maxc restrict the Link Material pool and material count used by the core check.
Use this in effect target and operation branches before calling Duel.LinkSummon. minc and maxc default to 0 when omitted, leaving the registered procedure's own count rules in control.
The core rejects this check during the Damage Step.
summary_zh: 检查连接怪兽c能否由当前原因玩家进行连接召唤。
可选的materials、lcard、minc、maxc会限制核心检查使用的连接素材池和素材数量。
通常在效果的target和operation分支中，于调用Duel.LinkSummon前使用。minc和maxc省略时默认为0，由已登记手续自身的数量规则决定。
核心在伤害步骤中会拒绝这个检查。
core_summary_en: Checks Link Summon availability.

params.name: c
params.description: Link Monster being tested.
params.description_zh: 要检查的连接怪兽。

params.name: materials
params.description: Optional temporary material pool. nil lets the registered procedure collect its normal pool.
params.description_zh: 可选的临时素材池。nil表示让已登记手续收集通常素材池。

params.name: lcard
params.description: Optional fixed material that the final selected group must include.
params.description_zh: 可选的固定素材；最终选择的Group必须包含它。

params.name: minc
params.description: Runtime minimum material-card count. default: 0
params.description_zh: 运行时素材卡数量下限。默认值：0

params.name: maxc
params.description: Runtime maximum material-card count. default: 0
params.description_zh: 运行时素材卡数量上限。默认值：0

returns.description: true if c has a legal Link Summon under the supplied temporary limits.
returns.description_zh: 若c在给定临时限制下存在合法连接召唤，则返回true。

summary_en: Checks whether c's type while used as Link Material contains type.
summary_zh: 检查c作为连接素材使用时的种类是否包含type。
core_summary_en: Checks c's type while used as Link Material.
core_summary_zh: 检查c作为连接素材使用时的种类。

summary_en: Checks whether c is currently in location.
Cards treated as not being on the field return false for field locations, including during a Summon before it successfully reaches the Monster Zone.
core_summary_en: Checks whether c is currently in location.

summary_en: Checks whether c can be Normal Set in a Monster Zone for the current reason player.
ignore_count skips the Normal Summon/Set count check. e checks Set legality for that effect, min is the minimum number of releases required, and zone restricts usable Monster Zones.
summary_zh: 判断c能否由当前原因玩家在怪兽区域通常盖放。
ignore_count会跳过通常召唤/盖放次数检查。e用于检查由该效果进行的盖放，min为要求的最少解放数量，zone限制可用怪兽区域。

summary_en: Checks whether c has any Attribute other than attribute.
For example, if a monster is both DARK and WIND, IsAttribute(DARK) is true, but IsNonAttribute(DARK) is also true.
Checks whether c is treated as a non-Tuner for Synchro Monster scard.
summary_zh: 检查c对同调怪兽scard而言是否被视为非调整。
core_summary_en: Checks non-Tuner status for Synchro Material use.
core_summary_zh: 检查同调素材用非调整状态。

summary_en: Checks whether c is currently on the field and is not being treated as off the field.
Checks whether c's rule-original card code matches any supplied code.
Nil code arguments are skipped. For double-code cards, the core checks both rule-original codes; otherwise it checks the card's duel code.
summary_zh: 检查c按规则使用的原本卡号是否匹配任意给定code。
nil的code参数会被跳过。双卡号卡会检查两个规则原本卡号；其他卡检查核心使用的决斗卡号。
core_summary_en: Checks c's rule-original card code.
core_summary_zh: 检查c按规则使用的原本卡号。

summary_en: Checks whether c is originally a card with an effect matching filter.
Checks whether c's original set data matches any supplied set code.
summary_zh: 检查c的原本系列数据是否匹配任意给定系列代码。
core_summary_en: Checks original set codes.

summary_en: Checks whether c's current battle position includes pos.
summary_zh: 判断c当前表示形式是否包含pos。

summary_en: Checks whether c's previous controller was player.
Checks whether c's previous location included location.
Checks whether c's previous position included pos.
summary_zh: 判断c之前的表示形式是否包含pos。

summary_en: Checks whether c's previous card-code or added previous set-code data matches any supplied setcode value.
Nil setcode arguments are skipped. This uses the previous state recorded before the last relevant field or position update, not c's current Set membership.
summary_zh: 检查c之前记录的卡号或附加系列数据是否匹配任意给定setcode。
nil的setcode参数会被跳过。该函数使用最近相关场上状态或表示形式更新前记录的状态，不检查c当前的系列。
core_summary_en: Checks c's previously recorded Set membership.

summary_en: Checks whether c is currently public to both players, represented by face-up position in this core.
summary_zh: 判断c当前是否为双方公开状态；在当前核心中表现为表侧表示。

summary_en: Checks whether c currently has at least one Race flag from race.
Checks whether c:GetRank() equals any supplied rank value.
Nil rank arguments are skipped. The binding compares the numeric Rank directly; it does not separately require c to be an Xyz Monster, so non-Xyz cards compare as Rank 0.
summary_zh: 检查c:GetRank()是否等于任意给定rank值。
nil的rank参数会被跳过。该绑定直接比较数值阶级，不会额外要求c必须是超量怪兽，因此非超量卡会按阶级0参与比较。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c's Rank matches any supplied value.
core_summary_zh: 检查c的阶级是否匹配任意给定值。

summary_en: Checks whether c has a nonzero Rank greater than or equal to rank.
summary_zh: 检查c是否具有非0阶级，且阶级大于等于rank。
core_summary_en: Checks c's Rank lower bound.

summary_en: Checks whether c has a nonzero Rank that is less than or equal to rank.
summary_zh: 检查c是否具有非0阶级，且阶级小于等于rank。
core_summary_en: Checks c's Rank upper bound.

summary_en: Checks whether c's current reason flags include reason.
Checks whether c is still related to the current battle, usually during the Damage Step or shortly after damage calculation.
Checks whether c1 currently has a relation to c2.
summary_zh: 检查c1当前是否与c2保持关系。
core_summary_en: Checks relation between two cards.
core_summary_zh: 检查两张卡之间的关系。

summary_en: Checks whether c is still related to chainc.

The activating card and cards selected as targets with Duel.SetTargetCard or Duel.SelectTarget automatically become related to that Chain. The relation is lost when the card leaves the expected place.
Checks whether c is still related to effect e.

When an effect enters the Chain, its handler and cards selected with Duel.SetTargetCard or Duel.SelectTarget are related to that effect. That relation is normally lost once the card leaves its expected place.
summary_zh: 检查c是否仍与效果e保持联系。
效果进入连锁时，其处理卡以及通过Duel.SetTargetCard或Duel.SelectTarget选中的卡会与该效果建立联系；卡离开预期位置后通常会失去该联系。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c is still related to effect e.
core_summary_zh: 检查c是否仍与效果e保持联系。

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose relation is checked.

params.name: e
params.description: Effect relation to test against.

returns.description: True if c still has relation to e.

summary_en: Checks whether c can be Released for a non-Summon reason by the current reason player.

reason defaults to REASON_COST. The core rejects cards being Summoned, Xyz Materials, cards in the GY or banished, Spell/Trap Cards in the hand, cards the player cannot release, and cards affected by EFFECT_UNRELEASABLE_NONSUM.
summary_zh: 检查c能否由当前原因玩家作为非召唤用途被解放。
reason默认REASON_COST。正在召唤中的卡、超量素材、墓地或除外的卡、手牌中的魔法/陷阱卡、玩家不能解放的卡，以及受EFFECT_UNRELEASABLE_NONSUM影响的卡会返回false。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c can be Released for a non-Summon reason.
core_summary_zh: 检查c能否作为非召唤用途被解放。

params.name: reason
params.description: default: REASON_COST

summary_en: Checks whether c can be Released by the current resolving effect, using the current reason player and reason effect.
summary_zh: 使用当前原因玩家和原因效果，检查c是否能被当前处理中的效果解放。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c can be Released by effect.
core_summary_zh: 检查c是否能被效果解放。

summary_en: Checks whether c can be Set in a Spell & Trap Zone. If ignore_field is true, available zone checks are ignored.
Checks whether c belongs to any of the supplied set codes.
core_summary_en: Checks whether c belongs to any supplied set code.
core_summary_zh: 检查c是否属于任意给定的系列代码。

summary_en: Checks whether c was Special Summoned by a card whose name includes setname.
Checks whether c can be Special Summoned by player under sum_type, defaulting to 0 and using the current reason player.
summary_zh: 检查c能否由当前原因玩家以sum_type特殊召唤；sum_type默认0。

summary_en: Checks whether c can be Special Summoned by a proper procedure.
c must have an available Special Summon procedure.
Checks whether c currently has at least one status flag from status.
Common legality checks use this for temporary engine states such as STATUS_BATTLE_DESTROYED before allowing a Damage Step Quick Effect.
summary_zh: 判断c当前状态是否包含status中的至少一个标志。
常见合法性检查会用它判断STATUS_BATTLE_DESTROYED等临时核心状态，再决定伤害步骤的Quick效果能否发动。

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose current status flags are checked.
params.description_zh: 要检查当前状态标志的卡。

params.name: status
params.description: Status flag or combined status mask, such as STATUS_BATTLE_DESTROYED.
params.description_zh: 状态标志或组合状态掩码，例如STATUS_BATTLE_DESTROYED。

returns.description: true if c has any flag included in status.
returns.description_zh: 若c具有status中的任意标志则为true。

summary_en: Checks whether c's recorded Summon location contains loc. This reads the Summon information, not c's current location.
summary_zh: 检查c记录的召唤位置是否包含loc。该函数读取召唤信息，不检查c的当前位置。
core_summary_en: Checks c's recorded Summon location.

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose recorded Summon location is checked.

params.name: loc
params.description: Location mask to test against the stored Summon location, such as LOCATION_EXTRA or LOCATION_GRAVE.

returns.description: True if any bit in loc is present in c's recorded Summon location.

summary_en: Checks whether player was the player who Summoned c.
summary_zh: 判断player是否为召唤c的玩家。

summary_en: Checks whether c's recorded Summon type includes every flag in sumtype.
summary_zh: 判断c记录的召唤类型是否包含sumtype中的全部标志。

summary_en: Checks whether c can be Normal Summoned, excluding Normal Summon/Set.
If e is not nil, checks whether c can be Normal Summoned by that effect. min is the minimum number of Tributes, and zone restricts the zone it must be Summoned to.
Checks whether c's card data represents a monster that is allowed to be Normal Summoned or Set by card kind.
This rejects non-monsters, Extra Deck monsters, Ritual Monsters, Special Summon-only monsters, and Tokens. It does not check current costs, Summon count, locations, or player restrictions.
summary_zh: 检查c的卡片数据是否属于按卡种可以通常召唤或盖放的怪兽。
非怪兽、额外卡组怪兽、仪式怪兽、特殊召唤怪兽和衍生物会返回false。该函数不检查当前费用、召唤次数、位置或玩家限制。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c is a Normal Summonable card kind.
core_summary_zh: 检查c是否属于可通常召唤的卡种。

summary_en: Checks whether c can be Synchro Summoned with tuner and the available material group mg.
If tuner is nil, this behaves like the regular Special Summon procedure check for c.
min and max restrict the number of non-Tuner Synchro Materials used by the procedure.
summary_zh: 判断c能否使用tuner以及可用素材组mg进行同调召唤。
tuner为nil时，相当于检查c通常的特殊召唤手续。
min和max限制该手续使用的非调整同调素材数量。

summary_en: Checks whether c's type while used as Synchro Material contains type.
summary_zh: 检查c作为同调素材使用时的类型是否包含type。
core_summary_en: Checks c's Synchro Material type.
core_summary_zh: 检查c的同调素材用类型。

summary_en: Checks whether c is a Tuner monster for scard.
Besides TYPE_TUNER, this also checks effects that can make c be treated as a Tuner.
Checks whether c has at least one of the type flags in type.
core_summary_en: Checks whether c has at least one type flag from type.
core_summary_zh: 检查c是否包含type中的任意类型。

summary_en: Checks whether c can provide Xyz Level lv for Xyz Monster xyzc.
summary_zh: 检查c能否为超量怪兽xyzc提供超量用等级lv。
core_summary_en: Checks Xyz Level value.

summary_en: Checks whether Xyz Monster c can be Xyz Summoned by the current reason player with an optional material group and min/max constraints.
Use this in effect target and operation branches before calling Duel.XyzSummon. minc and maxc default to 0 when omitted, leaving the registered procedure's own count rules in control.
The core rejects this check during the Damage Step.
summary_zh: 检查超量怪兽c能否由当前原因玩家用可选素材组和min/max限制进行超量召唤。
通常在效果的target和operation分支中，于调用Duel.XyzSummon前使用。minc和maxc省略时默认为0，由已登记手续自身的数量规则决定。
核心在伤害步骤中会拒绝这个检查。
core_summary_en: Checks whether c can be Xyz Summoned.

params.name: c
params.description: Xyz Monster being tested.
params.description_zh: 要检查的超量怪兽。

params.name: materials
params.description: Optional material pool or exact material group supplied by the effect.
params.description_zh: 效果提供的可选素材范围或指定素材Group。

params.name: minc
params.description: Optional minimum material count override. Defaults to 0.
params.description_zh: 可选的素材数量下限覆盖值。默认为0。

params.name: maxc
params.description: Optional maximum material count override. Defaults to 0.
params.description_zh: 可选的素材数量上限覆盖值。默认为0。

summary_en: Checks whether c's type while used as Xyz Material contains type.
summary_zh: 检查c作为超量素材使用时的类型是否包含type。
core_summary_en: Checks c's Xyz Material type.
core_summary_zh: 检查c的超量素材用类型。

summary_en: Registers effect e to card c and returns the generated effect field ID.
Registration also makes c the effect handler. If the card is unaffected by the current reason effect, registration can fail unless forced is true.
core_summary_en: Registers effect e to card c and returns the generated effect field ID.
core_summary_zh: 把效果e注册给c，成功时返回效果的场上编号，并设置e的Handler为c。

summary_en: Registers a special single-card flag effect on c and returns the created Effect.
Flag effects are script markers: their code is kept separate from regular effect codes, they cannot be disabled, and count=0 is treated as 1.
summary_zh: 在c上登记单卡标记效果，并返回创建的Effect。
标记效果是脚本用的标记：其code与普通效果code分开保存，不能被无效，且count=0会按1处理。
core_summary_en: Registers a single-card flag effect.

params.name: c
params.description: Card that receives the marker.

params.name: code
params.description: Flag-effect code; the core masks it with MAX_CARD_ID and adds EFFECT_FLAG_EFFECT.

params.name: reset_flag
params.description: RESET_* mask controlling when the marker expires.

params.name: property
params.description: Effect property flags stored on the created marker; EFFECT_FLAG_CANNOT_DISABLE is always added.

params.name: reset_count
params.description: Reset counter for the created marker; 0 is treated as 1.

params.name: label
params.description: Optional integer payload stored on the marker.

params.name: desc
params.description: Optional client description id for marker hints.

returns.description: The created flag effect.

summary_en: Releases c's relation to effect e.
summary_zh: 解除c与效果e之间的关系。
core_summary_en: Releases effect relation.

summary_en: Releases c1's relation to card c2.
summary_zh: 解除c1与卡c2之间的关系。

summary_en: Removes count counters of countertype from c for reason, using player as the removing player.
When countertype is 0, the core clears every counter on c and returns no Lua value. Otherwise it yields and returns whether the requested counters were removed.
summary_zh: 由player因reason从c上取除count个countertype类型的指示物。
countertype为0时，核心会清除c上的全部指示物且不返回Lua值。否则会让处理器取除指定指示物，并返回是否成功。
core_summary_en: Removes counters from c.

summary_en: Lets player remove between min and max Xyz Materials from c for reason and returns the number actually removed.
The core also offers applicable EFFECT_OVERLAY_REMOVE_REPLACE effects before selecting materials.
summary_zh: 让player为了reason从c上取除min到max个超量素材，并返回实际取除数量。
核心会在选择素材前提供可适用的EFFECT_OVERLAY_REMOVE_REPLACE替代效果。
core_summary_en: Removes Xyz Materials from c.

returns.description: Number of Xyz Materials actually removed.

summary_en: Replaces c's effects with the effects of card code under the given reset flags and returns the replacement id.
count defaults to 1; phase resets automatically include both players' turns when no turn side is specified.
summary_zh: 用卡号code的效果替换c的效果，使用给定reset标志，并返回替换效果id。
count默认1；RESET_PHASE未指定自己/对方回合时会自动补上双方回合。
core_summary_en: Replaces copied effects.

params.name: count
params.description: default: 1

summary_en: Manually resets effects on c that match code and reset_type.
summary_zh: 手动重置c上匹配code和reset_type的效果。
core_summary_en: Resets matching effects.

summary_en: Resets all flag effects on c with code.
summary_zh: 重置c上code对应的全部标志效果。
core_summary_en: Resets flag effects by code.

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose matching flag effects are reset.

params.name: code
params.description: Flag-effect code to clear.

summary_en: Resets negate-related card effects on c for each supplied reset code.
summary_zh: 按每个给定的重置代码重置c上相关的无效效果。

summary_en: Marks c face-up while it is in the Deck.
If c is the current top card of the Main Deck, the core also sends the top-of-Deck update to the client.
summary_zh: 把位于Deck中的c标记为表侧。
如果c是当前主Deck最上方的卡，核心还会向客户端发送Deck顶更新。
core_summary_en: Marks card face-up in Deck.

summary_en: Registers c2 as a persistent card target of c1.
This stores a card-target relation used by functions such as Card.GetCardTarget and by related-card disable checks; it is separate from Duel.SelectTarget's Chain target list.
summary_zh: 把c2登记为c1的持续卡片对象。
该函数保存的是供Card.GetCardTarget等函数以及相关卡无效检查使用的卡片对象关系，不是Duel.SelectTarget登记的连锁对象列表。
core_summary_en: Registers c2 as a card target of c1.

summary_en: Adds an EFFECT_COUNTER_LIMIT for countertype to c with value limit.
summary_zh: 为c添加countertype对应的EFFECT_COUNTER_LIMIT，数值为limit。
core_summary_en: Sets a counter limit effect.

summary_en: Sets the first matching flag effect label for code on c to label and returns whether a flag effect was found.
summary_zh: 把c上code对应的第一个标志效果Label设置为label，并返回是否找到标志效果。
core_summary_en: Sets a flag effect label.

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose matching flag effect is updated.

params.name: code
params.description: Flag-effect code to find.

params.name: label
params.description: New integer label stored on the first matching flag effect.

returns.description: True if a matching flag effect was updated; false if none exists.

summary_en: Sends a client card-hint message for c with hint type and value; types at or above CHINT_DESC_ADD are ignored.
summary_zh: 向客户端发送c的卡片提示消息，内容为提示type和值value；type大于等于CHINT_DESC_ADD时会被忽略。
core_summary_en: Sends a card hint.

summary_en: Sets g as c's material group for a Summon, or clears c's materials when g is nil.
summary_zh: 把g设置为c本次召唤使用的素材组；g为nil时清除素材记录。

summary_en: Sets c's current reason bitmask to reason.
summary_zh: 把c当前的原因位掩码设为reason。

summary_en: Marks c as sharing a once-per-turn Special Summon limit under spsummon_code.
Cards with the same nonzero spsummon_code share the limit for each player. The binding does nothing while c is copying another card's effect.
summary_zh: 将c标记为按spsummon_code共享每回合1次的特殊召唤限制。
具有相同非零spsummon_code的卡对每名玩家共享该限制。c正在复制其他卡效果时，该绑定不做处理。
core_summary_en: Sets c's shared once-per-turn Special Summon code.
core_summary_zh: 设置c共享的每回合1次特殊召唤代码。

summary_en: Sets or clears status on c.
This is an internal-status helper. The binding does nothing while c is copying another card's effect.
summary_zh: 设置或清除c上的status状态位。
这是内部状态辅助函数。c正在复制其他卡效果时，该绑定不做处理。
core_summary_en: Sets or clears a status bit on c.

summary_en: Sets c's turn counter.
summary_zh: 设置c的回合计数器。
core_summary_en: Sets c's turn counter.

summary_en: Sets a uniqueness rule for c so only one card with unique_code can exist on the checked field, Monster Zone, or Spell & Trap Zone range.
Material check for Branded Fusion.
Material check for Cyberload Fusion.
Material check for Destruction Swordsman Fusion.
Material check for Favorite Contact.
Release filter condition for Ritual Monsters.
Release group check condition for Ritual Monsters.
Material check for Red-Eyes Fusion.
Material check for Miracle Synchro Fusion.
Material check for Ultimate Fusion.
Equips this card as an Equip Card for ZW - monsters.
Creates a card with code and places it in the requested test field location, or attaches it as Xyz Material if an occupied Monster Zone contains an Xyz Monster; proc marks its procedure complete.
summary_zh: 创建卡号code的卡并放到指定测试场地位置；如果目标怪兽区域已被超量怪兽占用，则作为超量素材叠放；proc会标记正规手续完成。
core_summary_en: Adds a card to the debug field.

summary_en: Sends tostring(msg) to the local debug message handler.
summary_zh: 把tostring(msg)发送到本地调试消息处理。

summary_en: Adds count counters of countertype directly to c for field setup; count defaults to 1.
summary_zh: 在场地设置阶段直接给c添加count个countertype指示物；count默认1。

summary_en: Pre-equips equip_card to target during field setup and returns whether the relationship was created.
summary_zh: 在场地设置阶段预先把equip_card装备给target，并返回是否建立成功。

summary_en: Adds target as a persistent card target of c during field setup.
summary_zh: 在场地设置阶段把target加入c的持续卡片对象。

summary_en: Sets c's stored summon information to summon_type plus optional summon_location in the high word.
summary_zh: 把c保存的召唤信息设为summon_type，并可把summon_location写入高16位。

summary_en: Clears the duel and starts a field reload with duel option flag and optional rule; when rule is omitted, obsolete ruling flags choose rule 1, otherwise the current rule is used.
summary_zh: 清空决斗并用决斗选项flag和可选rule开始重新载入场地；省略rule时，旧规则标志会使用规则1，否则使用当前规则。
core_summary_en: Begins debug field reload.
core_summary_zh: 开始调试场地重新载入。

summary_en: Finishes a field reload by disabling pending shuffle checks and rebuilding field information.
summary_zh: 结束重新载入场地：关闭待处理洗切检查并重建场地信息。

summary_en: Writes the local AI name message, truncated to the core AI-name buffer size.
summary_zh: 写入本地AI名称消息，长度会按核心AI名称缓冲区截断。

summary_en: Sets a player's LP, starting hand count, and cards drawn each Draw Phase.
Writes tostring(msg) as a local show-hint message, truncated to the core hint buffer size.
summary_zh: 把tostring(msg)写成本地显示提示消息，长度会按核心提示缓冲区截断。

summary_en: Queues e to be activated by the core activation processor.
summary_zh: 把效果e加入核心发动处理队列。

summary_en: Registers a custom activity counter with id counter_id for the selected ACTIVITY_* type.

For Summon and attack counters, f is called with a Card and the counter increases when f returns false. For ACTIVITY_CHAIN, f is called with effect, player, chain_id and also counts false results. ACTIVITY_BATTLE_PHASE and unknown activity types do not register a custom counter in this core.
summary_zh: 为指定ACTIVITY_*类型登记编号为counter_id的自定义行动计数器。
召唤和攻击类计数器会以Card调用f，f返回false时计数增加。ACTIVITY_CHAIN会以effect, player, chain_id调用f，同样在返回false时计数。在此核心中，ACTIVITY_BATTLE_PHASE和未知行动类型不会登记自定义计数器。
core_summary_en: Registers a custom activity counter.
core_summary_zh: 登记自定义行动计数器。

params.name: counter_id
params.description: Script-chosen identifier used later with Duel.GetCustomActivityCount.

params.name: activity_type
params.description: ACTIVITY_* constant selecting which activity map receives the counter.

params.name: f
params.description: Filter callback. Returning false marks that activity as counted for the acting player.

summary_en: Immediately refreshes field information.
Runs immediate field adjustment.
When c is supplied, the core refreshes disable relations for cards related to c before adjusting the field.
summary_zh: 立即进行场上调整。
提供c时，核心会先刷新与c相关卡的无效关联，再调整场上状态。
core_summary_en: Runs immediate field adjustment.

summary_en: Lets player declare count Attributes from the available Attribute bitmask and returns the selected Attribute bitmask.
available should be a bitwise combination of ATTRIBUTE_* constants.
summary_zh: 让player从available属性位掩码中宣言count个属性，并返回所选属性位掩码。
available应为ATTRIBUTE_*常量的按位组合。
core_summary_en: Lets player declare Attributes.

returns.description: Selected Attribute bitmask.

summary_en: Lets player declare a card code matching the optional opcode/filter expression and returns the selected code.
summary_zh: 让player宣言一个匹配可选opcode/filter表达式的卡号，并返回所选卡号。
core_summary_en: Lets player declare a card code.

summary_en: Lets player choose one of the built-in coin-side options and returns the zero-based option index.
summary_zh: 让player从内置硬币面选项中选择一个，并返回从0开始的选项索引。
core_summary_en: Lets player announce a coin side.

returns.description: Zero-based option index.

summary_en: Lets player declare a Level and returns the declared Level plus the zero-based option index.
min and max default to 1 and 12 and are swapped if min is greater than max. Extra level arguments are excluded from the options; if no Levels remain, the binding returns no value.
summary_zh: 让player宣言等级，并返回宣言的等级以及从0开始的选项索引。
min和max默认1与12；min大于max时会交换。额外的等级参数会从选项中排除；没有剩余等级时，该绑定不返回值。
core_summary_en: Lets player declare a Level.

params.name: min
params.description: default: 1

params.name: max
params.description: default: 12

returns.description: Declared Level.
Zero-based option index.

summary_en: Lets player choose one of the supplied numbers.
Returns the selected number and the core's 0-based option index for that number.
summary_zh: 让player从给定数字中选择1个。
返回被选择的数字，以及该数字在核心选项列表中的0基序号。
core_summary_en: Lets player choose one of the supplied numbers.
core_summary_zh: 让player从给定数字中选择1个。

returns.description: Selected number.
0-based option index selected by the core.

summary_en: Lets player declare count Races from available and returns the selected RACE_* bitmask.
summary_zh: 让player从available中宣言count个种族，并返回所选RACE_*位掩码。
core_summary_en: Lets player declare Race values.

summary_en: Lets player choose one of the engine's built-in Monster/Spell/Trap type options and returns the zero-based option index.
The return value is the selected option index, not a TYPE_* bitmask.
summary_zh: 让player从核心内置的怪兽/魔法/陷阱类型选项中选择，并返回从0开始的选项索引。
返回值是所选选项索引，不是TYPE_*位掩码。
core_summary_en: Lets player choose Monster/Spell/Trap.

summary_en: Separates the current resolving effect into a later timing window, then raises EVENT_BREAK_EFFECT.
Use this when card text says to do one action, then do another action afterward, so later triggers do not see both actions as simultaneous.
Starts damage calculation between attacker and attack_target, or a direct attack when attack_target is nil.
new_attack is optional and is passed to the damage-step processor. If attacker and attack_target are the same card, the binding returns no value and does not start damage calculation.
summary_zh: 开始attacker与attack_target之间的伤害计算；attack_target为nil时表示直接攻击。
new_attack为可选参数，会传给伤害步骤处理器。attacker和attack_target是同一张卡时，该绑定不开始伤害计算且不返回值。
core_summary_en: Starts damage calculation.

params.name: new_attack
params.description: default: false

summary_en: Marks the current attacker so it can make another attack, optionally against card c.
The binding only sets chain-attack state. It returns no Lua value and does nothing if there is no current attacker or the attacker is not affected by the resolving effect.
summary_zh: 标记当前攻击怪兽，使其可以再次攻击；可选将攻击对象限制为卡c。
该绑定只设置连续攻击状态，不返回Lua值。没有当前攻击怪兽，或攻击怪兽不受当前处理效果影响时，不做处理。
core_summary_en: Marks the current attacker for another attack.
core_summary_zh: 标记当前攻击怪兽可以再次攻击。

summary_en: Changes the current attack target to target, or to a direct attack when target is nil, and returns whether the change succeeded.

The current attacker must exist, be able to attack, and not have its attack canceled. A card target must be one of the current legal attack targets; direct attack requires that the attacker is not forbidden from attacking directly.
summary_zh: 把当前攻击对象改为target；target为nil时改为直接攻击。返回是否成功变更。
当前攻击怪兽必须存在、可以攻击，且攻击未被取消。卡片对象必须是当前合法攻击对象之一；直接攻击要求攻击怪兽未被禁止直接攻击。
core_summary_en: Changes the current attack target.

summary_en: Changes the current attacking monster to attacker.
Unless ignore_count is true, the new attacker gains an attack announcement count, and during the Damage Phase also gains attacked-count and attacked-card records.
summary_zh: 把当前攻击怪兽改为attacker。
除非ignore_count为true，否则新的攻击怪兽会增加攻击宣言次数；在伤害阶段中还会记录已攻击次数和已攻击卡。

summary_en: Changes player battle damage for the current battle to value.
When check is true or omitted, existing 0 battle damage is left unchanged.
summary_zh: 把当前战斗中player受到的战斗伤害改为value。
check为true或省略时，原本已经是0的战斗伤害不会被改写。
core_summary_en: Changes current battle damage.

params.name: check
params.description: default: true

summary_en: Replaces the operation function of Chain Link chainc with f.
summary_zh: 把chainc连锁环的Operation函数替换为f。
core_summary_en: Changes a Chain Link operation.

summary_en: Changes the battle position of targets and returns the number of cards whose position actually changed.

The position arguments map by current position: au for face-up Attack Position, ad for face-down Attack Position, du for face-up Defense Position, and dd for face-down Defense Position. Omitted values use au.
core_summary_en: Changes battle positions and returns the number of cards whose position actually changed.
core_summary_zh: 变更targets的表示形式，并返回实际变更表示形式的卡的数量。
au、ad、du、dd分别对应当前表侧攻击、里侧攻击、表侧守备、里侧守备的目标表示形式；省略时使用au。MDPro3核心不读取旧文档中的第7个setavailable参数。

params.name: ad
params.description: default: au

params.name: du
params.description: default: au

params.name: dd
params.description: default: au

params.name: noflip
params.description: default: false

summary_en: Replaces the target card group recorded for Chain Link chainc with g.
summary_zh: 把chainc连锁环记录的取对象卡组替换为g。
core_summary_en: Changes a Chain Link's target card group.
core_summary_zh: 变更连锁环的取对象卡组。

summary_en: Changes target parameter data for Chain Link count to param.
summary_zh: 把连锁环count记录的对象参数改为param。

summary_en: Changes the target player recorded for Chain Link count.
summary_zh: 改变连锁环count记录的对象玩家。

summary_en: Checks whether c is a valid card related to chainc.
Checks whether all current Chain Links have different handler card codes.
summary_zh: 检查当前全部连锁环的处理对象卡号是否互不相同。
core_summary_en: Checks current Chain handler uniqueness.
core_summary_zh: 检查当前连锁处理对象唯一性。

summary_en: Without get_info, returns whether event is present in the current event state.
With get_info true, returns true plus event cards, event player, event value, reason effect, reason, and reason player when found; otherwise returns false.
summary_zh: 不传get_info时，返回当前事件状态中是否存在event。
get_info为true且找到事件时，返回true以及事件卡组、事件玩家、事件值、原因效果、原因、原因玩家；没有找到时只返回false。
core_summary_en: Checks current event state.

params.name: get_info
params.description: default: false

returns.description: Event cards when get_info succeeds.
Event player.
Event value.
Reason effect.
Reason.
Reason player.

summary_en: Checks whether player can pay the specified LP cost without paying it.
Use this in a Cost callback's chk==0 branch. The core returns false for nonpositive costs, and the optional must_pay flag is passed to the LP-cost check.
summary_zh: 检查player是否可以支付指定LP Cost，但不会实际支付。
通常在Cost回调的chk==0分支使用。cost小于等于0时核心返回false；可选的must_pay标志会传给LP支付检查。
core_summary_en: Checks whether a player can pay an LP cost.
core_summary_zh: 检查玩家能否支付LP Cost。

params.name: player
params.description: Player checked for payment ability.
params.description_zh: 要检查支付能力的玩家。

params.name: cost
params.description: LP amount to check; values of 0 or less return false.
params.description_zh: 要检查的LP数值；0或更小的值会返回false。

params.name: must_pay
params.description: Passed through to the core LP-cost check; scripts use true when the player must be able to pay that exact amount.
params.description_zh: 传给核心LP Cost检查；脚本在玩家必须能够支付该确切数值时传true。

returns.description: True if the LP cost can be paid; false if it cannot or cost is nonpositive; nil if player is invalid.
returns.description_zh: 可以支付时为true；不能支付或cost不为正数时为false；player无效时为nil。

summary_en: Checks whether player can use the given sequence in location.
summary_zh: 检查player能否使用location中的sequence位置。
core_summary_en: Checks whether a location sequence is usable.
core_summary_zh: 检查位置序号是否可用。

summary_en: Checks whether the card group satisfies mandatory material requirements.
Returns whether an action has been recorded for the current phase.
summary_zh: 返回当前阶段是否已经记录过行动。
core_summary_en: Returns phase action state.

summary_en: Checks whether player can release at least count cards matching f, excluding ex.
Extra arguments after ex are passed to f after the Card argument. This helper uses REASON_COST.
summary_zh: 检查player是否能解放至少count张满足f且不在ex中的卡。
ex之后的额外参数会传给f。此辅助函数使用REASON_COST。

summary_en: Checks whether player can release at least count cards matching f, excluding ex, with an explicit reason and optional hand releases.
Extra arguments after ex are passed to f after the Card argument.
summary_zh: 检查player是否能以指定reason解放至少count张满足f且不在ex中的卡，并可选择是否允许从手牌解放。
ex之后的额外参数会传给f。

summary_en: Checks whether player can remove at least count Xyz Materials from the specified own/opponent field locations for reason.
s marks locations on player's own field and o marks locations on the opponent's field, from player's perspective. Applicable replacement effects can satisfy the check.
summary_zh: 检查player能否因reason从指定的己方/对方场上位置取除至少count个超量素材。
s表示从player视角看的己方场上位置，o表示对方场上位置。可适用的替代效果也能满足该检查。
core_summary_en: Checks whether Xyz Materials can be removed.
core_summary_zh: 检查是否能取除超量素材。

summary_en: Checks whether the current reason player has a Normal Summon/Set count available, or whether c provides an extra summon-count effect.
summary_zh: 检查当前原因玩家是否还有通常召唤/盖放次数，或c是否提供额外召唤次数效果。

summary_en: Checks whether scard has a legal Synchro Material selection with optional tuner/non-tuner filters, count limits, required Synchro Material, and material group.
summary_zh: 检查scard是否存在合法的同调素材选择，可带调整/非调整筛选、数量限制、指定同调素材和素材Group。

summary_en: Checks whether timing is present in either player's current hint timing mask.
summary_zh: 检查timing是否存在于任一玩家当前的hint timing掩码中。

summary_en: Checks whether there is a valid Tribute set for Normal Summoning or Setting c.
max defaults to min, mg can restrict the candidate pool, toplayer defaults to c's current controller, and zone defaults to the current extra-summon zone limit when present or 0x1f otherwise.
summary_zh: 检查是否存在可用于通常召唤或盖放c的合法祭品组合。
max默认等于min，mg可以限制候选素材池，toplayer默认c当前控制者，zone默认当前额外召唤区域限制，若没有限制则为0x1f。
core_summary_en: Checks whether valid Tribute candidates exist for c.
core_summary_zh: 检查c是否存在合法祭品候选。

params.name: max
params.description: default: min

params.name: toplayer
params.description: default: c's controller

params.name: zone
params.description: default: current extra-summon zone limit or 0x1f

summary_en: Checks whether tuner can be used with scard under the supplied tuner/non-tuner filters, count limits, and optional material group.
summary_zh: 检查tuner能否在给定调整/非调整筛选、数量限制和可选素材Group下与scard一起使用。

summary_en: Checks whether scard has a legal Xyz Material selection for material Xyz Level lv, material count range, optional filter, and optional material group.
This is the boolean check used by Xyz procedure targets. It does not select or move cards.
summary_zh: 检查scard是否存在合法的超量素材选择，使用素材超量等级lv、素材数量范围、可选筛选函数和可选素材Group。
这是超量手续target使用的布尔检查；不会选择或移动卡。

params.name: scard
params.description: Xyz Monster whose material procedure is checked.
params.description_zh: 要检查素材手续的超量怪兽。

params.name: f
params.description: Optional per-material filter.
params.description_zh: 可选的单张素材筛选函数。

params.name: lv
params.description: Required material Xyz Level.
params.description_zh: 要求的素材超量等级。

params.name: minc
params.description: Minimum material count.
params.description_zh: 素材数量下限。

params.name: maxc
params.description: Maximum material count.
params.description_zh: 素材数量上限。

params.name: materials
params.description: Optional candidate material group. When omitted, procedure code usually supplies the player's Monster Zone group.
params.description_zh: 可选的候选素材Group。省略时，手续代码通常提供玩家怪兽区域的Group。

returns.description: true if a legal Xyz Material selection exists.
returns.description_zh: 存在合法超量素材选择时为true。

summary_en: Clears operation info for chain ct; it is a no-op if that Chain Link does not exist.
summary_zh: 清除连锁ct的操作信息；该连锁环不存在时不做处理。
core_summary_en: Clears operation info for a Chain Link.
core_summary_zh: 清除连锁环的操作信息。

summary_en: Clears the target-card group recorded on the current Chain Link, if one exists.
summary_zh: 清空当前连锁环记录的取对象卡组；没有记录时不处理。
core_summary_en: Clears current Chain targets.

summary_en: Reveals a Card or Group to player and waits for the client confirmation.
If skip_panel is true, the client skips the extra confirmation panel when possible.
Reveals up to count cards from the top of player's Main Deck to the client.
count is clamped to the remaining Deck size. The function yields for the reveal wait and returns no Lua values.
summary_zh: 向客户端公开player卡组最上方最多count张卡。
count会被限制为剩余主卡组数量。函数会为公开等待而yield，不返回Lua值。
core_summary_en: Reveals the top cards of player's Main Deck.
core_summary_zh: 公开player主卡组最上方的卡。

summary_en: Reveals count cards from the top of player's Extra Deck to the client, skipping face-up Pendulum cards tracked at the Extra Deck top.
summary_zh: 向客户端公开player额外卡组最上方count张卡，会跳过额外卡组顶端记录的表侧灵摆卡部分。

summary_en: Creates a Token card with card code code for player and returns it.
The returned Token is not placed on the field automatically; scripts normally pass it to Duel.SpecialSummon or another operation afterwards.
summary_zh: 为player创建卡号为code的衍生物并返回该Card。
返回的衍生物不会自动放到场上；脚本通常会随后把它传给Duel.SpecialSummon或其他处理。
core_summary_en: Creates a Token card for player.

summary_en: Deals value effect damage to player for reason and returns the damage actually applied.
If damage is changed into LP recovery or prevented, the return value reflects the final applied damage. With is_step=true, finish the damage/recovery batch with Duel.RDComplete.
Destroys targets for reason and returns the number of cards actually destroyed.
dest defaults to LOCATION_GRAVE. reason_player defaults to the current Chain's reason player. Use REASON_EFFECT for normal card effects and reserve REASON_RULE for rule/procedure cleanup.
Sets whether the core's self-destruction check is disabled; omitting disable disables the check.
summary_zh: 设置是否禁用核心的自毁检查；省略disable时表示禁用检查。
core_summary_en: Toggles self-destruction checks.

params.name: disable
params.description: default: true

summary_en: Disables the automatic shuffle check for the next Deck or hand operation.
Use this before operations that intentionally preserve Deck order or hand order.
Sends count cards from the top of player's Deck to the Graveyard for reason, and returns the number actually moved.
Lets player choose and discard min to max matching cards from their hand for reason, then returns the number discarded.
Cards in ex are excluded. Extra arguments after ex are passed to filter f.
Makes player draw up to count cards for reason and returns the number actually drawn.
When reason includes REASON_RULE, effects that prevent drawing are ignored.
Enables the supplied core global_flag bit for the Duel and returns no Lua value.
summary_zh: 启用决斗中的指定core global_flag位，且不返回Lua值。
core_summary_en: Enables a Duel global flag bit.

summary_en: Equips c1 to c2 for player and returns true if the equip succeeds.
up defaults to true and makes the Equip Card face-up. When is_step is true, call Duel.EquipComplete after all step equips have been created.
Completes a batch of step equips created with Duel.Equip(..., true) by enabling the equipped cards and raising the equip events.
Returns activity counts for player in the same order as the requested activity_type values.

Supported built-in activity types are ACTIVITY_SUMMON, ACTIVITY_NORMALSUMMON, ACTIVITY_SPSUMMON, ACTIVITY_FLIPSUMMON, ACTIVITY_ATTACK, and ACTIVITY_BATTLE_PHASE. Other values, including ACTIVITY_CHAIN in this binding, return 0.
summary_zh: 按传入的activity_type顺序返回player的行动次数。
内置支持ACTIVITY_SUMMON、ACTIVITY_NORMALSUMMON、ACTIVITY_SPSUMMON、ACTIVITY_FLIPSUMMON、ACTIVITY_ATTACK和ACTIVITY_BATTLE_PHASE。其他值在该绑定中返回0，包括ACTIVITY_CHAIN。
core_summary_en: Returns current activity counts for player.

returns.description: Count for activity_type1.
Additional counts for each extra activity_type.

summary_en: Returns the monster currently being attacked, or nil for a direct attack.
Returns the monster that is currently attacking, or nil if there is no current attacker.
Returns the battle damage currently recorded for player.
summary_zh: 返回当前为player记录的战斗伤害。
core_summary_en: Returns recorded battle damage.

summary_en: Returns the monster controlled by player that is currently in battle, followed by the monster controlled by the opponent that is currently in battle.
Each return can be nil if there is no attacker or attack target for that controller.
summary_zh: 返回当前战斗中由player控制的怪兽，然后返回当前战斗中由对方控制的怪兽。
若对应控制者没有攻击怪兽或攻击对象，则对应返回值为nil。
core_summary_en: Returns the battling monsters for player and the opponent.
core_summary_zh: 返回player与对方当前战斗中的怪兽。

returns.description: Monster controlled by player.
Monster controlled by the opponent.

summary_en: Returns how many battles player has conducted in the current Battle Phase tracking state.
summary_zh: 返回player在当前战斗阶段记录状态中的战斗次数。

summary_en: Returns the event group, event player, event value, reason effect, reason, and reason player stored on Chain Link count.
summary_zh: 返回连锁环count保存的事件Group、事件玩家、事件数值、原因效果、原因和原因玩家。
core_summary_en: Returns event data stored on a Chain Link.
core_summary_zh: 返回连锁环保存的事件数据。

returns.description: Event cards.
Event player.
Event value.
Reason effect.
Reason flags.
Reason player.

summary_en: Returns information fields from chainc in the same order as the requested CHAININFO_* constants.
Use chainc=0 for the currently resolving Chain. Unknown requested fields return nil, and no values are returned if the Chain does not exist.
summary_zh: 按请求的CHAININFO_*常量顺序，返回chainc对应连锁的信息字段。
chainc=0表示当前正在处理的连锁。未知字段返回nil；连锁不存在时不返回值。
core_summary_en: Returns requested Chain information fields.
core_summary_zh: 返回请求的连锁信息字段。

params.name: chainc
params.description: Chain index/count to inspect; scripts commonly use 0 for the current Chain Link.
One or more CHAININFO_* constants. Each requested field produces one return value.

returns.description: Values corresponding to the requested CHAININFO_* constants. CHAININFO_TARGET_CARDS returns the Chain's target Group.

summary_en: Returns the first EFFECT_CHAIN_MATERIAL effect currently applying to player, or nil if none applies.
Fusion-style scripts use the returned effect's target and operation callbacks to handle Chain Material alternatives.
summary_zh: 返回当前适用于player的第1个EFFECT_CHAIN_MATERIAL效果；没有时返回nil。
融合类脚本通常读取该效果的Target和Operation回调，用于处理连锁素材替代流程。
core_summary_en: Returns the first chain material effect applying to player.
core_summary_zh: 返回适用于player的连锁素材效果。

params.name: player
params.description: Player checked for an applying EFFECT_CHAIN_MATERIAL effect.

returns.description: First applying EFFECT_CHAIN_MATERIAL effect; no Lua value is pushed if player is invalid or no such effect exists, which behaves as nil in normal assignment.

summary_en: Returns the stored coin toss results for the current coin-toss event, one result per coin.
summary_zh: 返回当前投掷硬币事件保存的硬币结果；每枚硬币返回一个结果。
core_summary_en: Returns coin results.

returns.description: One value per stored coin result.

summary_en: Moves control of targets to player and returns the number of cards whose control actually changed.
Use reset_phase and reset_count for temporary control, such as PHASE_END, 1. To pass only a zone mask, use 0, 0, zone.
core_summary_en: Moves control of targets to player and returns the number of cards whose control actually changed.
core_summary_zh: 把targets的控制权转移给player，并返回实际变更控制权的卡的数量。
临时获得控制权时传入reset_phase和reset_count，例如PHASE_END, 1；只想指定可用区域时传入0, 0, zone。

params.name: reset_phase
params.description: default: 0

params.name: reset_count
params.description: default: 0

params.name: zone
params.description: default: 0xff

summary_en: Returns the total number of countertype counters in player-relative locations s and o.
summary_zh: 返回player视角下s和o位置中countertype类型指示物的总数。
core_summary_en: Counts counters in field locations.
core_summary_zh: 统计场上位置中的指示物。

returns.description: Counter count, or nil if player is invalid.

summary_en: Returns the number of Chain Links currently stored in the active Chain.
summary_zh: 返回当前连锁中已记录的连锁环数量。
core_summary_en: Returns the active Chain size.

summary_en: Returns the current phase constant.
Returns player 0's or player 1's count for the custom counter_id and ACTIVITY_* type.

Counts are reset each turn. In this core, most card-based custom counters only record whether that player has performed a counted activity at least once, while Chain counters can increase and decrease with Chain creation and cancellation.
summary_zh: 返回counter_id和指定ACTIVITY_*类型下，player对应的自定义计数。
计数每回合重置。在此核心中，多数以卡为对象的自定义计数器只记录该玩家是否至少进行过1次被计数行动；连锁计数器会随连锁建立和取消而增减。
core_summary_en: Returns one player's count from a custom activity counter.
core_summary_zh: 返回指定玩家的自定义行动计数。

params.name: counter_id
params.description: Identifier previously registered with Duel.AddCustomActivityCounter.

params.name: player
params.description: Player whose count is read; use 0 or 1.

params.name: activity_type
params.description: ACTIVITY_* constant selecting which custom activity map is read.

returns.description: Stored count for that player, counter ID, and activity type, or 0 if no matching custom counter exists.

summary_en: Returns a Group containing up to count cards from the top of player's Deck.
If count is larger than the remaining Deck size, only the available cards are included. This accessor does not confirm or reveal those cards by itself.
summary_zh: 返回玩家player卡组最上方最多count张卡组成的Group。
若count大于剩余卡组数量，只包含实际存在的卡。该读取函数本身不会确认或公开这些卡。
core_summary_en: Returns the top cards of player's Deck as a Group.
core_summary_zh: 返回player卡组最上方的卡组成的Group。

params.name: player
params.description: Player whose Deck is read.

params.name: count
params.description: Maximum number of cards to include from the top of the Deck.

returns.description: New Group containing the top Deck cards, or an empty Group if no cards are available.

summary_en: Returns the five stored dice-result slots for the current dice event.
summary_zh: 返回当前掷骰事件保存的5个骰子结果槽位。
core_summary_en: Returns dice result slots.

returns.description: First dice result.
Second dice result.
Third dice result.
Fourth dice result.
Fifth dice result.

summary_en: Returns player's current rule draw count for the Draw Phase.
summary_zh: 返回player当前抽卡阶段规则抽卡数量。
core_summary_en: Returns rule draw count.

returns.description: Draw count, or nil if player is invalid.

summary_en: Returns a Group containing up to count cards from the top of player's Extra Deck, after the face-up Pendulum section.
summary_zh: 返回player额外卡组最上方至多count张卡组成的Group，起点在表侧灵摆卡部分之后。

summary_en: Returns the card at player, location, and sequence, or nil if that slot is empty or invalid.

The binding also returns nil while the card at that slot is in Summoning or Special Summon step status. Field Zone sequence 0 maps to the Field Zone, and Pendulum Zone sequences 0 and 1 only return cards currently marked as Pendulum Zone cards.
summary_zh: 返回player的location中sequence位置的卡；该位置为空或无效时返回nil。
若该位置的卡正在召唤或处于特殊召唤步骤状态，该绑定也返回nil。场地区域使用sequence 0，灵摆区域只在sequence 0和1且该卡当前标记为灵摆区域卡时返回。
core_summary_en: Returns the card at a field location and sequence.
core_summary_zh: 返回指定位置序号上的卡。

summary_en: Returns the cards in the specified locations from player's viewpoint; s is player's side and o is the opponent's side.
summary_zh: 从player视角返回指定位置的卡组；s为自己一侧位置，o为对方一侧位置。

summary_en: Returns the number of cards in the specified locations from player's viewpoint.
Returns the first card in the specified locations that satisfies f and is not excluded by ex.
f may be nil. ex may be a Card, a Group, or nil, and extra arguments after ex are passed to f. Returns nil when no matching card is found.
summary_zh: 返回指定位置中第一张满足f且未被ex排除的卡。
f可以为nil。ex可以是Card、Group或nil，ex之后的额外参数会传给f。没有匹配卡时返回nil。
core_summary_en: Returns the first matching card from the specified locations.
core_summary_zh: 返回指定位置中第一张满足条件的卡。

summary_en: Returns the first target card currently recorded for the resolving Chain.
If multiple target cards were recorded, the remaining target cards are returned as additional values in recorded order.
summary_zh: 返回当前正在处理的连锁登记的第一张对象卡。
若登记了多张对象卡，其余对象卡会按登记顺序作为额外返回值返回。
core_summary_en: Returns target cards recorded for the current Chain.
core_summary_zh: 返回当前连锁登记的对象卡。

returns.description: First recorded target card, followed by any additional target cards as extra Lua return values. No value is returned when the current Chain has no target cards.

summary_en: Returns how many player flag effects with code are registered on player.
summary_zh: 返回player上编号为code的玩家标记效果数量。
core_summary_en: Counts player flag effects by code.

params.name: player
params.description: Player whose flag effects are counted.

params.name: code
params.description: Flag-effect code; the core masks it with MAX_CARD_ID and adds EFFECT_FLAG_EFFECT.

returns.description: Number of matching player flag effects, or nil if player is invalid.

summary_en: Returns the label values stored on player flag effects with code.
If no matching flag effect exists, the core returns nil; if multiple matching flag effects exist, it returns one label value for each. A matching flag effect with no label returns 0 for that slot.
summary_zh: 返回player身上code对应标志效果保存的Label值。
没有对应标志效果时核心返回nil；存在多个对应标志效果时，会按每个效果返回一个Label值。匹配的标志效果没有Label时，该位置返回0。
core_summary_en: Returns player flag-effect labels.

params.name: player
params.description: Player whose player flag effects are inspected.

params.name: code
params.description: Flag-effect code; the core masks it with MAX_CARD_ID and adds EFFECT_FLAG_EFFECT.

returns.description: First matching label, or nil if player is invalid or no matching flag effect exists.
Additional matching labels; a matching effect with no label contributes 0.

summary_en: Returns two Groups for player: all currently usable Fusion Material candidates, then the base material pool from the requested locations.

location defaults to LOCATION_HAND + LOCATION_MZONE. Extra Fusion Material effects in the Spell & Trap Zone or GY are added to the first returned Group, while the second Group contains only cards from location.
summary_zh: 返回player的两个Group：当前可用的全部融合素材候选，以及来自指定位置的基础素材池。
location默认LOCATION_HAND + LOCATION_MZONE。魔法与陷阱区域或墓地中受EFFECT_EXTRA_FUSION_MATERIAL影响的卡只加入第1个返回Group；第2个Group只包含location指定位置的卡。
core_summary_en: Returns all Fusion Material candidates and the requested-location base pool.
core_summary_zh: 返回全部融合素材候选和指定位置的基础素材池。

params.name: player
params.description: Player whose Fusion Material pool is collected.

params.name: location
params.description: Location mask for the base pool; default: LOCATION_HAND + LOCATION_MZONE.

returns.description: All currently usable Fusion Material candidates, including extra Fusion Material effects.
Base material pool from the requested locations only.

summary_en: Returns player's current LP.
summary_zh: 返回player当前LP。

summary_en: Returns the last HINT_SELECTMSG hint sent to player.
Returns a Group of cards in player-relative locations s and o that are linked.
Use the Card.GetLinkedGroup method when checking one Link Monster; use this Duel helper for field-wide location-mask checks.
summary_zh: 返回player视角下s和o位置中处于连接状态区域的卡组成的Group。
检查单个连接怪兽时使用Card.GetLinkedGroup；需要按场上位置掩码进行全场检查时使用此Duel辅助函数。
core_summary_en: Returns linked cards in field locations.
core_summary_zh: 返回场上位置中的连接卡。

params.name: player
params.description: Perspective player.
params.description_zh: 视角玩家。

params.name: s
params.description: Location mask on player's side.
params.description_zh: player自己场上的位置掩码。

params.name: o
params.description: Location mask on the opponent's side from player's perspective.
params.description_zh: 从player视角看对方场上的位置掩码。

returns.description: Linked cards, or nil if player is invalid.

summary_en: Returns the number of cards linked to player-relative locations s and o.
summary_zh: 返回与player视角位置s和o连接的卡数量。

summary_en: Returns the zone bitmask currently pointed to by Link Markers from player's perspective.
Use bit operations to test individual zones. For one Link Monster's markers, use Card.GetLinkedZone.
summary_zh: 返回从player视角看当前被连接标记指向的区域位掩码。
检查单个区域时配合位运算。若只检查一只连接怪兽的连接标记，使用Card.GetLinkedZone。
core_summary_en: Returns linked-zone bitmask.

params.name: player
params.description: Perspective player for the returned zone mask.
params.description_zh: 返回区域掩码时使用的视角玩家。

returns.description: Linked-zone bitmask from player's perspective.
returns.description_zh: player视角下的连接区域位掩码。

summary_en: Returns how many zones of location are available on player's field and the corresponding usable zone mask.
location is normally LOCATION_MZONE or LOCATION_SZONE. use_player, reason, and zone are used by effects that restrict where cards can be placed, such as Kaiser Colosseum-style restrictions.
The count can be negative, so scripts that free a zone as a cost sometimes check ft > -1 instead of ft > 0.
summary_zh: 返回player场上location中可用区域数量以及对应的可用区域掩码。
location通常为LOCATION_MZONE或LOCATION_SZONE。use_player、reason和zone用于会限制放置区域的效果，例如类似凯撒斗技场的限制。
数量可能为负数；因此会把区域作为Cost腾出的脚本有时检查ft > -1，而不是ft > 0。
core_summary_en: Returns the available zone count and usable zone mask for location on player's field.
core_summary_zh: 返回玩家player场上location可用区域数量以及对应的可用区域mask。

params.name: player
params.description: Player whose field is checked.
params.description_zh: 要检查其场上的玩家。

params.name: location
params.description: Location to count, normally LOCATION_MZONE or LOCATION_SZONE.
params.description_zh: 要统计的位置，通常为LOCATION_MZONE或LOCATION_SZONE。

params.name: use_player
params.description: Player treated as placing the card. Defaults to the current reason player.
params.description_zh: 视为要放置卡的玩家。省略时使用当前原因玩家。

params.name: reason
params.description: Placement reason such as LOCATION_REASON_TOFIELD or LOCATION_REASON_CONTROL. Defaults to LOCATION_REASON_TOFIELD.
params.description_zh: 放置原因，例如LOCATION_REASON_TOFIELD或LOCATION_REASON_CONTROL。省略时为LOCATION_REASON_TOFIELD。

params.name: zone
params.description: Zone mask to restrict the count. Defaults to 0xff.
params.description_zh: 限制统计范围的区域掩码。省略时为0xff。

returns.description: Available zone count. The core comment notes this can be negative.
returns.description_zh: 可用区域数量。核心注释说明该值可能为负数。

returns.description: Usable zone mask.
returns.description_zh: 可用区域掩码。

summary_en: Returns the usable Monster Zone count for Special Summoning from the Extra Deck, followed by the usable zone mask.
reason_player defaults to the current reason player. targets are treated as leaving the field before the count is checked.
summary_zh: 返回从额外卡组特殊召唤时可用的怪兽区域数量，并额外返回可用区域掩码。
reason_player省略时使用当前原因玩家。targets会在检查数量前视为将离场。
core_summary_en: Returns Extra Deck Special Summon zone availability.

returns.description: Number of usable Monster Zones.
Usable zone mask.

summary_en: Returns the number of usable Monster Zones for player after targets leave, plus the usable zone mask.
use_player, reason, and zone are used by effects that restrict where monsters can be placed.
summary_zh: 返回targets离场后player可用的怪兽区域数量，并额外返回可用区域掩码。
use_player、reason和zone用于会限制怪兽可放置区域的效果。
core_summary_en: Returns Monster Zone availability after targets leave.
core_summary_zh: 返回targets离场后的怪兽区域可用情况。

params.name: player
params.description: Player whose Monster Zones are checked.
params.description_zh: 要检查其怪兽区域的玩家。

params.name: targets
params.description: Card or Group treated as leaving the field before the count is checked.
params.description_zh: 在统计前视为将离场的Card或Group。

params.name: use_player
params.description: Player treated as placing the monster. Defaults to the current reason player.
params.description_zh: 视为要放置怪兽的玩家。省略时使用当前原因玩家。

params.name: reason
params.description: Placement reason. Defaults to LOCATION_REASON_TOFIELD.
params.description_zh: 放置原因。省略时为LOCATION_REASON_TOFIELD。

params.name: zone
params.description: Monster Zone mask to restrict the count. Defaults to 0xff.
params.description_zh: 限制统计范围的怪兽区域掩码。省略时为0xff。

returns.description: Usable Monster Zone count after targets are ignored.
returns.description_zh: 忽略targets后的可用怪兽区域数量。

returns.description: Usable Monster Zone mask.
returns.description_zh: 可用怪兽区域掩码。

summary_en: Returns a Group containing cards from the specified locations that satisfy filter f and are not excluded by ex.
s is player's own location mask and o is the opponent's location mask from that player's viewpoint. Extra arguments after ex are passed to f.
summary_zh: 返回指定位置中满足筛选函数f且不在ex中的卡组成的Group。
s是player视角下己方位置掩码，o是对方位置掩码；ex之后的额外参数会传给f。
core_summary_en: Returns matching cards from the specified locations as a Group.
core_summary_zh: 返回以player来看指定位置中满足f且不等于ex的卡组成的Group。

params.name: f
params.description: Filter callback; nil accepts cards that pass location and exclusion checks.

params.name: player
params.description: Reference player for the s and o location masks.

params.name: s
params.description: Location mask on player's side.

params.name: o
params.description: Location mask on the opponent's side from player's viewpoint.

params.name: ex
params.description: Card or Group excluded from the result; nil excludes nothing.
Extra values forwarded to f after the candidate Card.

returns.description: New Group containing every matching card.

summary_en: Counts cards in the specified locations that satisfy filter f and are not excluded by ex.
Extra arguments after ex are passed to f after the card argument.
Returns the group of cards that must be used as material.
Returns the group of cards actually processed by the most recent card operation.
summary_zh: 返回最近一次卡片操作实际处理过的卡组。

summary_en: Returns the number of operation categories recorded for chainc.
Returns operation information recorded for category on chainc.
The first return value is false when that category is not recorded. Otherwise, the remaining values correspond to Duel.SetOperationInfo: targets, count, target_player, and target_param.
Returns the number of Xyz Materials attached to cards in player-relative locations s and o.
summary_zh: 返回player视角下s和o位置中的超量素材数量。
core_summary_en: Counts Xyz Materials in field locations.
core_summary_zh: 统计场上位置中的超量素材。

returns.description: Overlay count, or nil if player is invalid.

summary_en: Returns the Xyz Materials attached to cards in player-relative locations s and o.
summary_zh: 返回player视角下s和o位置中卡片叠放的超量素材Group。
core_summary_en: Returns overlay cards in locations.
core_summary_zh: 返回位置中的超量素材。

returns.description: Overlay group, or nil if player is invalid.

summary_en: Returns the number of chains whose Target function has already been executed.
Returns the cards player can Tribute/Release for effect purposes. If use_hand is true, valid cards in the hand are included.
Returns the number of cards player can Tribute/Release for effect purposes. If use_hand is true, valid cards in the hand are included.
Returns the cards player can use as basic Ritual Material.
The group includes cards in the hand or field that can be Tributed, plus Ritual-material exceptions such as suitable cards in the Graveyard.
This is only the starting pool. After a Ritual Monster is chosen, filter the group with Card.IsCanBeRitualMaterial and then perform the exact or greater-or-equal material total check.
summary_zh: 返回player可作为基础仪式素材使用的卡。
该组包含手牌或场上可被解放的卡，也包含仪式素材例外，例如合适的墓地卡。
这只是起始素材池。选定仪式怪兽后，仍应使用Card.IsCanBeRitualMaterial过滤，并继续检查素材合计是否正好相等或大于等于需求。

summary_en: Returns an extended Ritual Material pool, including monsters without a Level.
