Local Drytron-style scripts use this when the Ritual procedure compares something other than ordinary Levels, such as an ATK-based value.
After collecting the group, still apply the script's own race, card text, and Ritual Monster material checks.
summary_zh: 返回扩展仪式素材池，其中包含没有等级的怪兽。
本地Drytron风格脚本在仪式手续比较普通等级以外的数值时使用它，例如基于攻击力的数值。
取得该组后，仍需继续套用脚本自身的种族、卡片文本以及仪式怪兽素材检查。

summary_en: Returns the number of available Spell & Trap Zones for player after targets leave, optionally restricted by zone. The Field Zone is not included.
The additional use_player and reason parameters are used by effects that restrict zones, such as Kaiser Colosseum.
summary_zh: 返回targets离场后player可用的魔法与陷阱区域数量，并可用zone限制统计范围；不包含场地区域。
额外的use_player和reason参数用于会限制区域的效果，例如凯撒斗技场。
core_summary_en: Returns Spell & Trap Zone availability after targets leave.
core_summary_zh: 返回targets离场后的魔法与陷阱区域可用情况。

params.name: player
params.description: Player whose Spell & Trap Zones are checked.
params.description_zh: 要检查其魔法与陷阱区域的玩家。

params.name: targets
params.description: Card or Group treated as leaving the field before the count is checked.
params.description_zh: 在统计前视为将离场的Card或Group。

params.name: use_player
params.description: Player treated as placing the card. Defaults to the current reason player.
params.description_zh: 视为要放置卡的玩家。省略时使用当前原因玩家。

params.name: reason
params.description: Placement reason. Defaults to LOCATION_REASON_TOFIELD.
params.description_zh: 放置原因。省略时为LOCATION_REASON_TOFIELD。

params.name: zone
params.description: Spell & Trap Zone mask to restrict the count. Defaults to 0xff.
params.description_zh: 限制统计范围的魔法与陷阱区域掩码。省略时为0xff。

returns.description: Usable Spell & Trap Zone count after targets are ignored.
returns.description_zh: 忽略targets后的可用魔法与陷阱区域数量。

returns.description: Usable Spell & Trap Zone mask.
returns.description_zh: 可用魔法与陷阱区域掩码。

summary_en: Gets the group of cards player can use as Synchro Material.
Face-down cards in the Monster Zone are omitted unless facedown is true.
summary_zh: 返回player可作为同调素材使用的卡组。
怪兽区域中里侧表示的卡只有在facedown为true时才包含。

summary_en: Counts cards matching filter in the given field locations that can be used as effect targets, excluding exception when supplied.
summary_zh: 统计给定场上位置中匹配filter且可作为效果对象的卡数量；提供exception时将其排除。
core_summary_en: Counts targetable matching cards.
core_summary_zh: 统计可取对象的匹配卡。

summary_en: Returns all target cards currently related to the resolving Chain.
This is the relation-aware helper for multi-target operations; targets that left their expected place are omitted from the returned Group.
summary_zh: 返回当前正在处理的连锁中仍与该连锁有关联的全部对象卡。
这是多对象操作常用的关联检查辅助函数；已经离开预期位置的对象不会包含在返回的Group中。
core_summary_en: Returns target cards still related to the current Chain.
core_summary_zh: 返回仍与当前连锁有关联的对象卡。

returns.description: New Group containing the current Chain targets whose Chain relation is still valid; empty when none qualify.

summary_en: Returns the number of available Tribute candidates for target, optionally restricted to mg and extra handling.
summary_zh: 返回target可用的祭品候选数量，可选用mg和额外处理限制。

summary_en: Returns the Group of cards that can be Tributed for a Normal Summon/Set of target.
summary_zh: 返回可为target通常召唤/盖放而解放的卡组成的Group。

summary_en: Returns the current turn count.
With no player argument, this returns the duel-wide turn number; with player 0 or 1, it returns that player's personal turn count.
summary_zh: 返回当前回合数。
不传player时返回整场决斗的回合数；传入player 0或1时返回该玩家经过的个人回合数。

summary_en: Returns the current turn player.
Returns how many Monster Zones player can use for a monster entering the field.
use_player defaults to the current reason player and is used for zone-limit checks involving the acting player.
summary_zh: 返回player可用于怪兽进场的怪兽区域数量。
use_player省略时使用当前原因玩家，并用于涉及行动玩家的区域限制检查。
core_summary_en: Returns usable Monster Zone count.
core_summary_zh: 返回可用怪兽区域数量。

params.name: use_player
params.description: default: current reason player

returns.description: Usable Monster Zone count, or nil if player is invalid.

summary_en: Returns the current must-select cards as a Group and clears the core must-select list.
summary_zh: 把当前必须选择的卡作为Group返回，并清空核心必须选择列表。

summary_en: Sends a hint message of hint_type to player using desc as the message id.
For HINT_SELECTMSG, desc is also stored as that player's last selection hint. HINT_OPSELECTED is displayed to the other player.
core_summary_en: Sends a hint message of hint_type to player using desc as the message id.
core_summary_zh: 给玩家player发送hint_type类型的提示消息，提示内容为desc。

summary_en: Displays the selection animation for g and records those cards as selected for client feedback.
Consumes the current reason player's Normal Summon/Set count, or invokes c's extra summon-count effect when present.
summary_zh: 消耗当前原因玩家的通常召唤/盖放次数；若c存在额外召唤次数效果，则调用该效果。

summary_en: Checks whether the current turn player can still enter the Battle Phase.
The core requires the duel to allow first-turn attacks or not be turn 1, the current phase to be before PHASE_BATTLE_START, and the turn player not to be affected by EFFECT_CANNOT_BP.
summary_zh: 检查当前回合玩家是否仍能进入战斗阶段。
核心要求决斗允许先攻攻击或当前不是第1回合，当前阶段早于PHASE_BATTLE_START，并且回合玩家不受EFFECT_CANNOT_BP影响。
core_summary_en: Checks whether the current turn player can enter the Battle Phase.
core_summary_zh: 检查当前回合玩家能否进入战斗阶段。

summary_en: Returns whether the current phase is the Battle Phase.
With only player, checks whether player is not forbidden from placing counters.
With countertype, count, and c, checks whether player can place that many counters of countertype on c.
summary_zh: 只提供player时，检查player是否未被禁止放置指示物。
提供countertype、count和c时，检查player能否在c上放置该数量的countertype指示物。
core_summary_en: Checks whether counters can be placed.
core_summary_zh: 检查是否能放置指示物。

summary_en: Checks whether player can remove count counters of countertype for reason from the selected field locations.
s marks locations on player's own field and o marks locations on the opponent's field, from player's perspective.
summary_zh: 检查player能否因reason从指定场上位置取除count个countertype类型的指示物。
s表示从player视角看的己方场上位置，o表示对方场上位置。
core_summary_en: Checks whether player can remove counters from field locations.
core_summary_zh: 检查player能否从场上位置取除指示物。

summary_en: Checks whether chainc's effect can be negated.
While a Chain is resolving, this asks the core whether that Chain link can currently be disabled; outside Chain resolution it returns true.
summary_zh: 检查chainc的效果能否被无效。
连锁处理中会询问核心该连锁环节当前能否被无效；不在连锁处理中时返回true。

summary_en: Checks whether chainc has already been negated.
Compatibility check for whether chainc's activation can be negated.
In this MDPro3 core binding, the function currently returns true for any chain count.
Local scripts still call it in negation conditions so the script expresses the intended activation-legality check.
summary_zh: 用于兼容的连锁发动可否被无效检查。
在当前MDPro3核心绑定中，此函数对任意连锁序号都会返回true。
本地脚本仍会在无效发动的条件中调用它，用来表达预期的发动合法性检查。

params.name: chainc
params.description: Chain Link number to test, commonly the ev argument in an EVENT_CHAINING condition.
params.description_zh: 要检查的连锁序号，通常是EVENT_CHAINING条件中的ev参数。

returns.description: true when this binding considers that Chain Link's activation negatable.
returns.description_zh: 若当前绑定认为该连锁环节的发动可以被无效则为true。

summary_en: Checks whether the game is currently resolving a Chain or resolving an effect that does not start a Chain.
Returns whether damage calculation has been performed in the current battle/damage-step state.
Use it with Duel.GetCurrentPhase in Damage Step conditions, especially for ATK/DEF-changing effects that stop being legal after damage calculation.
summary_zh: 返回当前战斗/伤害步骤状态中是否已经进行过伤害计算。
在伤害步骤条件中可与Duel.GetCurrentPhase搭配使用，尤其适用于伤害计算后不能再发动的ATK/DEF变更效果。
core_summary_en: Returns whether damage calculation is complete.
core_summary_zh: 返回是否已进行伤害计算。

returns.description: true after damage calculation has been performed in the current battle timing.
returns.description_zh: 当前战斗时点已经进行过伤害计算时为true。

summary_en: Checks whether code is currently treated as the environment card or as a matching face-up card in the requested locations.

player defaults to PLAYER_ALL and loc defaults to LOCATION_ONFIELD. The core checks Field Zones first; if no face-up Field Zone card exists, it can also match the latest EFFECT_CHANGE_ENVIRONMENT effect.
summary_zh: 检查code当前是否被视为环境卡，或是否在请求的位置中存在匹配的表侧表示卡。
player默认PLAYER_ALL，loc默认LOCATION_ONFIELD。核心会先检查场地区域；若没有表侧场地区域卡，也可以匹配最新的EFFECT_CHANGE_ENVIRONMENT效果。
core_summary_en: Checks the current environment card/code state.
core_summary_zh: 检查当前环境卡/卡号状态。

params.name: player
params.description: default: PLAYER_ALL

params.name: loc
params.description: default: LOCATION_ONFIELD

summary_en: Checks whether the specified locations contain at least count cards that satisfy filter f and are not excluded by ex.
s is player's own location mask and o is the opponent's location mask from that player's viewpoint. Extra arguments after ex are passed to f.
core_summary_en: Checks whether the specified locations contain at least count matching cards.
core_summary_zh: 过滤函数；检查以player来看指定位置是否存在至少count张满足f且不等于ex的卡。

summary_en: Checks whether the specified locations contain at least count cards that satisfy filter f, are not excluded by ex, and can be targeted by the currently handled effect.
Use this in Target callbacks when the card must become an official effect target.
summary_zh: 检查指定位置中是否存在至少count张满足筛选函数f、未被ex排除、且可以成为当前处理效果对象的卡。
当卡需要成为正式效果对象时，在Target回调中使用此函数。
core_summary_en: Checks whether enough matching cards can become targets for the current effect.
core_summary_zh: 检查指定位置是否存在足够数量、满足f且可以成为当前效果对象的卡。

params.name: f
params.description: Filter called with each candidate card first, then any extra arguments after ex.

params.name: player
params.description: Viewpoint player for s and o.

params.name: s
params.description: Locations on player's side to search.

params.name: o
params.description: Locations on the opponent's side to search.

params.name: count
params.description: Minimum number of legal targets required.

params.name: ex
params.description: Card or Group excluded from the search.
Extra values passed to f after the candidate card.

returns.description: True if at least count matching cards can be targeted by the current effect.

summary_en: Returns whether the current phase is a Main Phase.
Returns whether the current phase is phase.
Returns an effect affecting player with code, or nil if no matching effect exists. Some effects may return additional values.
Returns true when player has no pending extra Normal Summon marker in core.extra_summon.
summary_zh: 当player在core.extra_summon中没有待处理的额外通常召唤标记时返回true。
core_summary_en: Checks extra Normal Summon availability.
core_summary_zh: 检查额外通常召唤可用性。

summary_en: Checks whether player can send count cards from the top of the Deck to the Graveyard.
Checks whether player can send count cards from the top of the Deck to the Graveyard as a cost.
Checks whether player can draw count cards.
Checks whether player can Flip Summon at all, or whether player can Flip Summon c.
summary_zh: 检查player是否能进行反转召唤，或检查player能否反转召唤c。

summary_en: Checks whether player can Set monsters at all, or whether player can Set c with summon type sumtype.
summary_zh: 检查player是否能盖放怪兽，或检查player能否以召唤类型sumtype盖放c。

summary_en: Checks whether player can release cards at all, or whether player can release c for reason.
When c is supplied and reason is omitted, the core uses REASON_COST.
summary_zh: 检查player是否能进行解放，或检查player能否以reason解放c。
提供c但省略reason时，核心使用REASON_COST。
core_summary_en: Checks whether a player can release.

params.name: reason
params.description: default: REASON_COST

summary_en: With only player, checks whether player is not forbidden from banishing.
With c, checks whether player can banish c for reason; reason defaults to REASON_EFFECT.
summary_zh: 只提供player时，检查player是否未被禁止除外。
提供c时，检查player能否因reason除外c；reason默认REASON_EFFECT。
core_summary_en: Checks whether player can banish.

params.name: reason
params.description: default: REASON_EFFECT

summary_en: Checks whether player can Set Spell/Trap Cards at all, or whether player can Set c as a Spell/Trap Card.
summary_zh: 检查player是否能盖放魔法/陷阱，或检查player能否把c作为魔法/陷阱盖放。
core_summary_en: Checks Spell/Trap Set permission.
core_summary_zh: 检查魔法/陷阱盖放权限。

summary_en: Checks whether player can send cards to the Deck at all, or whether player can send c to the Deck.
summary_zh: 检查player是否能把卡送去Deck，或检查player能否把c送去Deck。

summary_en: Checks whether player can send c to the Graveyard.
Checks whether player can send cards to the hand at all, or whether player can send c to the hand.
summary_zh: 检查player是否能把卡送去手牌，或检查player能否把c送去手牌。

summary_en: With only player, checks whether player is allowed to perform a Special Summon and still has Special Summon count available.
With the optional card-specific arguments, checks whether player can Special Summon c to target_player in sumpos with sumtype, using the current reason effect.
summary_zh: 只提供player时，检查player是否允许进行特殊召唤，且仍有可用的特殊召唤次数。
提供可选的卡片相关参数时，使用当前原因效果检查player能否以sumtype和sumpos把c特殊召唤到target_player场上。
core_summary_en: Checks whether player can Special Summon.

summary_en: Checks whether player can perform count Special Summons under the current remaining Special Summon-count limits.
The core checks EFFECT_LEFT_SPSUMMON_COUNT effects and the player's Special Summon counter.
summary_zh: 检查player在当前剩余特殊召唤次数限制下，能否进行count次特殊召唤。
核心会检查EFFECT_LEFT_SPSUMMON_COUNT效果以及该玩家的特殊召唤计数器。
core_summary_en: Checks whether player can perform count Special Summons.
core_summary_zh: 检查player能否进行count次特殊召唤。

summary_en: Checks whether player can Special Summon a virtual monster with the supplied card data.
Optional arguments override the loaded card data, then pos, target_player, and sumtype describe how and where the monster would be Summoned. This MDPro3 binding does not read a zone argument.
summary_zh: 检查player能否特殊召唤一只由传入卡片数据构造的虚拟怪兽。
可选参数会覆盖读取到的卡片数据，之后用pos、target_player和sumtype描述召唤方式与位置。当前MDPro3绑定不会读取zone参数。
core_summary_en: Checks whether a virtual monster can be Special Summoned with the supplied data.

returns.description: true if the virtual monster can be Special Summoned.

summary_en: With only player, checks whether player is not forbidden from performing a Normal Summon by an untargeted EFFECT_CANNOT_SUMMON.

With sumtype and c, checks player EFFECT_CANNOT_SUMMON restrictions for Normal Summoning c with that sumtype. This binding does not check Summon count, costs, tribute availability, or zone availability.
summary_zh: 只提供player时，检查player是否未被无目标的EFFECT_CANNOT_SUMMON禁止通常召唤。
提供sumtype和c时，检查player对c以该sumtype通常召唤时受到的EFFECT_CANNOT_SUMMON限制。该绑定不检查召唤次数、费用、解放可用性或区域可用性。
core_summary_en: Checks whether player can Normal Summon.

summary_en: Returns the core summon-cancelable flag for the current Summon selection.
summary_zh: 返回当前召唤选择的核心可取消标志。

summary_en: Returns whether playerid is the current turn player.
Performs a rule Link Summon for player and c using an optional material group, fixed material, and min/max constraints.
Use this in effect operations after checking Card.IsLinkSummonable. The selected Link Monster's registered procedure still controls final material selection and sends materials to the GY.
The core rejects this during the Damage Step, yields while the Summon is processed, and returns no Lua value.
summary_zh: 为player和c执行规则连接召唤，可使用可选素材Group、固定素材和min/max限制。
通常在效果operation中先检查Card.IsLinkSummonable，再调用此函数。被选择连接怪兽已登记的手续仍负责最终素材选择，并把素材送去墓地。
核心在伤害步骤中会拒绝调用；处理召唤时会让脚本等待，且没有Lua返回值。
core_summary_en: Performs a rule Link Summon.

params.name: player
params.description: Player performing the Link Summon.
params.description_zh: 进行连接召唤的玩家。

params.name: c
params.description: Link Monster to Link Summon.
params.description_zh: 要连接召唤的连接怪兽。

params.name: materials
params.description: Optional temporary material pool. nil uses the Link Monster's normal procedure pool.
params.description_zh: 可选的临时素材池。nil表示使用该连接怪兽手续的通常素材池。

params.name: lcard
params.description: Optional fixed material that must be included in the selected group.
params.description_zh: 可选的固定素材；选择的Group必须包含它。

params.name: minc
params.description: Runtime minimum material-card count. default: 0
params.description_zh: 运行时素材卡数量下限。默认值：0

params.name: maxc
params.description: Runtime maximum material-card count. default: 0
params.description_zh: 运行时素材卡数量上限。默认值：0

summary_en: Makes player Set c by a Normal Summon procedure, optionally using effect e and requiring at least min Tributes.
If e is nil, regular Normal Summon/Set rules are used. If ignore_count is true, the once-per-turn Normal Summon limit is ignored.
Copies monster initial effects from copy_target onto c until the End Phase.
It copies chain-link monster effects, skips Xyz Material effects, converts mandatory trigger/quick effects to optional versions, and does not copy Spell/Trap effects.
summary_zh: 把copy_target的怪兽initial_effect复制给c，持续到结束阶段。
它复制连锁环怪兽效果，跳过超量素材效果，把强制诱发/快速效果改成任意发动版本，并且不复制魔法/陷阱效果。

summary_en: Moves c to sequence seq within its current controller and location if c is affected by the resolving reason effect.
The core raises EVENT_MOVE for the moved card and returns no Lua values.
summary_zh: 若c受当前处理中的原因效果影响，将c在其当前控制者与当前位置内移动到序号seq。
核心会对移动的卡引发EVENT_MOVE，且不返回Lua值。
core_summary_en: Moves c to another sequence in its current location.
core_summary_zh: 将c移动到当前位置内的另一序号。

summary_en: Moves c onto target_player's field and returns true if the move succeeds.
dest is normally LOCATION_MZONE or LOCATION_SZONE. LOCATION_FZONE and LOCATION_PZONE are accepted and converted to the matching Spell & Trap Zone handling by the core.
Attempts to negate the activation of chainc and returns true if it succeeds.
summary_zh: 尝试把chainc的发动无效，并返回是否成功。

summary_en: Attempts to negate the current attack and returns whether the attack was successfully negated.

The core fails if there is no valid current attacker, if the attacker moved or changed field ID, if the attacker cannot attack, if the Damage Step state blocks attack negation, or if the attacker is not affected by the resolving effect.
summary_zh: 尝试无效当前攻击，并返回是否成功无效该次攻击。
没有有效攻击怪兽、攻击怪兽离场或field ID变化、攻击怪兽不能攻击、伤害步骤状态不允许无效攻击，或攻击怪兽不受当前处理效果影响时，核心返回false。
core_summary_en: Attempts to negate the current attack.

summary_en: Attempts to negate the effect of chainc and returns true if it succeeds. forced requests a forced disable.
summary_zh: 尝试把chainc的效果无效，并返回是否成功。forced表示请求强制无效。

summary_en: For each current Chain Link whose triggering effect is handled by c and still related to c, registers a temporary EFFECT_DISABLE_CHAIN effect on c.

The generated disable effect resets with RESET_CHAIN, RESET_EVENT, and the supplied reset flags. The core does nothing if there is no earlier Chain Link to disable or if c is unaffected by the resolving effect.
summary_zh: 对当前连锁中由c发动且仍与c保持关联的连锁，给c登记临时的EFFECT_DISABLE_CHAIN效果。
该无效效果以RESET_CHAIN、RESET_EVENT和传入的reset标志重置；若没有可处理的早前连锁，或c不受当前处理效果影响，核心不做处理。
core_summary_en: Registers temporary chain-disable effects for related Chain Links handled by c.
core_summary_zh: 为c相关的连锁登记临时连锁无效效果。

params.name: c
params.description: Card whose related earlier Chain Links should receive EFFECT_DISABLE_CHAIN.

params.name: reset_flag
params.description: Additional reset mask ORed with RESET_CHAIN and RESET_EVENT on each generated disable effect.

summary_en: Negates a current Normal Summon, Flip Summon, or Special Summon for targets.

targets may be a Card or Group. Normal and Flip Summon negation require a single card; Special Summon negation can process a group and only negates cards whose Summon is negatable by the current reason effect. The core raises the matching *_SUMMON_NEGATED event and returns no Lua value.
summary_zh: 无效targets正在进行的通常召唤、反转召唤或特殊召唤。
targets可以是Card或Group。通常召唤与反转召唤的无效要求只有1张卡；特殊召唤无效可以处理Group，并且只无效当前原因效果可以无效其召唤的卡。核心会引发对应的*_SUMMON_NEGATED事件，且不返回Lua值。
core_summary_en: Negates the current Summon for targets.
core_summary_zh: 无效targets当前正在进行的召唤。

summary_en: Overlays ocard under c as Xyz Material.
This moves a Card or Group under c; it does not by itself perform a proper Xyz Summon or mark the monster's procedure complete.
By default the field is adjusted after the overlay. Pass adjust=false only when a larger procedure will adjust afterward.
summary_zh: 把ocard叠放在c下方作为超量素材。
这会把一张卡或一个Group移动到c下方；它本身不会执行正规超量召唤，也不会把怪兽标记为已完成正规手续。
默认会在叠放后调整场地。只有在更大的手续稍后会统一调整时，才传入adjust=false。
core_summary_en: Overlays cards under an Xyz Monster.
core_summary_zh: 把卡叠放在超量怪兽下。

params.name: c
params.description: Card that will receive the Xyz Materials.
params.description_zh: 接收超量素材的卡。

params.name: ocard
params.description: Card or Group to overlay under c.
params.description_zh: 要叠放到c下方的卡或Group。

params.name: adjust
params.description: Whether to adjust the field after overlaying. Defaults to true.
params.description_zh: 叠放后是否调整场地。默认为true。

summary_en: Makes player pay the specified LP cost.
Call this only in the real Cost branch after the chk==0 branch has used Duel.CheckLPCost or an equivalent legality check.
summary_zh: 使player支付指定LP Cost。
只应在实际Cost分支调用；chk==0分支应先使用Duel.CheckLPCost或等价检查确认可以支付。
core_summary_en: Processes LP cost payment.

params.name: player
params.description: Player who pays the LP cost.
params.description_zh: 支付LP Cost的玩家。

params.name: cost
params.description: LP amount to pay.
params.description_zh: 要支付的LP数值。

params.name: must_pay
params.description: Passed through to the core LP-cost payment processor.
params.description_zh: 传给核心LP Cost支付处理器。

summary_en: Completes reserved step damage/recover processing after Duel.Damage or Duel.Recover is called with is_step=true.
summary_zh: 在Duel.Damage或Duel.Recover以is_step=true调用后，完成保留的分步伤害/恢复处理。
core_summary_en: Completes reserved step damage/recover processing.
core_summary_zh: 完成保留的分步伤害/恢复处理。

summary_en: Raises event code for a Card or Group with the supplied effect, reason, reason player, event player, and event value.
The core processes instant events after raising the event and yields without returning Lua values.
summary_zh: 以给定效果、原因、原因玩家、事件玩家和事件值，对Card或Group引发事件code。
核心在引发事件后处理即时事件并yield，不返回Lua值。
core_summary_en: Raises an event for a Card or Group.

summary_en: Raises a single-card event for ec with code, re, r, rp, ep, and ev, then processes single-card events.
summary_zh: 以code、re、r、rp、ep、ev为ec引发单卡事件，然后处理单卡事件。
core_summary_en: Raises a single-card event.

summary_en: Requests a field readjust for the current reason effect's handler.
If the same handler requests readjustment more than three times in the current tracking map, the core sends it to the Graveyard by rule instead.
summary_zh: 为当前原因效果的处理对象请求场地重新调整。
同一处理对象在当前追踪表中请求超过3次时，核心会把它因规则送去墓地。
core_summary_en: Requests field readjustment.

summary_en: Gives player LP for reason and returns the amount processed.
Effects can reverse recovery into damage. With is_step=true, finish the damage/recovery batch with Duel.RDComplete.
summary_zh: 为player恢复LP并返回处理的数值。
效果可以把恢复反转为伤害。is_step=true时，需要用Duel.RDComplete完成本批伤害/恢复处理。

summary_en: Registers e as a player/global effect for player.
Registers a player/global flag effect on player and returns the created Effect.
The flag effect is player-targeted, field-only, cannot be disabled, and count=0 is treated as 1.
summary_zh: 为player登记玩家/全局标记效果，并返回创建的Effect。
该标记效果以玩家为对象、只作为场地效果存在、不能被无效，且count=0会按1处理。
core_summary_en: Registers a player/global flag effect.
core_summary_zh: 登记玩家/全局标记效果。

params.name: player
params.description: Player that receives the marker; invalid players make the core return no values.

params.name: code
params.description: Flag-effect code; the core masks it with MAX_CARD_ID and adds EFFECT_FLAG_EFFECT.

params.name: reset_flag
params.description: RESET_* mask controlling when the marker expires.

params.name: property
params.description: Effect property flags stored on the created marker; player-target, field-only, and cannot-disable flags are always added.

params.name: reset_count
params.description: Reset counter for the created marker; 0 is treated as 1.

params.name: label
params.description: Optional integer payload stored on the marker.

returns.description: The created flag effect, or nil if player is invalid.

summary_en: Tributes/Releases targets for reason and returns the number of cards actually released.
Use REASON_COST when paying a cost and REASON_EFFECT or REASON_SPSUMMON when the release is part of an effect or Summon procedure.
Moves the selected Ritual Materials in g using Ritual-material rules.
Standard hand or field materials are Tributed, while materials such as suitable Graveyard Ritual Materials are banished instead.
Call Card.SetMaterial before this function, then Special Summon with SUMMON_TYPE_RITUAL and call Card.CompleteProcedure after the Summon succeeds. The function does not return a count.
summary_zh: 按照仪式素材规则移动g中选定的仪式素材。
通常的手牌或场上素材会被解放，而合适的墓地仪式素材等会改为除外。
调用此函数前应先调用Card.SetMaterial；之后以SUMMON_TYPE_RITUAL特殊召唤，并在召唤成功后调用Card.CompleteProcedure。本函数不返回数量。

summary_en: Banishes targets in position pos for reason and returns the number of cards actually banished.
If reason includes REASON_TEMPORARY, the banish is treated as temporary and the card can later be returned with Duel.ReturnToField.
Lets player remove count counters of countertype from the selected field locations for reason and returns whether removal succeeded.

s marks locations on player's own field and o marks locations on the opponent's field, from player's perspective. The core can offer applicable counter-removal replacement effects before removing counters.
summary_zh: 让player因reason从指定场上位置取除count个countertype类型的指示物，并返回是否成功取除。
s表示从player视角看的己方场上位置，o表示对方场上位置。核心会在取除指示物前提供可适用的指示物取除替代效果。
core_summary_en: Removes counters from selected field locations.
core_summary_zh: 从指定场上位置取除指示物。

summary_en: Lets player remove between min and max Xyz Materials from the specified own/opponent field locations for reason.
s marks locations on player's own field and o marks locations on the opponent's field, from player's perspective. The return value is the number of materials removed.
summary_zh: 让player因reason从指定的己方/对方场上位置取除min到max个超量素材。
s表示从player视角看的己方场上位置，o表示对方场上位置。返回值为实际取除的素材数量。
core_summary_en: Removes Xyz Materials.

summary_en: Resets all player flag effects with code for player.
summary_zh: 重置player持有的code对应全部玩家标志效果。
core_summary_en: Resets player flag effects.

params.name: player
params.description: Player whose matching flag effects are reset.

params.name: code
params.description: Flag-effect code to clear.

summary_en: Returns a card temporarily removed from the field to its previous controller and previous location.

pos defaults to the previous position and zone defaults to 0xff. If c was not removed for REASON_TEMPORARY, the binding returns no Lua value; otherwise it yields and returns whether the move succeeded.
summary_zh: 把临时离场的卡返回到其之前的控制者和之前的位置。
pos默认之前的表示形式，zone默认0xff。若c不是因REASON_TEMPORARY离场，该绑定不返回Lua值；否则会yield并返回移动是否成功。
core_summary_en: Returns a temporarily removed card to the field.
core_summary_zh: 把临时离场的卡返回场上。

params.name: pos
params.description: default: previous position

params.name: zone
params.description: default: 0xff

returns.description: Success flag, or nil if c was not temporarily removed from the field.

summary_en: Enables showing the real sequence when selecting cards from the Deck.
Runs the Rock-Paper-Scissors selector and returns the winning player; repeat defaults to true.
summary_zh: 执行猜拳选择并返回胜方玩家；repeat默认true。
core_summary_en: Runs Rock-Paper-Scissors.

params.name: repeat
params.description: default: true

returns.description: Winning player.

summary_en: Makes player Set targets to target_player's Spell & Trap Zone. If targets is a Group, returns the number of cards successfully Set.
Lets player select count available field zones from the requested own-side and opponent-side locations, then returns the selected zone bitmask.
location1 applies to player's field and location2 applies to the opponent's field. The core clamps count to the available number of zones and returns no value if no zone can be selected.
The returned mask uses player-relative bits: own Monster Zone seq, own Spell & Trap Zone seq+8, opponent Monster Zone seq+16, and opponent Spell & Trap Zone seq+24.
summary_zh: 让player从请求的己方与对方位置中选择count个可用场地区域，并返回所选区域位掩码。
location1应用于player场上，location2应用于对方场上。核心会把count限制为可用区域数量；没有可选区域时不返回值。
返回掩码使用player视角位：己方怪兽区域为seq，己方魔法与陷阱区域为seq+8，对方怪兽区域为seq+16，对方魔法与陷阱区域为seq+24。
core_summary_en: Lets player select field zones to disable.
core_summary_zh: 让player选择要禁用的场地区域。

params.name: player
params.description: Player who selects zones and whose viewpoint defines the returned mask.
params.description_zh: 选择区域的玩家；返回掩码也以该玩家视角表示。

params.name: count
params.description: Number of zones to select. The core reduces this to the number of available zones if needed.
params.description_zh: 要选择的区域数量；必要时核心会把该值限制到可用区域数量。

params.name: location1
params.description: Selectable locations on player's field, usually LOCATION_MZONE and/or LOCATION_SZONE.
params.description_zh: player场上可选择的位置，通常为LOCATION_MZONE和/或LOCATION_SZONE。

params.name: location2
params.description: Selectable locations on the opponent's field, usually LOCATION_MZONE and/or LOCATION_SZONE.
params.description_zh: 对方场上可选择的位置，通常为LOCATION_MZONE和/或LOCATION_SZONE。

params.name: filter
params.description: Player-relative mask of zones that cannot be selected.
params.description_zh: 以player视角表示的不可选择区域掩码。

returns.description: Selected zone bitmask, or no return value if no zone can be selected.
returns.description_zh: 所选区域掩码；没有可选区域时不返回值。

summary_en: Asks player whether to use c's effect with description id desc, defaulting to 95.
summary_zh: 询问player是否使用c的效果，提示描述编号为desc，省略时默认为95。

summary_en: Lets player select count field zones from location1/location2 after applying filter as unavailable zones.
When desc is supplied, the core shows it as a selection hint. The return value is a bitmask of selected zones from player's viewpoint.
summary_zh: 让player从location1/location2对应的场地区域中选择count个区域，并把filter视为不可选择区域。
提供desc时，核心会显示该选择提示。返回值是从player视角表示已选区域的位掩码。
core_summary_en: Lets player select field zones.

returns.description: Selected zone bitmask, or nil if player is invalid.

summary_en: Lets player select a valid Fusion Material group for Fusion Monster c from g and returns the selected Group.
gc, when supplied, must be included. The returned Group also contains gc, matching the core selection behavior.
summary_zh: 让player从g中为融合怪兽c选择有效的融合素材组，并返回选中的Group。
提供gc时，所选素材必须包含gc；返回的Group也会包含gc，与核心选择行为一致。
core_summary_en: Lets player select Fusion Materials for c from g.
core_summary_zh: 让player从g中为c选择融合素材。

params.name: chkf
params.description: default: PLAYER_NONE

params.name: not_material
params.description: default: false

summary_en: Lets sel_player choose min to max cards from the specified locations that satisfy filter f and are not excluded by ex.
s is player's own location mask and o is the opponent's location mask from that player's viewpoint. Extra arguments after ex are passed to f.
summary_zh: 让sel_player从指定位置中选择min到max张满足筛选函数f且不在ex中的卡。
s是player视角下己方位置掩码，o是对方位置掩码；ex之后的额外参数会传给f。
core_summary_en: Lets sel_player choose min to max matching cards from the specified locations.
core_summary_zh: 过滤函数；让玩家sel_player从指定位置选择min到max张满足f且不等于ex的卡。

params.name: sel_player
params.description: Player who makes the selection; invalid players make the core return no values.

params.name: f
params.description: Filter callback; nil accepts cards that pass location and exclusion checks.

params.name: player
params.description: Reference player for the s and o location masks.

params.name: s
params.description: Location mask on player's side.

params.name: o
params.description: Location mask on the opponent's side from player's viewpoint.

params.name: min
params.description: Minimum number of cards to select.

params.name: max
params.description: Maximum number of cards to select.

params.name: ex
params.description: Card or Group excluded from selectable cards; nil excludes nothing.
Extra values forwarded to f after the candidate Card.

returns.description: New Group containing the selected cards, or nil if sel_player is invalid.

summary_en: Shows player a list of description ids and returns the zero-based index of the selected option.
The selected description id is also announced to the client.
summary_zh: 让player从一组描述编号中选择1项，并返回所选项从0开始的序号。
所选描述编号也会作为客户端提示显示。

summary_en: Lets player choose one of the allowed positions for c and returns the selected POS_* value.
summary_zh: 让player为c从允许的表示形式中选择一个，并返回所选POS_*数值。
core_summary_en: Lets player select a position.

summary_en: Lets player select min to max releasable cards matching f, excluding ex, and returns the selected Group.
Extra arguments after ex are passed to f after the Card argument.
summary_zh: 让player选择min到max张满足f且不在ex中的可解放卡，并返回选中的Group。
ex之后的额外参数会传给f。

summary_en: Lets player select min to max cards that can be Tributed/Released for effect purposes, optionally excluding ex and applying filter f.
No-op stub in this core; it only checks action permission and returns no values.
summary_zh: 此核心中的空操作存根；只检查动作权限，不返回值。
core_summary_en: No-op stub in this core.
core_summary_zh: 此核心中的空操作存根。

summary_en: Lets player select Synchro Materials for c and returns the selected Group.
f1 filters the Tuner material, f2 filters non-Tuner materials, min and max restrict the non-Tuner count, smat forces a required material, and mg supplies an optional material pool.
summary_zh: 让player为c选择同调素材，并返回选中的Group。
f1筛选调整素材，f2筛选非调整素材，min和max限制非调整数量，smat指定必须包含的素材，mg提供可选的素材范围。

summary_en: Lets sel_player choose min to max cards that satisfy filter f, are not excluded by ex, and can be targeted by the currently handled effect.
The selected cards are registered as the current Chain's target cards. For non-continuous effects, the core also creates Chain relations used by IsRelateToEffect and related helpers.
summary_zh: 让sel_player选择min到max张满足筛选函数f、未被ex排除、且可以成为当前处理效果对象的卡。
选择的卡会登记为当前连锁的对象卡。对于非永续效果，核心还会建立供IsRelateToEffect等函数使用的连锁关联。
core_summary_en: Selects matching target cards and registers them as the current Chain's targets.
core_summary_zh: 选择满足条件的对象卡，并把选择结果登记为当前连锁的对象。

params.name: sel_player
params.description: Player who makes the selection.

params.name: f
params.description: Filter called with each candidate card first, then any extra arguments after ex.

params.name: player
params.description: Viewpoint player for s and o.

params.name: s
params.description: Locations on player's side to search.

params.name: o
params.description: Locations on the opponent's side to search.

params.name: min
params.description: Minimum number of cards to select.

params.name: max
params.description: Maximum number of cards to select.

params.name: ex
params.description: Card or Group excluded from the selection.
Extra values passed to f after the candidate card.

returns.description: Group of cards selected by sel_player and registered as current Chain targets. If there is no current Chain or sel_player is invalid, the core returns no value.

summary_en: Lets player select min to max Tribute candidates for Normal Summoning or Setting c and returns the selected Group.
mg can restrict the candidate pool. toplayer defaults to player; when toplayer differs, the core builds the extra release list for Tributing to that player's field.
summary_zh: 让player为通常召唤或盖放c选择min到max只祭品，并返回选择的Group。
mg可以限制候选素材池。toplayer默认player；toplayer不同于player时，核心会构建用于向该玩家场上解放的额外候选列表。
core_summary_en: Lets player select Tribute candidates for c.

params.name: toplayer
params.description: default: player

summary_en: Lets player select Synchro Materials for scard using the fixed tuner, optional filters, count limits, and optional material group.
summary_zh: 让player以固定tuner、可选筛选、数量限制和可选素材Group为scard选择同调素材。

summary_en: Lets player select Xyz Materials for scard for material Xyz Level lv and material count range, with optional filter and material group.
Use this only after a matching Duel.CheckXyzMaterial check has succeeded. It yields and returns the selected Group.
summary_zh: 让player为scard选择素材超量等级lv和素材数量范围对应的超量素材，可带可选筛选函数和素材Group。
只应在对应的Duel.CheckXyzMaterial检查成功后使用。它会让脚本等待选择并返回选择的Group。

params.name: player
params.description: Player choosing the Xyz Materials.
params.description_zh: 选择超量素材的玩家。

params.name: scard
params.description: Xyz Monster whose materials are being selected.
params.description_zh: 正在选择素材的超量怪兽。

params.name: f
params.description: Optional per-material filter.
params.description_zh: 可选的单张素材筛选函数。

params.name: lv
params.description: Required material Xyz Level.
params.description_zh: 要求的素材超量等级。

params.name: minc
params.description: Minimum material count.
params.description_zh: 素材数量下限。

params.name: maxc
params.description: Maximum material count.
params.description_zh: 素材数量上限。

params.name: materials
params.description: Optional candidate material group.
params.description_zh: 可选的候选素材Group。

returns.description: The selected Xyz Materials.
returns.description_zh: 被选择的超量素材Group。

summary_en: Asks player a yes/no prompt using description id desc and returns true for Yes.
Returns targets to the Deck or Extra Deck for reason and returns the number of cards moved.
If player is nil, each card returns to its owner. seq=0 places cards on top of the Deck, seq=1 places them on the bottom, and other values use the default shuffle/return handling.
Sends cards to player-side Extra Deck face-up for reason and returns the number of cards moved.
summary_zh: 因reason把卡以表侧送去player方额外卡组，并返回实际移动的卡数量。
core_summary_en: Sends cards to the Extra Deck face-up.
core_summary_zh: 把卡以表侧送去额外卡组。

summary_en: Sends targets to the Graveyard for reason, optionally treating reason_player as the player that moved them, and returns the number actually moved.
summary_zh: 因reason将targets送去墓地，可选指定reason_player作为执行该移动的玩家，并返回实际移动的数量。
core_summary_en: Sends cards to the Graveyard and returns the number actually moved.
core_summary_zh: 把卡送去墓地，并返回实际移动的数量。

params.name: targets
params.description: Card or Group to send to the Graveyard.

params.name: reason
params.description: REASON_* flags recorded for the move.

params.name: reason_player
params.description: Player recorded as the reason player; defaults to the core's current reason player.

returns.description: Number of cards actually sent to the Graveyard.

summary_en: Sends targets to a hand for reason and returns the number of cards actually moved.
Pass nil for player to use the normal return destination. Pass a specific player only when the effect says the cards go to that player's hand.
Registers a temporary chain-limit callback for the current Chain window.
The callback is stored with the current reason player and is later called as f(e, chain_player, activating_player). If it returns false, that effect cannot be chained.
summary_zh: 为当前连锁窗口登记临时连锁限制回调。
该回调会与当前原因玩家一起保存，之后以f(e, chain_player, activating_player)调用；返回false时，该效果不能连锁。
core_summary_en: Registers a temporary Chain limit callback.
core_summary_zh: 登记临时连锁限制回调。

summary_en: Registers a chain-limit callback that persists until the current chain ends.
summary_zh: 登记持续到当前连锁结束的连锁限制回调。
core_summary_en: Sets a chain limit until chain end.
core_summary_zh: 设置持续到连锁结束的连锁限制。

params.name: f
params.description: callback: f(e, chain_player, activating_player)

summary_en: Sets the stored coin results in the core result slots; only 0 and 1 are preserved, and other values are stored as 0.
summary_zh: 设置核心保存的硬币结果槽；只有0和1会保留，其他值会按0保存。

summary_en: Sets the five stored dice-result slots; missing or out-of-range values are stored as 1.
summary_zh: 设置5个骰子结果槽位；缺少或超出范围的值会被保存为1。
core_summary_en: Sets dice result slots.

summary_en: Sets the first matching player flag effect's label to label and returns whether one was found.
summary_zh: 把player身上第一个匹配的标志效果Label设为label，并返回是否找到该效果。
core_summary_en: Updates a player flag-effect label.

params.name: player
params.description: Player whose matching flag effect is updated.

params.name: code
params.description: Flag-effect code to find.

params.name: label
params.description: New integer label stored on the first matching player flag effect.

returns.description: True if a matching flag effect was updated; false if none exists; nil if player is invalid.

summary_en: Replaces the core's current Fusion Material set with the cards in g.
Fusion Material procedure operations use this after selecting a legal group so the later Fusion Summon operation can read the selected materials.
This function records the selection only; it does not move the materials or return a value.
summary_zh: 用g中的卡替换核心当前保存的融合素材组。
融合素材手续的操作函数在选出合法素材组后使用它，使之后的融合召唤操作可以读取所选素材。
本函数只记录选择；不会移动素材，也不返回值。
core_summary_en: Sets current Fusion Materials.

summary_en: Sets player's LP to lp, clamping negative lp values to 0, and sends the LP update message.
summary_zh: 将player的LP设为lp；lp为负数时限制为0，并发送LP更新消息。
core_summary_en: Sets player's LP.

summary_en: Records operation information for category on chainc.
Use concrete targets and count when the affected cards are known. For unresolved non-targeting movement effects, pass nil targets with the expected count, target player, and target location.
This information is used by response checks such as Stardust Dragon-style effects.
summary_zh: 为chainc对应的连锁记录category的操作信息。
已知受影响卡时传入具体targets和count；未确定对象的非取对象移动效果，可传nil targets并填写预计数量、目标玩家和目标位置。
这些信息会被类似星尘龙的响应检查使用。
core_summary_en: Records operation information for a category on a Chain Link.
core_summary_zh: 为连锁上的category记录操作信息。

params.name: chainc
params.description: Chain index/count passed to the core chain lookup; scripts commonly use 0 for the current Chain Link.

params.name: category
params.description: CATEGORY_* operation category to record.

params.name: targets
params.description: Known affected cards. Card or Group values are cloned into a read-only Group; nil records only count, player, and param.

params.name: count
params.description: Expected number of affected cards.

params.name: player
params.description: Target player stored in the operation info.

params.name: param
params.description: Category-specific value, commonly a destination location, amount, or other operation parameter.

summary_en: Sets the core must-select list to a Card or all cards in a Group for later selection helpers.
summary_zh: 把核心必须选择列表设置为一张Card，或设置为Group中的全部卡，供之后的选择辅助函数使用。
core_summary_en: Sets cards that must be selected.

summary_en: Stores g as the Synchro Material group for the current Synchro Material custom procedure.

Local standard Synchro helpers usually keep their selected material group on the procedure effect instead; this function appears in custom material-provider scripts such as Flower Cardian Synchro helpers.
This records the selected group for the core. It does not move those cards and returns no value.
summary_zh: 把g保存为当前同调素材自定义手续使用的同调素材组。
本地标准同调辅助函数通常把已选择素材组保存在手续效果上；此函数多见于花札卫等自定义同调素材提供脚本。
它只把已选择的素材组登记给核心使用；不会移动这些卡，也没有返回值。
core_summary_en: Stores a custom Synchro Material group.
core_summary_zh: 保存自定义同调素材组。

params.name: g
params.description: Selected Synchro Material group to store for the custom procedure.

summary_en: Stores targets as the target cards for the currently handled Chain.
For non-continuous effects, the core creates Chain relations for those cards and sends the become-target message when the effect has EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET.
This records broad operation targets; it does not by itself check whether the cards are legal effect targets.
summary_zh: 把targets保存为当前处理连锁的对象卡。
对于非永续效果，核心会为这些卡建立连锁关联；若效果带有EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET，还会发送成为对象的消息。
此函数用于登记广义操作对象；它本身不会检查这些卡是否可以合法成为效果对象。
core_summary_en: Sets target cards for the current Chain.
core_summary_zh: 设置当前连锁的对象卡。

params.name: targets
params.description: Card or Group to record as current Chain target cards.

summary_en: Stores param as the target parameter for the currently handled Chain.
Operations commonly read it with Duel.GetChainInfo(0, CHAININFO_TARGET_PARAM), often together with CHAININFO_TARGET_PLAYER.
summary_zh: 把param保存为当前处理连锁的对象参数。
Operation回调通常用Duel.GetChainInfo(0, CHAININFO_TARGET_PARAM)读取它，并常与CHAININFO_TARGET_PLAYER一起使用。
core_summary_en: Sets the current Chain target parameter.
core_summary_zh: 设置当前连锁的对象参数。

params.name: param
params.description: Integer target parameter stored on the current Chain.
params.description_zh: 保存到当前连锁上的整数对象参数。

summary_en: Stores player as the target player for the currently handled Chain.
Operations commonly read it with Duel.GetChainInfo(0, CHAININFO_TARGET_PLAYER), often together with CHAININFO_TARGET_PARAM.
summary_zh: 把player保存为当前处理连锁的对象玩家。
Operation回调通常用Duel.GetChainInfo(0, CHAININFO_TARGET_PLAYER)读取它，并常与CHAININFO_TARGET_PARAM一起使用。
core_summary_en: Sets the current Chain target player.
core_summary_zh: 设置当前连锁的对象玩家。

params.name: player
params.description: Player value stored on the current Chain.
params.description_zh: 保存到当前连锁上的玩家值。

summary_en: Shuffles player's Deck and resets shuffle-check state.
Shuffles player's Extra Deck.
summary_zh: 洗切player的额外卡组。
core_summary_en: Shuffles the Extra Deck.

summary_en: Shuffles player's hand and resets shuffle-check state.
Randomly reorders the Set cards in g, used for effects such as Magical Hats.
Applies a temporary field effect that makes player skip phase.

The phase must be one of PHASE_DRAW, PHASE_STANDBY, PHASE_MAIN1, PHASE_BATTLE, PHASE_MAIN2, or PHASE_END. reset_count values of 0 or less are treated as 1, and value is stored on the generated skip effect.
summary_zh: 适用一个临时场上效果，使player跳过phase阶段。
phase必须是PHASE_DRAW、PHASE_STANDBY、PHASE_MAIN1、PHASE_BATTLE、PHASE_MAIN2或PHASE_END之一。reset_count小于等于0时按1处理，value会保存在生成的跳过阶段效果上。
core_summary_en: Makes player skip a phase.

params.name: value
params.description: default: 0

summary_en: Lets sort_player reorder the top count cards of target_player's Main Deck.
Both players must be valid and count must be at least 1. If count is larger than the remaining Deck size, the processor only sorts the available top cards.
summary_zh: 让sort_player重新排列target_player主卡组最上方count张卡。
两名玩家都必须有效，且count至少为1。count大于剩余卡组数量时，处理器只排列实际存在的最上方卡。
core_summary_en: Lets one player sort cards on top of a Main Deck.
core_summary_zh: 让一名玩家排列主卡组最上方的卡。

summary_en: Special Summons targets to target_player's field in position pos and returns the number of cards successfully Summoned.
sumplayer is the player performing the Summon and sumtype records the Summon type. nocheck skips Summoning-condition checks; nolimit skips revive-limit checks.
summary_zh: 以pos表示形式把targets特殊召唤到target_player场上，并返回成功特殊召唤的数量。
sumplayer是执行召唤的玩家，sumtype记录召唤类型；nocheck跳过召唤条件检查，nolimit跳过苏生限制检查。
core_summary_en: Special Summons targets and returns the number of cards successfully Summoned.
core_summary_zh: 把targets特殊召唤到target_player场上，并返回成功特殊召唤的数量。

params.name: targets
params.description: Card or Group to Special Summon.

params.name: sumtype
params.description: Summon type value recorded for the Summon.

params.name: sumplayer
params.description: Player treated as performing the Special Summon.

params.name: target_player
params.description: Player whose field receives the Summoned cards.

params.name: nocheck
params.description: If true, skips Summoning-condition checks.

params.name: nolimit
params.description: If true, skips revive-limit checks.

params.name: pos
params.description: POS_* position mask for the Summon.

params.name: zone
params.description: Allowed Monster Zone bitmask; default: 0xff.

returns.description: Number of cards successfully Special Summoned.

summary_en: Completes a batch of successful Duel.SpecialSummonStep calls, raises the Summon events, and returns the number of completed Summons.
core_summary_en: Completes Special Summons started with Duel.SpecialSummonStep.
core_summary_zh: 完成由Duel.SpecialSummonStep开始的特殊召唤处理，触发召唤相关事件，并返回完成的特殊召唤数量。

summary_en: Performs a rule Special Summon of c for player with optional summon type sumtype, unless the core is in effect damage step processing.
summary_zh: 为player按规则特殊召唤c，可带召唤类型sumtype；核心处于效果伤害步骤处理时不会执行。
core_summary_en: Performs a rule Special Summon.

params.name: sumtype
params.description: default: 0

summary_en: Special Summons one card as part of a multi-step Summon procedure and returns true if that step succeeds.
Every successful step batch must finish with Duel.SpecialSummonComplete.
Makes player Normal Summon c, not Set it, optionally by effect e and requiring at least min Tributes.
If e is nil, regular Normal Summon rules are used. If ignore_count is true, the once-per-turn Normal Summon limit is ignored.
Swaps control between two Cards or between two Groups and returns whether the swap processor succeeded.
reset_phase and reset_count are optional temporary-control reset settings.
summary_zh: 交换两张Card或两组Group的控制权，并返回交换处理器是否成功。
reset_phase和reset_count是可选的临时控制权重置设置。
core_summary_en: Swaps control of cards.

params.name: reset_phase
params.description: default: 0

params.name: reset_count
params.description: default: 0

summary_en: For Exchange of the Spirit-style effects, swaps player's Deck and Graveyard.
Swaps the Monster Zone sequences of c1 and c2 when both are controlled by the same player, both are affected by the current reason effect, and both are in the Monster Zone.
The core raises move events for the swapped cards when the swap occurs.
summary_zh: 当c1和c2由同一玩家控制、都在怪兽区域且都受当前原因效果影响时，交换它们的怪兽区域序号。
交换成功时，核心会为这两张卡引发移动事件。
core_summary_en: Swaps Monster Zone sequences.

summary_en: Performs a Synchro Summon of c for player, optionally requiring tuner and selecting materials from mg.
Use this in an effect operation after checking Card.IsSynchroSummonable; the chosen Synchro Monster's registered procedure still controls material legality.
minc and maxc can restrict the number of non-Tuner materials used by the procedure.
summary_zh: 为player进行c的同调召唤；可以指定必须使用的tuner，并可从mg中选择素材。
通常在效果操作处理中先用Card.IsSynchroSummonable检查后再调用；被选择的同调怪兽登记的同调手续仍然决定素材是否合法。
minc和maxc可以限制该手续使用的非调整素材数量。
core_summary_en: Performs a Synchro Summon.

params.name: player
params.description: Player performing the Synchro Summon.

params.name: c
params.description: Synchro Monster to Summon.

params.name: tuner
params.description: Optional required Tuner material.

params.name: mg
params.description: Optional material pool to select from.

params.name: minc
params.description: Optional minimum non-Tuner material count override; default: 0.

params.name: maxc
params.description: Optional maximum non-Tuner material count override; default: 0.

summary_en: Tosses count coins for player and returns one integer result per toss.
Results are 0 or 1. Normal script use passes a positive count up to MAX_COIN_COUNT; the binding rejects 0 and values below -1, and clamps large positive counts to the core maximum.
summary_zh: 为player投掷count枚硬币，并为每次投掷返回1个整数结果。
结果为0或1。通常脚本用法传入正数count且不超过MAX_COIN_COUNT；该绑定拒绝0和小于-1的值，并将过大的正数限制为核心最大值。
core_summary_en: Tosses coins and returns their results.

returns.description: First coin result, 0 or 1.
Additional coin results.

summary_en: Tosses count1 dice for player and, when count2 is supplied, count2 dice for the opponent.
Valid dice results are integers from 1 to 6. Normal script use should keep count1 + count2 at 5 or less; the core rejects count1 <= 0 and count2 < 0.
summary_zh: 为player投掷count1个骰子；提供count2时，为对方再投掷count2个骰子。
有效骰子结果为1到6的整数。通常脚本用法应保持count1 + count2不超过5；核心会拒绝count1 <= 0和count2 < 0。
core_summary_en: Tosses dice and returns their results.

params.name: count2
params.description: default: 0

returns.description: First die result.
Additional die results.

summary_en: Sets player as the duel winner with reason, but only if no winner has already been set.
summary_zh: 把player设置为因reason获得决斗胜利；如果核心已经记录胜者，则不会覆盖。
core_summary_en: Sets the duel winner.

summary_en: Performs a rule Xyz Summon for player and c using an optional material group and min/max constraints.
Use this in effect operations after checking Card.IsXyzSummonable. The selected Xyz Monster's registered procedure still controls final material legality and overlaying.
The core rejects this during the Damage Step, yields while the summon is processed, and returns no Lua value.
summary_zh: 为player和c执行规则超量召唤，可使用可选素材组和min/max限制。
通常在效果operation中先检查Card.IsXyzSummonable，再调用此函数。被选择超量怪兽已登记的手续仍负责最终素材合法性和叠放处理。
核心在伤害步骤中会拒绝调用；处理召唤时会让脚本等待，且没有Lua返回值。
core_summary_en: Performs a rule Xyz Summon.

params.name: player
params.description: Player performing the Xyz Summon.
params.description_zh: 进行超量召唤的玩家。

params.name: c
params.description: Xyz Monster to Summon.
params.description_zh: 要召唤的超量怪兽。

params.name: materials
params.description: Optional material group supplied by the effect.
params.description_zh: 效果提供的可选素材Group。

params.name: minc
params.description: Optional minimum material count override. Defaults to 0.
params.description_zh: 可选的素材数量下限覆盖值。默认为0。

params.name: maxc
params.description: Optional maximum material count override. Defaults to 0.
params.description_zh: 可选的素材数量上限覆盖值。默认为0。

summary_en: Checks whether e's count limit is still available for player p.
Normal activation checks already use the core count-limit check; this helper is mainly for scripts that manually inspect another Effect object.
summary_zh: 检查效果e对玩家p是否仍有可用次数。
通常的发动检查已经会执行核心次数限制检查；此函数主要用于脚本手动检查另一个Effect对象。
core_summary_en: Returns whether e's count limit is available for player p.
core_summary_zh: 返回效果e对玩家p是否仍有可用次数。

params.name: e
params.description: Effect whose remaining count is checked.
params.description_zh: 要检查剩余次数的效果。

params.name: p
params.description: Player whose local or shared count map is checked.
params.description_zh: 要检查本地或共享次数表的玩家。

returns.description: True if e has no exhausted count limit for p; false when the count is already spent.
returns.description_zh: 如果e对p没有耗尽次数限制则返回true；次数已经用尽时返回false。

summary_en: Creates and returns a new Effect object copied from e.
Creates a new empty Effect object owned by card c.
core_summary_en: Creates a new empty Effect object owned by card c.
core_summary_zh: 新建一个空效果，并把效果的Owner设为c。

summary_en: Returns the location from which effect e was activated.
summary_zh: 返回效果e发动时所在的位置。
core_summary_en: Returns e's activation location.

summary_en: Returns the sequence where e was activated.
summary_zh: 返回效果e发动时所在的位置序号。

summary_en: Returns the active effect type, such as monster, Spell, or Trap. This can differ from the type of the card that activated the effect, such as Pendulum effects being treated as Spell effects.
Returns e's category bitmask.
summary_zh: 返回e的Category位掩码。
core_summary_en: Returns effect category bits.

summary_en: Returns e's effect code.
summary_zh: 返回e的效果编号。

summary_en: Returns e's condition callback, or nil when no condition is set.
summary_zh: 返回e的Condition回调；没有设置Condition时返回nil。
core_summary_en: Returns condition callback.

summary_en: Returns e's cost function, or nil when no cost function is set.
summary_zh: 返回e的费用函数；未设置费用函数时返回nil。
core_summary_en: Returns e's cost function.

summary_en: Returns e's description id.
summary_zh: 返回e的描述编号。

summary_en: Returns e's internal field ID.
summary_zh: 返回效果e的内部field ID。
core_summary_en: Returns e's internal field ID.

params.name: e
params.description: Effect whose internal field ID is returned.

returns.description: Internal effect ID stored in e.

summary_en: Returns the card currently handling e, usually the card that registered it with Card.RegisterEffect.
core_summary_en: Returns the card currently handling e.
core_summary_zh: 返回效果e当前在哪张卡上生效。

summary_en: Returns the current controller of e's handler.
Returns e's stored integer labels. If no label was set, returns 0.
Returns e's stored label object, or nil if none is stored or the object is no longer valid.
Returns e's operation callback, or nil if no operation callback is set.
summary_zh: 返回e的Operation回调函数；未设置时返回nil。
core_summary_en: Returns e's operation callback, or nil if no operation callback is set.
core_summary_zh: 返回e的Operation回调函数；未设置时返回nil。

summary_en: Returns the card that owns e.
summary_zh: 返回持有e的卡。

summary_en: Returns the player stored as e's owner player.
summary_zh: 返回效果e记录的拥有者玩家。
core_summary_en: Returns e's owner player.
core_summary_zh: 返回效果e的拥有者玩家。

summary_en: Returns e's two property flag fields, flag1 and flag2.
summary_zh: 返回e的两个属性标志字段flag1和flag2。
core_summary_en: Returns effect property flags.

returns.description: flag1.
flag2.

summary_en: Returns e's range bitmask.
summary_zh: 返回效果e的Range位掩码。

summary_en: Returns e's target callback, or nil if no target callback is set.
summary_zh: 返回e的Target回调函数；未设置时返回nil。
core_summary_en: Returns e's target callback, or nil if no target callback is set.
core_summary_zh: 返回e的Target回调函数；未设置时返回nil。

summary_en: Returns e's effect type mask, such as EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE, EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD, or EFFECT_TYPE_TRIGGER_O.
summary_zh: 返回e的效果类型掩码，例如EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE、EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD或EFFECT_TYPE_TRIGGER_O。

summary_en: Returns e's value field. For function-valued effects this is the stored callback; otherwise it is the stored integer value.
summary_zh: 返回e的Value字段。函数值效果返回保存的回调函数；否则返回保存的整数值。
core_summary_en: Returns e's value callback or integer value.
core_summary_zh: 返回e的Value回调函数或整数值。

summary_en: Creates a new effect owned by the duel temporary card with effect owner player 0.
summary_zh: 创建一个由决斗临时卡拥有、效果拥有者为玩家0的新效果。
core_summary_en: Creates a global Effect object.

summary_en: Checks whether e can currently be activated by player, with optional booleans to ignore location and target checks.
summary_zh: 检查e当前能否由player发动，并可用可选布尔值忽略位置检查和对象检查。
core_summary_en: Checks effect activation legality.

summary_en: Checks whether e has one of the EFFECT_TYPES_CHAIN_LINK type bits.
summary_zh: 检查效果e是否具有EFFECT_TYPES_CHAIN_LINK中的类型位。
core_summary_en: Checks whether e has a Chain Link effect type.
core_summary_zh: 检查效果e是否具有连锁环效果类型。

summary_en: Checks whether e's active card type contains at least one flag from type.
Checks whether e's cost has already been checked, which indicates whether it was copied.
Checks whether e's category bitmask contains cate.
summary_zh: 检查e的category位掩码是否包含cate。
core_summary_en: Checks effect category bits.

summary_en: Checks whether e contains the requested effect property flags.
prop1 is checked against the first property word and optional prop2 against the second property word. Passing 0 for a word makes that word pass.
summary_zh: 检查效果e是否包含指定的效果Property标志。
prop1检查第1个Property字段，可选的prop2检查第2个Property字段；某个字段传0时该字段视为通过。
core_summary_en: Checks e's effect property flags.

params.name: e
params.description: Effect whose property words are checked.

params.name: prop1
params.description: Mask checked against the first property word. Use 0 to ignore this word.

params.name: prop2
params.description: Mask checked against the second property word. Omitted or 0 means this word passes.

returns.description: True when every nonzero requested property mask is present on e.

summary_en: Checks whether the effect includes range.
Checks whether e's effect type contains at least one flag from type.
Removes e from its registered card or field effect list when e is still attached to a valid owner and handler.
summary_zh: 当e仍附着在有效持有者和处理对象上时，将其从对应卡片或场地效果列表中移除。

summary_en: Sets e's target range from an absolute player viewpoint and marks the effect with EFFECT_FLAG_ABSOLUTE_TARGET.
If playerid is 1, the supplied ranges are swapped internally so the stored ranges still line up with player 0/player 1 absolute handling.
core_summary_en: Sets e's target range from an absolute player viewpoint.
core_summary_zh: 以绝对玩家视角设置效果e的Target Range属性。playerid为1时，s_range和o_range会在核心中交换保存。

summary_en: Sets when the client should offer or highlight e for the handler's controller and, optionally, the opponent.
This controls prompting and display timing only; it does not replace activation legality checks in the effect's condition, cost, or target callbacks.
summary_zh: 设置客户端应在何时向处理者的控制者提示或高亮e，也可以单独设置对手侧提示。
该函数只控制提示与显示时机；不能替代Condition、Cost或Target回调中的发动合法性检查。
core_summary_en: Sets hint timing for e.

params.name: s_time
params.description: Hint timing mask for the handler's controller.
params.description_zh: 处理者控制者侧的提示时机掩码。

params.name: o_time
params.description: Hint timing mask for the opponent. Defaults to s_time.
params.description_zh: 对手侧的提示时机掩码；默认等于s_time。

summary_en: Sets e's operation category flags, such as CATEGORY_DESTROY, CATEGORY_TOHAND, or CATEGORY_SPECIAL_SUMMON.
Categories describe what the effect may do; known operation details should still be recorded with Duel.SetOperationInfo in the Target callback.
core_summary_en: Sets e's operation category flags.
core_summary_zh: 设置效果e的Category属性，用于声明效果可能包含的操作类别。

summary_en: Sets e's code. For triggered effects this is usually an event code; for continuous effects it is the effect code being applied.
core_summary_en: Sets e's code.

summary_en: Sets e's condition callback. The callback decides whether the effect can apply or be activated in the current context.
core_summary_en: Sets e's condition callback.

summary_en: Sets e's cost callback. For activated effects, the callback checks whether the cost can be paid and then pays it.
Cost callbacks should only test legality when chk is 0; irreversible payment belongs in the nonzero chk branch.
summary_zh: 设置e的Cost回调。对于发动型效果，该回调用于检查Cost能否支付，并在实际发动时支付Cost。
chk为0时Cost回调只应检查合法性；不可逆的支付动作应放在chk非0的分支。
core_summary_en: Sets e's cost callback.

params.name: e
params.description: Effect whose cost callback is replaced.
params.description_zh: 要替换Cost回调的效果。

params.name: cost_func
params.description: Callback usually shaped as cost_func(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk).
params.description_zh: 回调通常写作cost_func(e,tp,eg,ep,ev,re,r,rp,chk)。

summary_en: Sets e's cost-check flag to b.
Sets how many times e can be used before its count limit is spent.
If count is 0, the core treats it as 1. Effects that share a nonzero code share the same usage count for the checked player.

EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_OATH uses oath-style rollback on negated activations and failed procedure attempts; EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_DUEL uses the duel-long count map; EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_SINGLE shares usage by handler instance; EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_CHAIN uses the chain count map.
summary_zh: 设置效果e在次数限制耗尽前可以使用的次数。
count为0时核心按1处理。共享同一个非0 code的效果会对被检查的玩家共用使用次数。
EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_OATH在发动被无效或手续失败时使用誓约式次数回退；EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_DUEL使用决斗内次数表；EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_SINGLE按处理者实例共享次数；EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_CHAIN使用连锁次数表。
core_summary_en: Sets e's count limit and optional shared count code. The binding sets EFFECT_FLAG_COUNT_LIMIT and stores count_limit, count_limit_max, and count_code.
core_summary_zh: 设置效果e的使用次数限制count，以及可选的共享次数代码code；绑定会设置EFFECT_FLAG_COUNT_LIMIT并保存count_limit、count_limit_max和count_code。

params.name: e
params.description: Effect whose count limit is set.
params.description_zh: 要设置次数限制的效果。

params.name: count
params.description: Maximum uses before the count is spent; 0 is normalized to 1 by the core.
params.description_zh: 次数耗尽前的最大使用次数；核心会将0按1处理。

params.name: code
params.description: Shared count-limit code. Effects with the same nonzero code share usage for the checked player; combine a card id with EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_OATH, EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_DUEL, or EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_SINGLE when that special behavior is needed. Passing exactly EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_CHAIN stores it together with EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_SINGLE in this core.
params.description_zh: 共享次数限制代码。同一个非0代码的效果会对被检查的玩家共用使用次数；需要特殊行为时可将卡号与EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_OATH、EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_DUEL或EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_SINGLE组合。传入的代码正好是EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_CHAIN时，此核心会同时保存EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_SINGLE。

summary_en: Sets e's description id, usually produced with Auxiliary.Stringid for card text choices.
core_summary_en: Sets e's description id.

summary_en: Stores one or more integer label values on e, replacing any previous labels.
Stores a Card, Group, Effect, or nil as e's label object.
Sets e's operation callback. Passing nil clears the operation.
For activated effects, this callback resolves after the Chain reaches this Link, so it should re-check targets, locations, relation, and other state that may have changed since activation.
summary_zh: 设置e的Operation回调；传入nil会清除Operation。
对于发动型效果，该回调会在连锁处理到此连锁环时结算，因此应重新检查对象、位置、关联以及发动后可能变化的状态。
core_summary_en: Sets or clears e's operation callback.
core_summary_zh: 设置或清除效果e的Operation函数。

params.name: e
params.description: Effect whose operation callback is replaced or cleared.
params.description_zh: 要替换或清除Operation回调的效果。

params.name: op_func
params.description: Operation callback, or nil to clear it.
params.description_zh: Operation回调；传nil表示清除。

summary_en: Sets e's owner player to player.
Only player values 0 and 1 are accepted; any other value leaves the effect unchanged.
summary_zh: 将效果e的拥有者玩家设为player。
只接受0和1作为player；其他值不会改变该效果。
core_summary_en: Sets e's owner player.
core_summary_zh: 设置效果e的拥有者玩家。

summary_en: Sets e's property flags. prop1 holds the normal effect property flags; prop2 is used for the second property word when needed.
Internal flags are preserved when prop1 is replaced.

Learner-facing flags include EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET for official targets, EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_STEP and EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_CAL for Damage Step timing, and EFFECT_FLAG_PLAYER_TARGET for effects that apply to players.
summary_zh: 设置e的Property标志。prop1保存常规效果性质标志；需要第二组性质标志时使用prop2。
替换prop1时会保留内部标志。
学习时常见的标志包括：EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET用于正式取对象，EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_STEP与EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_CAL用于伤害步骤时点，EFFECT_FLAG_PLAYER_TARGET用于影响玩家的效果。
core_summary_en: Sets e's property flags.

params.name: e
params.description: Effect whose property flags are set.
params.description_zh: 要设置Property标志的效果。

params.name: prop1
params.description: Primary effect property bitmask.
params.description_zh: 主要效果性质位掩码。

params.name: prop2
params.description: Optional second property bitmask for flags stored in the second property word.
params.description_zh: 可选的第二组性质位掩码，用于保存在第二个Property字段中的标志。

summary_en: Sets the location range where e applies or can be activated.
core_summary_en: Sets the location range where e applies or can be activated.
core_summary_zh: 设置效果e的生效或可发动位置。

summary_en: Sets when e resets and how many reset checks it can survive.
If reset_count is 0 or omitted, the core stores 1. When a phase reset is used without an explicit turn side, the core applies both RESET_SELF_TURN and RESET_OPPO_TURN.
core_summary_en: Sets e's reset flags and optional reset count.
core_summary_zh: 设置效果e的reset参数和可选的reset次数。

summary_en: Sets e's target callback. For activated effects, this callback performs activation legality checks and records target or operation information.

Target callbacks normally use chk==0 only to answer legality, then use the real activation branch to select official targets with Duel.SelectTarget, record broad targets with Duel.SetTargetCard, or announce operation details with Duel.SetOperationInfo.
summary_zh: 设置e的Target回调。对于发动型效果，该回调用于检查发动合法性，并登记对象或操作信息。
Target回调通常在chk==0分支只回答是否合法；实际发动分支再用Duel.SelectTarget选择正式对象、用Duel.SetTargetCard登记广义对象，或用Duel.SetOperationInfo声明操作信息。
core_summary_en: Sets e's target callback.

params.name: e
params.description: Effect whose target callback is replaced.

params.name: targ_func
params.description: Callback function stored on e.

summary_en: Sets e's target range fields and clears EFFECT_FLAG_ABSOLUTE_TARGET.

For most field effects, s_range is the affected locations on the handler's controller's side and o_range is the affected locations on the opponent's side. With EFFECT_FLAG_SPSUM_PARAM, they store Special Summon destination player and position.
core_summary_en: Sets e's target range fields.

summary_en: Sets e's effect type flags.
The core normalizes some type combinations: Spell/Trap activation effects become field activation effects, Flip Effects receive EVENT_FLIP handling, and ignition/Quick Effects gain field behavior.
core_summary_en: Sets e's effect type flags.

summary_en: Sets e's value field. The value can be a number, boolean, or callback function depending on the effect code.
core_summary_en: Sets e's value field.

summary_en: Manually consumes count uses of e's count limit for player p.
count defaults to 1. If oath_only is true, the count is consumed only when e's count code includes EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_OATH; otherwise the binding decrements the count limit directly.
summary_zh: 手动消耗玩家p对效果e的count次次数限制。
count默认1。oath_only为true时，只有e的次数代码包含EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_OATH才会消耗次数；否则该绑定会直接减少次数限制。
core_summary_en: Manually consumes e's count limit for player p.
core_summary_zh: 手动消耗玩家p对效果e的次数限制。

params.name: e
params.description: Effect whose count is manually consumed.
params.description_zh: 要手动消耗次数的效果。

params.name: p
params.description: Player whose local or shared count is consumed.
params.description_zh: 要消耗本地或共享次数的玩家。

params.name: count
params.description: Number of uses to consume; default: 1.
params.description_zh: 要消耗的使用次数；默认值为1。

params.name: oath_only
params.description: If true, consume only when e's count code includes EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_OATH; default: false.
params.description_zh: 若为true，则仅在e的次数代码包含EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_OATH时消耗次数；默认值为false。

summary_en: Returns the current script's table, card code, and string offset. The offset is 1 for regular card IDs and 100 for large custom IDs.
summary_zh: 返回当前脚本的表、卡名编号以及字符串偏移值。普通卡编号的偏移值为1，大型自定义编号的偏移值为100。
core_summary_en: Returns the current script table, card code, and string offset.

returns.description: The current script table.
The current card code.
String ID offset, 1 or 100.

summary_en: Adds c to g if g is mutable.
summary_zh: 若g可修改，则把c加入g。

summary_en: Lets player select min to max cards from g, excluding ex; the selection can be canceled and return nil.
Checks whether g has a subgroup with size between min and max that satisfies f, while respecting already selected cards from Duel.GrabSelectedCard and Auxiliary.GCheckAdditional.
summary_zh: 检查g是否存在数量在min到max之间且满足f的子组，同时考虑Duel.GrabSelectedCard已有选择和Auxiliary.GCheckAdditional。
core_summary_en: Checks whether g has a subgroup satisfying f.

returns.description: true if a valid subgroup exists.

summary_en: Checks whether g can supply one card for each filter in checks. If f is omitted, only the per-position checks are required.
summary_zh: 检查g是否能为checks中的每个筛选各提供1张卡。省略f时，只要求每个位置的筛选成立。
core_summary_en: Checks whether g can supply one card for each filter in checks.

returns.description: true if one card can satisfy each check.

summary_en: Checks whether a subset of g, including any must-select cards, can make the f-sum exactly acc using between min and max cards.
summary_zh: 检查g的某个子集（包括所有必须选择的卡）能否用min到max张卡使f的合计正好等于acc。
core_summary_en: Checks exact sum selection.

summary_en: Checks whether g can satisfy an f-sum of at least acc.
Cards previously set with Duel.SetSelectedCard are forced into the sum and the must-select list is cleared before returning.
summary_zh: 检查g是否能满足f的合计值至少为acc。
先前用Duel.SetSelectedCard设置的卡会强制计入合计，且必须选择列表会在返回前清空。
core_summary_en: Checks a greater-or-equal sum.
core_summary_zh: 检查大于等于的合计值。

summary_en: Clears g unless it is a read-only group.
summary_zh: 清空g；若g为只读Group则不会清空。
core_summary_en: Clears a Group.

summary_en: Creates and returns a new Group containing the same cards as g.
Creates and returns a new empty Group.
summary_zh: 新建并返回一个空Group。
core_summary_en: Creates an empty Group.

summary_en: Releases a Group previously preserved with Group.KeepAlive so Lua can manage it normally again.
Calling this on an ordinary Group has no effect.
summary_zh: 释放之前通过Group.KeepAlive保留的Group，使其重新交由Lua正常管理。
对普通Group调用此函数没有效果。

summary_en: Checks whether g1 and g2 contain exactly the same cards in the same internal order.
summary_zh: 检查g1和g2是否以相同内部顺序包含完全相同的卡。

summary_en: Returns a new Group containing cards from g that satisfy filter f and are not excluded by ex.
Extra arguments after ex are passed to f after the card argument.
summary_zh: 返回由g中满足筛选函数f且不在ex中的卡组成的新Group。
ex之后的额外参数会在Card参数之后传给f。
core_summary_en: Returns the cards in g that satisfy f and are not excluded by ex.
core_summary_zh: 从g中筛选满足f且不等于ex的卡，并返回新的Group。

params.name: g
params.description: Group to filter; it is not modified.

params.name: f
params.description: Filter callback called for each candidate card.

params.name: ex
params.description: Card or Group excluded before filtering; nil excludes nothing.
Extra values forwarded to f after the candidate Card.

returns.description: New Group containing cards that passed f.

summary_en: Counts cards in g that satisfy f, excluding ex.
Extra arguments after ex are passed to f after the Card argument.
summary_zh: 统计g中满足f且不在ex中的卡数量。
ex之后的额外参数会传给f。

summary_en: Lets player choose min to max cards from g that satisfy filter f, excluding ex, and returns the selected Group.
Extra arguments after ex are passed to f after the Card argument.
summary_zh: 让player从g中选择min到max张满足筛选函数f且不在ex中的卡，并返回选中的Group。
ex之后的额外参数会在Card参数之后传给f。
core_summary_en: Lets player choose matching cards from g.
core_summary_zh: 让player从g中选择满足条件的卡。

summary_en: Utility stub for calling f once for each card in g with any extra arguments.
summary_zh: 工具存根：对g中的每张卡以任意额外参数调用一次f。

summary_en: Creates and returns a new Group containing the non-nil Card arguments.
summary_zh: 创建并返回包含所有非nil Card参数的新Group。

summary_en: Calls f for each card in g, ORs the returned integer values together, and returns the number of set bits in the result.
summary_zh: 对g中的每张卡调用f，把返回的整数值按位或合并，然后返回结果中置位的数量。

summary_en: Counts distinct classes among cards in g according to f. Cards with the same return value from f count as the same class; extra arguments are passed to f.
Returns the number of cards in g.
core_summary_en: Returns the number of cards in g.

summary_en: Returns the first card in g and resets g's internal iterator to that card. Returns nil when g is empty.
core_summary_en: Returns the first card in g and resets g's iterator.
core_summary_zh: 返回g中的第一张卡，并把g的迭代指针重置到第一张卡。

summary_en: Calls f for each card in g, forwards any extra arguments, and returns a Group containing every card tied for the maximum value.
The second return is the maximum integer value. If g is empty, this binding returns no Lua values.
summary_zh: 对g中的每张卡调用f，转发额外参数，并返回所有最大值并列卡组成的Group。
第二个返回值是最大整数值。g为空时，该绑定不返回Lua值。
core_summary_en: Returns cards with the maximum value produced by f.
core_summary_zh: 返回使f取得最大值的卡。

returns.description: Cards tied for maximum value.
Maximum value.

summary_en: Calls f for each card in g, forwards any extra arguments, and returns a Group containing every card tied for the minimum value.
The second return is the minimum integer value. If g is empty, this binding returns no Lua values.
summary_zh: 对g中的每张卡调用f，转发额外参数，并返回所有最小值并列卡组成的Group。
第二个返回值是最小整数值。g为空时，该绑定不返回Lua值。
core_summary_en: Returns cards tied for minimum function value.
core_summary_zh: 返回函数值最小的并列卡。

returns.description: Cards tied for the minimum value.
Minimum value.

summary_en: Advances g's internal iterator and returns the next card, or nil when there are no more cards.
core_summary_en: Returns the next card from g's iterator.
core_summary_zh: 把g的迭代指针移动到下一张卡并返回该卡。

summary_en: Calls f for each card in g, forwards any extra arguments, and returns the sum of the integer values produced.
summary_zh: 对g中的每张卡调用f，转发额外参数，并返回各次整数结果的总和。
core_summary_en: Sums f's value for every card in g.
core_summary_zh: 累计g中每张卡调用f得到的数值。

summary_en: Checks whether g contains card c.
Checks whether at least count cards in g satisfy filter f and are not excluded by ex.
Extra arguments after ex are passed to f after the card argument.
core_summary_en: Checks whether at least count cards in g satisfy f and are not excluded by ex.
core_summary_zh: 检查g中是否存在至少count张满足f且不等于ex的卡。

summary_en: Prevents g from being automatically released by Lua until Group.DeleteGroup is called.
summary_zh: 阻止g被Lua自动释放，直到调用Group.DeleteGroup。

summary_en: Adds every card from g2 into g1. g2 itself is not changed.
Returns a new Group containing count randomly chosen cards from g.
count is clamped to g's size. The player argument is written to the random-selection message but does not influence the random choice.
summary_zh: 返回一个新Group，包含从g中随机选出的count张卡。
count会被限制为g的数量。player参数会写入随机选择消息，但不影响随机结果。
core_summary_en: Returns a random subset of g.

summary_en: Removes cards from mutable group g that satisfy f and are not ex, passing any extra arguments to f.
summary_zh: 从可修改的Group g中移除满足f且不等于ex的卡，并把额外参数传给f。
core_summary_en: Removes matching cards from a mutable Group.
core_summary_zh: 从可修改Group中移除匹配卡。

summary_en: Removes c from g. The function mutates g unless g is read-only and returns no Lua value.
summary_zh: 从g中移除c。除非g为只读Group，否则会直接修改g；不返回Lua值。
core_summary_en: Removes c from g.

summary_en: Returns the first card in g that satisfies f with any extra arguments, or nil if none does.
summary_zh: 返回g中第一张满足f和额外参数的卡；没有则返回nil。

summary_en: Lets player choose min to max cards from g, optionally excluding ex, and returns the selected Group.
summary_zh: 让player从g中选择min到max张卡，可选排除ex，并返回选中的Group。
core_summary_en: Lets player choose min to max cards from g.
core_summary_zh: 让玩家player从g中选择min到max张卡。

params.name: g
params.description: Selectable card pool.

params.name: player
params.description: Player who makes the selection; invalid players make the core return no values.

params.name: min
params.description: Minimum number of cards to select.

params.name: max
params.description: Maximum number of cards to select.

params.name: ex
params.description: Card or Group excluded from selectable cards; nil excludes nothing.

returns.description: New Group containing selected cards, or nil if player is invalid.

summary_en: Lets tp select a subgroup from g with size between min and max that satisfies f. It respects already selected cards and returns nil if no valid selection is completed.
summary_zh: 让tp从g中选择数量在min到max之间且满足f的子组。会考虑已有选择；若不能完成有效选择则返回nil。
core_summary_en: Lets tp select a subgroup satisfying f.

returns.description: The selected subgroup, or nil if no valid selection is completed.

summary_en: Lets tp select one card for each filter in checks, optionally cancelable. If f is omitted, Auxiliary.TRUE is used for the final group check.
summary_zh: 让tp为checks中的每个筛选各选择1张卡，可选择是否允许取消。省略f时，最终组检查使用Auxiliary.TRUE。
core_summary_en: Lets tp select one card for each filter in checks.

returns.description: The selected subgroup, or nil if no valid selection is completed.

summary_en: Lets player choose one card from cg to add to the current selection or one card from sg to remove from it, then returns the card that was chosen.
sg may be nil. finishable controls whether the selection can finish at its current size, cancelable allows cancellation, and cancellation returns nil. min and max default to 1.
summary_zh: 让player从cg中选择1张卡加入当前选择，或从sg中选择1张卡移出当前选择，并返回被选择的那张卡。
sg可以为nil。finishable控制当前数量下能否结束选择，cancelable允许取消；取消时返回nil。min和max默认均为1。
core_summary_en: Lets player add or remove one card from an interactive selection.
core_summary_zh: 让player在交互选择中加入或移出1张卡。

params.name: finishable
params.description: default: false

params.name: cancelable
params.description: default: false

params.name: min
params.description: default: 1

params.name: max
params.description: default: 1

returns.description: Chosen card, or nil if the selection is canceled.

summary_en: Lets player select cards from g whose f-sum equals acc using between min and max cards.
Cards previously set with Duel.SetSelectedCard are forced into the sum, removed from the selectable pool, cleared afterward, and are not included in the returned Group.
summary_zh: 让player从g中选择若干卡，使f的合计值等于acc，选择数量在min到max之间。
先前用Duel.SetSelectedCard设置的卡会强制计入合计、从可选池移除、处理后清空，且不会包含在返回的Group中。
core_summary_en: Selects cards with an exact sum.
core_summary_zh: 选择合计值正好相等的卡。

returns.description: Selected optional cards, or nil for invalid player.

summary_en: Lets player select a subset of g whose f-value sum reaches or exceeds sum according to the core's exact greater-sum selection rule; returns an empty Group if no valid subset exists.
summary_zh: 让player从g中选择一个子集，使f的取值合计按核心的精确大于等于规则达到sum；没有合法子集时返回空Group。

summary_en: Removes every card in g2 from g1. g1 is mutated unless it is read-only; g2 is not changed.
summary_zh: 从g1中移除g2包含的每张卡。除非g1只读，否则会直接修改g1；g2不会改变。
core_summary_en: Removes g2's cards from g1.

summary_en: Returns a new Group containing cards from both operands, where each operand may be a Card or Group.
summary_zh: 返回包含两个操作数中卡的新Group；每个操作数都可以是Card或Group。
core_summary_en: Union operator for Group/Card operands. Equivalent to combining both operands into a new Group.

returns.description: A new group containing cards from both operands.

summary_en: Returns a new Group containing cards present in both operands.
summary_zh: 返回同时存在于两个操作数中的卡组成的新Group。
core_summary_en: Intersection operator for Group/Card operands.

returns.description: A new group containing cards present in both operands.

summary_en: Returns a new Group containing cards from both operands; this uses the same core handler as Group.__add.
summary_zh: 返回包含两个操作数中卡的新Group；它与Group.__add使用同一个核心处理。
core_summary_en: Bitwise-or/union operator for Group/Card operands. It uses the same core handler as Group.__add.

returns.description: A new group containing cards from both operands.

summary_en: Returns a new Group containing cards present in exactly one operand.
summary_zh: 返回只存在于其中一个操作数中的卡组成的新Group。
core_summary_en: Symmetric-difference operator for Group/Card operands.

returns.description: A new group containing cards present in exactly one operand.

summary_en: Returns the number of cards in g.
summary_zh: 返回g中的卡片数量。
core_summary_en: Length operator for Group. Equivalent to Group.GetCount.

returns.description: The number of cards in g.

summary_en: Returns a new Group containing cards from the left operand that are not in the right operand.
summary_zh: 返回左操作数中有、右操作数中没有的卡组成的新Group。
core_summary_en: Difference operator for Group/Card operands. It removes the right operand's cards from the left operand.

returns.description: A new group with cards from left that are not in right.

summary_en: Returns the bitwise AND of a and b.
summary_zh: 返回a和b的按位与结果。
core_summary_en: Lua 5.3 bit32-compatible bitwise AND helper.

returns.description: Bitwise AND of a and b.

summary_en: Returns the bitwise NOT of a.
summary_zh: 返回a的按位取反结果。
core_summary_en: Lua 5.3 bit32-compatible bitwise NOT helper.

returns.description: Bitwise NOT of a.

summary_en: Returns the bitwise OR of a and b.
summary_zh: 返回a与b的按位或结果。
core_summary_en: Returns the bitwise OR of a and b.

summary_en: Returns the bitwise XOR of a and b.
summary_zh: 返回a与b的按位异或结果。
core_summary_en: Bitwise XOR.

summary_en: Extracts width bits from r starting at bit field. width defaults to 1.
summary_zh: 从r中提取从field位开始的width位。width省略时为1。
core_summary_en: Extracts a bit field from r.

returns.description: The extracted bit field.

summary_en: Returns a shifted left by b bits.
summary_zh: 返回a左移b位后的结果。
core_summary_en: Bitwise left shift.

summary_en: Returns r with width bits starting at field replaced by the low width bits of v. width defaults to 1.
summary_zh: 返回把r中从field位开始的width位替换为v的低width位后的结果。width省略时为1。
core_summary_en: Replaces a bit field inside r.

returns.description: r with the selected bit field replaced.

summary_en: Returns a shifted right by b bits.
summary_zh: 返回a右移b位后的结果。
core_summary_en: Bitwise right shift.
